etymology.historical_story: English pulpy combines pulp with the adjective-forming suffix -y. Pulp ultimately traces to Latin pulpa, referring to flesh or a fruit's soft interior. The literary association belongs to pulp publishing, named after inexpensive wood-pulp paper. Thus one English adjective can describe both soft fruit material and sensational popular storytelling. [Etymological account](https://www.etymonline.com/word/pulpy)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语 pulp 是果肉或浆，加 -y 就是“有果肉、像浆一样的”；想象吸管吸到细软果肉。

morphology.formula: pembuat + -an → pembuatan（按词包基底衔接）；完整构词：peN-...-an + buat → pembuatan
morphology.pattern_note: pembuat 是词包提供的派生基底，基本词根为 buat。通行整体分析采用环缀 peN-...-an；peN- 在 b 前实现为 pem-，b 保留，u 与 a 分属两个音节。[马来西亚教师教育学院：构词说明](https://ipkent.edu.my/document/pskent/pskent18/modul/bmm/BMM3093.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 制作、制造或生产某物的活动及过程。
senses.en_definition: The activity or process of making or manufacturing something.
senses.ms_definition: Kegiatan, usaha atau proses menghasilkan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 词包所载的核心义，可涵盖手工制作与工业制造；强调制作过程。pembuat 指制作者，buatan 可指制成品或制造属性，三者不可任意替换。

senses.zh_definition: 制造业；以加工和制造产品为主要活动的产业领域。
senses.en_definition: Manufacturing as an industrial sector.
senses.ms_definition: Bidang perindustrian yang tertumpu pada penghasilan barangan.
senses.nuances: 这是制作义在经济领域中的专门用法，通常见于 sektor pembuatan 或 industri pembuatan；可以指整个行业，而非某一次生产活动。[DBP：pembuatan 的专业用法](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pembuatan)

etymology.historical_story: Pembuatan shows how Malay builds an abstract process noun around the everyday verb buat, meaning to make or do. The same family distinguishes making, the maker and what is made. Its industrial use brings this ordinary vocabulary into factories and economic reports, while phrases about making cakes or furniture preserve its accessible everyday connection.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 围着 buat“做”记一家：pembuat 是做的人，pembuatan 是做的过程，buatan 是做出来的东西或制造属性。

morphology.pattern_note: 数学词 plus 是无马来语词缀的独立词；高速公路专名 PLUS 由名称首字母组成，通常整体读作 /plus/。二者同形而来源、大小写和语义不同。

senses.zh_definition: PLUS：Projek Lebuhraya Utara Selatan 的首字母缩略名；在马来西亚交通语境中常指相关高速公路或其运营机构。
senses.en_definition: PLUS, the acronym for Projek Lebuhraya Utara Selatan, also used for the associated expressways or their operator.
senses.ms_definition: Akronim bagi Projek Lebuhraya Utara Selatan.

senses.zh_definition: 加；加上。置于两个数之间，表示将它们相加。
senses.en_definition: With the following number added; used between numbers to express addition.
senses.ms_definition: Tambah; campur.
senses.nuances: 如 dua plus tiga，表示二加三。此处按连接两个运算项的介词性功能标注；DBP 原条目给出数学领域标记及释义，未明确标注这一词类。正式马来语教学常用 tambah 或 campur。[DBP：plus](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150324&keyword=plus)；[Cambridge：plus](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/plus)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报：交通通告
dual_scenarios.ms: Pengguna lebuh raya PLUS dinasihatkan supaya merancang perjalanan lebih awal bagi mengelakkan kesesakan semasa musim perayaan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 建议 PLUS 高速公路使用者提早规划行程，以避开节日期间的交通拥堵。
dual_scenarios.en: PLUS expressway users are advised to plan their journeys ahead to avoid congestion during the festive season.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流：讨论回乡路线
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Esok nak balik kampung ikut PLUS ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu hendak pulang ke kampung melalui lebuh raya PLUS esok?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你明天回乡是走 PLUS 高速吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Are you taking PLUS back to your hometown tomorrow?
spoken_features: nak 对应 hendak；balik 对应 pulang。
ikut PLUS 是口语中的路线表达，标准表达可用 melalui lebuh raya PLUS。
句末 ke 是疑问标记；je 对应 sahaja。
lah 在回复中加强决定的语气。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Esok nak balik kampung ikut PLUS ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu hendak pulang ke kampung melalui lebuh raya PLUS esok?
messages.zh: 你明天回乡走 PLUS 高速吗？
messages.en: Are you taking PLUS back to your hometown tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Farid (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Haah, ikut PLUS je. Kita gerak awal lah, takut sesak nanti.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, kita melalui lebuh raya PLUS sahaja. Kita bertolak awal kerana bimbang akan berlaku kesesakan nanti.
messages.zh: 对，就走 PLUS。我们早点出发吧，怕到时堵车。
messages.en: Yes, we’ll just take PLUS. Let’s leave early in case traffic gets heavy.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 交通语境中的 PLUS 是中性专名，正式文件使用大写。讲解数学时，tambah 或 campur 通常比直接使用英语读法更清楚。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 马来西亚口语中的 naik PLUS 或 ikut PLUS 通常是在谈高速公路路线。询问当前拥堵、收费或服务情况时，应另查即时资料，不能从词义推断。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 交通语境中的 PLUS 是中性专名，正式文件使用大写。讲解数学时，tambah 或 campur 通常比直接使用英语读法更清楚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 马来西亚口语中的 naik PLUS 或 ikut PLUS 通常是在谈高速公路路线。询问当前拥堵、收费或服务情况时，应另查即时资料，不能从词义推断。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries distinguish lowercase mathematical plus from uppercase PLUS. The mathematical word belongs to the international vocabulary of addition. The road name is an acronym formed from Projek Lebuhraya Utara Selatan. For Malaysian travellers, it also functions as a familiar route name in everyday speech. Its historical expansion should be distinguished from the names of the companies operating the network today. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150324&keyword=plus)；[PLUS](https://www.plus.com.my/ms/plus-malaysia-berhad/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 小写 plus 看见“+”；大写 PLUS 想到四个首字母 P-L-U-S 和回乡高速公路。大小写帮助分义。

morphology.pattern_note: 输入把 petik 解析为 tik 的派生词，缺乏此处规范构词依据，故更正为完整词干 petik。meN- 接词首 p 时，鼻音同化为 m，p 脱落：memetik；peN- 派生 pemetik 同理。末尾 k 在常见马来西亚读音中实现为 [ʔ]。参见 [DBP：petik 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=petik)。

senses.zh_definition: 从枝梗上摘取果实、花朵、嫩叶等。
senses.en_definition: To pick fruit, flowers, or shoots from their stalks.
senses.ms_definition: Mengambil buah, bunga atau pucuk dengan memisahkannya daripada tangkai.
senses.nuances: 正式主动陈述通常用 memetik；祈使句、部分被动结构及口语可用 petik。强调摘下，不能泛指从桌上拿取东西。

senses.zh_definition: 从文章、讲话或其他材料中摘取并引用一部分内容。

senses.ms_definition: Mengambil sebahagian teks atau ujaran untuk dipetik semula sebagai rujukan.
senses.nuances: 与 mengutip、menukil 近义；引用内容应忠于原文。petikan 是相应的名词“摘录、节选”，不与动词 petik 混用。

senses.en_definition: To pull a trigger or draw a bowstring.
senses.ms_definition: Menarik picu atau tali busur dengan jari.

senses.en_definition: To snap one's fingers.
senses.ms_definition: Menggesekkan jari dengan ibu jari hingga berbunyi.
senses.nuances: 不是折响指关节。

senses.zh_definition: 按动或拨动电器开关。
senses.en_definition: To operate an electrical switch.
senses.ms_definition: Menggerakkan suis untuk mengendalikan peralatan elektrik.
senses.nuances: 当代也常说 menekan suis。

senses.zh_definition: 用两根手指捻弄胡须。
senses.en_definition: To twirl a moustache between two fingers.
senses.ms_definition: Memintal misai dengan dua jari.
senses.nuances: 较少见的叙事用法；以下是典型组合，并非高频日常搭配。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Sila petik kenyataan daripada laporan asal dengan tepat dan nyatakan sumbernya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 请准确引用原报告中的声明，并注明来源。
dual_scenarios.en: Please quote the statement from the original report accurately and identify the source.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Mangga kat belakang tu dah masak ke? Nak petik dua biji je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah mangga di belakang itu sudah masak? Saya mahu memetik dua biji sahaja.

dual_scenarios.en: Are the mangoes out back ripe yet? I just want to pick two.
spoken_features: kat、tu、dah 分别对应 di、itu、sudah。
句末 ke 构成口语疑问。
nak 和 je 分别对应 mahu 和 sahaja。
口语主动句可用 petik，标准主动句通常用 memetik。
biji 是此处用于计算芒果的量词。

messages.speaker: Farah (邻居)
messages.ms_spoken: Mangga kat belakang tu dah masak ke? Nak petik dua biji je.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah mangga di belakang itu sudah masak? Saya mahu memetik dua biji sahaja.
messages.zh: 后面那棵树上的芒果熟了吗？我就想摘两个。
messages.en: Are the mangoes out back ripe yet? I just want to pick two.

messages.speaker: Amir (果树主人)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, petik je yang kuning tu. Yang hijau tinggal dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, mangga itu sudah masak. Petiklah yang kuning sahaja dan biarkan yang hijau dahulu.
messages.zh: 熟了，摘黄色的就行。绿色的先留着。
messages.en: Yes, they are. Go ahead and pick the yellow ones. Leave the green ones for now.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Petik 可以构成直接指令；向不熟悉的人提出请求时，用 Tolong petik… 或 Boleh tolong petik…? 更客气。不要用打响指的动作招呼服务人员，容易显得不尊重。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 摘取别人种植的花果前应先征得同意。学术或新闻引用应注明来源并保留原意；引用宗教经文时尤其应核对文字与出处。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Petik 可以构成直接指令；向不熟悉的人提出请求时，用 Tolong petik… 或 Boleh tolong petik…? 更客气。不要用打响指的动作招呼服务人员，容易显得不尊重。

etymology.historical_story: For learning, petik offers a memorable connection between taking fruit from a branch and taking words from a passage. Both involve selecting something from a larger whole. This is a semantic memory aid, not proof that one meaning historically developed before the other. The supplied evidence does not establish a dated origin or justify splitting the word into pe- and tik.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 同一个“摘”：从枝上摘果，从文中摘句；再想象手指拨一下琴弦，串起 petik 的常用动作义。

morphology.pattern_note: -kan 使形容词 penuh 获得“使其变满”的及物动词功能；词根无音变。penuhkan 可用于祈使句，主动陈述通常用 memenuhkan。输入 Jawi ڤنوه 是词根，完整形式应为 ڤنوهکن。

senses.zh_definition: 把容器或空间装满、填满，使其达到满的状态；常用于指示或请求。
senses.en_definition: To fill a container or space completely; make full, especially in an instruction or request.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan sesuatu penuh dengan mengisinya; bentuk yang digunakan, antaranya, dalam ayat perintah bagi memenuhkan.
senses.nuances: 宾语通常是被填满的容器或空间，如 botol、baldi、tangki。Sila penuhkan botol ini 是规范祈使结构；主动陈述可用 Dia memenuhkan botol itu。不要把 memenuhi 的“履行承诺、满足条件”等义项全部移植到 penuhkan。释义根据 [DBP：memenuhkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=memenuhkan) 综合表述。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Sila penuhkan tangki simpanan dengan air bersih sebelum kerja penyelenggaraan dimulakan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 请在维修工作开始前，将储水箱注满清水。
dual_scenarios.en: Please fill the storage tank with clean water before maintenance work begins.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tolong penuhkan botol aku sekali, ya. Aku nak keluar dah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Tolong penuhkan botol aku juga. Aku sudah hendak keluar.
dual_scenarios.zh: 也帮我把水瓶装满啊，我要出门了。
dual_scenarios.en: Could you fill my bottle too? I'm about to head out.
spoken_features: sekali 在这里表示“也一并”，对应 juga。
nak 是 hendak 的口语形式。
句末 dah 表示动作即将发生；ya 缓和请求。

messages.speaker: Amir (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tolong penuhkan botol aku sekali, ya. Aku nak keluar dah.
messages.ms_standard: Tolong penuhkan botol aku juga. Aku sudah hendak keluar.
messages.zh: 也帮我把水瓶装满啊，我要出门了。

messages.ms_standard: Boleh, letakkan sahaja di atas meja. Aku akan mengisinya sekarang.
messages.zh: 行，放桌上就好，我现在装。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说 Penuhkan! 容易像命令。服务场合或请求同事帮忙时，可加 tolong、sila 或 boleh，例如 Boleh tolong penuhkan botol ini?
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于加水、加油或填满空间。若指填写表格，通常说 isi borang 或 lengkapkan borang；若指履行承诺，通常说 menunaikan janji 或 memenuhi janji。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接说 Penuhkan! 容易像命令。服务场合或请求同事帮忙时，可加 tolong、sila 或 boleh，例如 Boleh tolong penuhkan botol ini?
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于加水、加油或填满空间。若指填写表格，通常说 isi borang 或 lengkapkan borang；若指履行承诺，通常说 menunaikan janji 或 memenuhi janji。

etymology.historical_story: Penuhkan shows a productive Malay way of turning a state into an action: penuh describes fullness, while -kan asks someone to bring that state about. DBP defines memenuhkan through this same result. A bucket and water make the distinction visible: the bucket becomes penuh after someone acts to fill it. Source: [DBP: memenuhkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=memenuhkan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: penuh＝满，-kan＝使它如此：penuhkan 就是“让它满起来”。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为整体词根使用，分为 pub.lik 两个音节；不把 pub- 或 -lik 分析为马来语词缀。没有据此确认的常用马来语派生词，故词族留空。

senses.zh_definition: 公众；一般社会大众。
senses.en_definition: The public; people in general.
senses.ms_definition: Orang ramai atau masyarakat umum.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录此义，但其语言咨询说明，马来西亚和文莱通常使用 orang awam 或 awam，publik 在印度尼西亚更常见。学习时应区分“词典收录”与“本地最常用表达”。参见 [DBP：publik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=publik)。

senses.zh_definition: 与公众有关的；面向公众或对公众开放的。
senses.en_definition: Public; relating to or open to the general public.
senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan orang ramai atau terbuka kepada umum.
senses.nuances: 作名词后面的修饰语，表示公共属性。相关搭配在印度尼西亚语境尤其常见；马来西亚通常更自然地说 ruang awam、kemudahan awam 或 terbuka kepada umum。此义依据 [DBP：publik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=publik)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Kenyataan syarikat itu telah menarik perhatian publik dan mendapat liputan meluas dalam media.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该公司的声明引起了公众关注，并获得媒体广泛报道。
dual_scenarios.en: The company's statement attracted public attention and received extensive media coverage.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dalam artikel tu, publik maksudnya orang ramai je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Dalam artikel itu, publik bermaksud orang ramai sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那篇文章里的 publik 就是“公众”的意思。
dual_scenarios.en: In that article, publik just means the public.
spoken_features: tu 和 je 分别对应 itu 和 sahaja。
maksudnya 用于随意解释词义，标准对应形式可用 bermaksud。
对话以解释阅读材料中的词语为背景，符合 publik 在马来西亚日常交流中较不常用的特点。

messages.speaker: Mei (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah baca artikel tu, tapi publik tu maksudnya apa?
messages.ms_standard: Aku sudah membaca artikel itu, tetapi apakah maksud perkataan publik?
messages.zh: 那篇文章我看了，不过 publik 是什么意思？
messages.en: I've read the article, but what does publik mean?

messages.speaker: Farah (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Orang ramai je. Kat Malaysia, kita biasa sebut orang awam.
messages.ms_standard: Maksudnya orang ramai sahaja. Di Malaysia, kita biasanya menggunakan ungkapan orang awam.
messages.zh: 就是公众。我们在马来西亚一般说 orang awam。
messages.en: It just means the public. In Malaysia, we usually say orang awam.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 该词本身没有冒犯意味，但在马来西亚日常交流或面向本地公众的文件中，orang ramai、orang awam、awam 或 umum 往往更自然。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合阅读跨区域新闻、评论及印度尼西亚材料时识别。涉及官方机构或服务名称，应采用该机构认可的马来语名称，不自行把 awam 全部替换成 publik。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 该词本身没有冒犯意味，但在马来西亚日常交流或面向本地公众的文件中，orang ramai、orang awam、awam 或 umum 往往更自然。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合阅读跨区域新闻、评论及印度尼西亚材料时识别。涉及官方机构或服务名称，应采用该机构认可的马来语名称，不自行把 awam 全部替换成 publik。

etymology.historical_story: Publik offers a useful lesson in regional vocabulary. A word can appear in Kamus Dewan yet remain less usual in Malaysian conversation. DBP explicitly contrasts its frequent Indonesian use with Malaysian and Bruneian preferences for awam or orang awam. This documented regional difference is clearer than any borrowing route established by the supplied packet. Source: [DBP: publik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=publik).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 publik 与英语 public 配对：拼写相近，核心都围绕“公众、公共”。这是记忆联想，不据此断定直接借词来源。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节英语词，/ɪ/ 为英语短元音；不是马来语词根派生形式。以下词族均属英语构词。其标准马来语动物名称为 babi，不能因收录于英马双语词典而标为正式马来语词。

word_family.gloss: 贪吃的；贪婪或脏乱得像猪的，带贬义

senses.zh_definition: 英语“猪”；通常指家猪，在马来语混合对话中属于英语插入。
senses.en_definition: A pig: a stout-bodied mammal with a snout and cloven hooves, especially the domesticated animal.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang berpadanan dengan babi.
senses.nuances: DBP 将 pig 列在 Kamus Bahasa Inggeris 中，不能据此认定它是正式马来语词。以下搭配列出马来语对应表达；英语对应搭配分别为 pig farm 和 wild pig。[DBP：pig](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pig)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语贬称，指肮脏、贪吃或贪婪的人。
senses.en_definition: An insulting term for a dirty, greedy, or gluttonous person.
senses.ms_definition: Sebutan bahasa Inggeris yang menghina orang yang pengotor, tamak atau gelojoh.
senses.nuances: 属于英语侮辱性比喻，不能因英语插入马来语对话而减轻冒犯性。以下给出马来语释义搭配，英语栏保留对应英语表达。[DBP：pig](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pig)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语口语，指非常棘手、难做或令人厌烦的事情。
senses.en_definition: An unpleasant or exceptionally difficult task or thing.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris percakapan, sesuatu tugas atau perkara yang sangat susah atau menyusahkan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语口语义，不是马来语 pig 的独立义项。DBP 英马词典以 teruk betul 等表达转译；下列搭配为马来语对应说法。[DBP：pig](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pig)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语非正式用法，贪婪地大吃；常见于 pig oneself 或 pig out。
senses.en_definition: To eat greedily or excessively, especially in pig oneself or pig out.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris tidak formal, makan dengan lahap atau berlebihan.

etymology.historical_story: English pig continues Middle English pigge, originally referring to a young pig; its deeper origin remains uncertain. The meaning later broadened to pigs of any age. In this Malay-focused entry, its English identity matters: DBP supplies Malay equivalents through its English–Malay dictionary, while the ordinary Malay name of the animal is babi. [Sources: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/pig), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pig).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 两种语言各记一个标签：英语 pig ↔ 马来语 babi ↔ 中文“猪”；小猪则是 piglet ↔ anak babi。

word_family.gloss: 他／她的电影院；所指的电影院

senses.nuances: 指放映场所，不指电影作品本身；一部电影是 sebuah filem，一家电影院是 sebuah pawagam。日常交流也常用 panggung wayang，或用 tengok wayang 表示去看电影。

etymology.historical_story: Pawagam compresses panggung wayang gambar into a single pronounceable word: pa, wa, and gam. Its formation illustrates a Malay acronym tradition that combines meaningful pieces of longer expressions. The result functions as an everyday noun, allowing speakers to name the film-screening venue without repeating the full phrase. [DBP discussion of Malay acronym formation](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/khidmatsms.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 三个声音对应三个词：PA＝panggung，WA＝wayang，GAM＝gambar；把“放电影的场所”压缩起来，就是 pawagam。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 遇到以元音 a 开头的词根，采用 peng- 形式；词根 anut 保持完整，ng 表示单个鼻音 /ŋ/。所给音节 pe.nga.nut 中的 e 读 /ə/。

word_family.gloss: 信奉宗教；持有某种学说
所信奉的宗教、学说或信念

senses.zh_definition: 某一宗教的信徒或信奉者。
senses.en_definition: An adherent or follower of a religion.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang memeluk atau menganut sesuatu agama.
senses.nuances: 核心是宗教归属，不必然表示虔诚程度，也不等同于宗教领袖。可直接接宗教名称，如 penganut Buddha，也可加 agama，如 penganut agama Buddha。

senses.zh_definition: 某种学说、思想或流派的信奉者。
senses.en_definition: An adherent of a doctrine, ideology, or school of thought.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mengikuti atau berpegang pada sesuatu ajaran, fahaman atau aliran.
senses.nuances: 常用于思想、理论或学术讨论。强调认同某套思想，不宜直接用于表示社交媒体关注者；后者通常称 pengikut。pengikut 比 penganut 的适用范围更广，见[DBP：pengikut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pengikut)。

etymology.historical_story: Penganut is transparently built from anut with the Malay person-forming prefix peN-. Before the initial vowel, the prefix takes the form peng-. The same root appears in menganut and anutan, linking the person, the act of adherence, and the belief followed. Its religious and intellectual senses share the idea of committed following.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把三词连起来：menganut＝信奉，penganut＝信奉的人，anutan＝所信奉的内容；peN- 给 anut 加上“人”的身份。

morphology.formula: ∅ + price → price（英语整词；马来语对应 harga）
morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语词，不应分析为马来语派生词。单音节，末尾 e 不单独发音；原包的 sst 不是其音节划分，已校正。以下词族属于英语。

senses.zh_definition: 价格；购买商品或服务所需支付的金额。
senses.en_definition: The amount of money asked or paid for goods or services.
senses.ms_definition: Harga, iaitu jumlah wang yang diminta atau dibayar untuk memperoleh barang atau perkhidmatan.
senses.nuances: price 是英语；在马来语交谈中出现时属于语码转换，规范马来语用 harga。本条保留指定的 official 状态值，但该值不表示 price 已获认定为标准马来语词。以下含 price 的搭配属于混合语表达。参见 [Cambridge：price](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/learner-english/price)。

senses.zh_definition: 为获得某种结果而付出的代价，尤指损失、牺牲或不利后果。
senses.en_definition: A loss, sacrifice or adverse consequence incurred in obtaining something.
senses.ms_definition: Pengorbanan, kerugian atau akibat buruk yang ditanggung untuk memperoleh sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是英语的比喻义。马来语通常用 harga 或 pengorbanan，并依语境明确所付出的代价；以下搭配采用标准马来语对应表达。参见 [Cambridge：price](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/learner-english/price)。

senses.zh_definition: 给商品或服务定价、标价。
senses.en_definition: To assign or state a selling price for goods or services.
senses.ms_definition: Menentukan atau menyatakan harga jualan sesuatu barang atau perkhidmatan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语及物动词用法，不是马来语本土词缀构成的动词。标准马来语采用 menetapkan harga 或 meletakkan harga；以下列其马来语对应搭配。参见 [DBP：price 的动词释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pricing)。

senses.zh_definition: 了解、查询商品的价格。
senses.en_definition: To find out how much something costs.
senses.ms_definition: Mendapatkan maklumat tentang harga sesuatu barang sebelum membuat keputusan pembelian.
senses.nuances: 这是英语用法；在马来语中应按语境译为 meninjau harga、menyemak harga 或 bertanya tentang harga。参见 [DBP：price 的动词释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pricing)。

senses.zh_definition: 估计某物的价格或价值。
senses.en_definition: To estimate the monetary value of something.
senses.ms_definition: Menganggarkan nilai wang atau harga yang sesuai bagi sesuatu barang.
senses.nuances: 这是英语估价义，不一定涉及最终售价。马来语可用 menganggarkan harga 或 menaksir nilai。参见 [DBP：price 的动词释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pricing)。

etymology.historical_story: English price came through Middle English pris and Anglo-French from Latin pretium, meaning price or money. Its history connects a market payment with the broader idea of value. In a Malay learning context, however, it must remain identifiable as English: the standard Malay counterpart for an ordinary selling price is harga. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/price)

messages.ms_standard: Saya masih bersedih atas pemergian ayah. Kadang-kadang saya berasa seolah-olah beliau masih berada di rumah.
messages.zh: 爸爸走了，我还是很难过。有时总觉得他还在家里。
messages.en: I'm still grieving for Dad. Sometimes it feels like he's still at home.

messages.speaker: Mei (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tak apa kalau belum bersedia nak cerita. Aku dah kosongkan petang ni, boleh teman kau.
messages.ms_standard: Tidak mengapa jika kamu belum bersedia untuk bercerita. Saya sudah melapangkan masa petang ini dan boleh menemani kamu.
messages.zh: 还没准备好说也没关系。我今天下午已经腾出时间了，可以陪你。
messages.en: It's okay if you're not ready to talk. I've cleared this afternoon so I can keep you company.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 悼念时可说 Takziah atas pemergian ayah anda。提及亡者宜使用符合其宗教与身份的称谓，不凭姓名猜测宗教。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: pemergian 在慰问中较委婉庄重；普通出差可用 perjalanan 或直接用 pergi，以免产生悼亡联想。涉及王室出行时，应按礼仪使用 keberangkatan 等适当用语。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 悼念时可说 Takziah atas pemergian ayah anda。提及亡者宜使用符合其宗教与身份的称谓，不凭姓名猜测宗教。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: pemergian 在慰问中较委婉庄重；普通出差可用 perjalanan 或直接用 pergi，以免产生悼亡联想。涉及王室出行时，应按礼仪使用 keberangkatan 等适当用语。

etymology.historical_story: Pemergian is formed from pergi, meaning to go, through Malay noun formation. Its literal meanings concern journeys and departures. In remembrance and condolence language, departure also becomes a gentle image for death. DBP's usage advice recognises pemergian in commemorating P. Ramlee, illustrating how an ordinary movement word can express shared grief respectfully. [DBP usage advice](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pemergian).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pergi 是“走”，pemergian 把“走”变成“离去这件事”；悼念时，就是温柔地说一个人“走了”。

morphology.pattern_note: 实际构词基词为 selidik（سليديق）；root_word 与 root_jawi 按词包保留。peN- 遇词首 s 时变为 peny-，原 s 脱落；ny 表示 /ɲ/，词尾 k 通常读 /ʔ/。

senses.zh_definition: 对某个课题或对象进行认真、深入研究或调查的人；研究人员。
senses.en_definition: A person who studies or investigates a subject thoroughly; a researcher.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang menyelidiki atau mempelajari sesuatu dengan sungguh-sungguh.
senses.nuances: 现代常用于大学、科研机构、社会调查及其他研究工作；不限定为实验室科学家，也不自动表示教授或博士身份。

collocations.zh: 首席研究员；项目主要研究负责人

senses.zh_definition: 侦察或秘密搜集敌情的人；侦察员或探子。
senses.en_definition: A scout or spy who gathers information, especially about an enemy.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mengintip atau menyuluh untuk mendapatkan maklumat tentang musuh.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录的另一义项，常须靠军事、历史或叙事语境辨认。现代一般语境首先理解为研究人员；明确表达间谍时，pengintip 更直接。

tu 是 itu 的口语缩略形式。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: penyelidik 是职业或工作角色，不是敬称。正式介绍时可说 penyelidik utama；只有确认对方拥有相应头衔时才使用 Dr. 或 Profesor。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 科研、访谈和调查场合使用自然。不要因为词典另收“探子”义，就在普通交流中把研究人员称作间谍；该义必须由明确语境支持。

etymology.historical_story: Penyelidik is formed from selidik with the Malay agent prefix peN-. The initial s is replaced by the nasal sound written ny. Kamus Dewan records both a serious investigator and a scout or spy, even using Raja Ali Haji as an example of a careful researcher. The meanings share the activity of seeking information closely and deliberately. [Kamus Dewan via DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=373700&keyword=selidik)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: selidik 是仔细查究；peN- 给动作配上“做这件事的人”：penyelidik 就是研究的人。

morphology.pattern_note: 实际构词基词为 pantau；root_word 与 root_jawi 按词包保留。peN- 遇词首 p 时变为 pem-，原 p 脱落；词尾 au 通常为双元音 /aw/。

senses.zh_definition: 持续观察、检查某项活动或情况的人、组织或相关单位；监督人员或观察员。
senses.en_definition: A person or body that monitors an activity, development or situation.
senses.ms_definition: Orang atau pihak yang memantau.
senses.nuances: 重点在持续观察、检查与记录；是否具有执法、处分或指挥权，取决于具体职务，词本身不赋予这些权限。

senses.zh_definition: 用于持续观察、测量或追踪某项状况的监测仪器或装置。
senses.en_definition: A device used to monitor a condition, process or activity.
senses.ms_definition: Alat yang digunakan untuk memantau.
senses.nuances: 可用于医疗、环境或设备运行等语境。这里的 monitor 表示监测设备；普通电脑显示器通常称 monitor 或 skrin，不宜一概译作 pemantau。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: pemantau 是中性的职责名称。与监督人员交谈时，可依实际身份使用 Encik、Puan 或职称；不能仅凭该词判断对方拥有执法权。

etymology.historical_story: Pemantau is formed from pantau with peN-, a Malay prefix that can name either a person performing an activity or an instrument used for it. The dictionary records both a monitoring party and a monitoring device. This pairing explains why a project observer and a cardiac monitor share one word: both keep watch over a changing situation. [Kamus Dewan via DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pemantau)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pantau 是盯着情况看；加 peN- 后，就是负责监看的人，或替你持续监看的仪器。

morphology.pattern_note: 原包将 penukaran 标作词根，现按实际构词更正为 tukar。peN- 接 /t/ 开头的 tukar 时，N 实现为 /n/，词根首音 /t/ 脱落，形成 penukar-，再接 -an。DBP 亦将本词列为 tukar 的派生词，见 [DBP：penukaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=penukaran)。

word_family.gloss: 把某物换成另一物；转换
转换器；进行兑换的人或机构

senses.zh_definition: 更换；替换；将原有物品或人员换成另一物品或人员的行为或过程。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of replacing one thing or person with another.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan menggantikan sesuatu atau seseorang dengan yang lain.
senses.nuances: 强调 menukar 或 menukarkan 所表达的更换行为。与 penggantian 有重叠；涉及双方互换、意见交流或员工调任时，pertukaran 往往更惯用。

senses.zh_definition: 转换；变更；把某物的形式、用途、名称或其他属性改成另一种状态。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of changing something into a different form, use, or state.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan mengubah bentuk, kegunaan, nama atau keadaan sesuatu kepada yang lain.
senses.nuances: 常用于行政手续、技术转换及资料变更。不是所有 perubahan 都适合改为 penukaran；后者通常涉及可指出的原状态与新状态。

senses.zh_definition: 兑换；将一种货币或可兑换价值换成另一种。
senses.en_definition: The conversion or exchange of one currency or redeemable form of value into another.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan menukar sesuatu mata wang atau nilai yang boleh ditebus kepada mata wang atau bentuk nilai yang lain.
senses.nuances: penukaran mata wang 着重兑换行为；询问汇率通常说 kadar pertukaran。讨论兑换金额时，应明确原货币和目标货币。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 属于中性而偏正式的手续用语，适合柜台咨询、公文和工作汇报。礼貌询问可说 Bolehkah saya memohon penukaran…?
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 日常聊天常直接用动词 tukar。员工调任、学生交流和意见交换通常用 pertukaran；零件、卡片、名称或格式的更换则常用 penukaran。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于中性而偏正式的手续用语，适合柜台咨询、公文和工作汇报。礼貌询问可说 Bolehkah saya memohon penukaran…?
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 日常聊天常直接用动词 tukar。员工调任、学生交流和意见交换通常用 pertukaran；零件、卡片、名称或格式的更换则常用 penukaran。

etymology.historical_story: Penukaran is a Malay formation built from tukar, rather than an indivisible root. The circumfix peN-...-an names an action or process, while nasal substitution removes the initial t of tukar. This structure links a concrete replacement, such as changing a tyre, with abstract operations such as converting a file format or exchanging currency.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tukar＝换；peN-...-an 把“换”变成“更换这件事”。记住 t 被 n 替代：tukar → penukaran。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根首音 s 在鼻音替换中脱落，peN- 实现为 peny-；词根末尾 a 与后缀 -an 的 a 分属两个音节。

senses.zh_definition: 参加或参与某项活动、计划、比赛等的行为；在征集或比赛语境中，也可指提交的参赛报名或作品。
senses.en_definition: Participation in an activity, programme, or competition; contextually, an entry submitted to a competition.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan menyertai atau menyertakan.
senses.nuances: 强调参与行为，而 peserta 指参与的人。hantar penyertaan 在比赛语境中可理解为提交参赛材料。核心释义见 [DBP：penyertaan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penyertaan)。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适用于正式通知和日常交流；向公众发出邀请时，欢迎式表达如 Kami mengalu-alukan penyertaan tuan/puan 较为得体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: sijil penyertaan 证明参加过活动，本身不表示获奖、通过考试或取得专业资格。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 适用于正式通知和日常交流；向公众发出邀请时，欢迎式表达如 Kami mengalu-alukan penyertaan tuan/puan 较为得体。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: sijil penyertaan 证明参加过活动，本身不表示获奖、通过考试或取得专业资格。

etymology.historical_story: Penyertaan belongs to the Malay word family built around serta, associated with joining or being together. The circumfix peN-...-an turns this base into a noun naming participation. Its connection with menyertai remains transparent in modern Malay. On competition notices, application forms, and certificates, the word presents joining an activity as a formally recognized act.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serta 记成“一起加入”：menyertai 是“参加”，penyertaan 是“参加这件事”，peserta 是“参加的人”。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在元音 i 前采用 peng-，词基 ikat 不变。is_root 按实际构词校正；root_word 和 root_jawi 依要求保留输入包标签，实际词基为 ikat。

senses.zh_definition: 用于捆扎、系紧或固定物件的东西，如绳、带或束具。
senses.en_definition: An object or material used to tie, bind, or secure something.
senses.ms_definition: Alat seperti tali atau benda lain yang digunakan untuk mengikat.

senses.en_definition: A person who ties or binds something.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mengikat.

senses.zh_definition: 维系情感、友谊或其他人际关系的纽带或象征。

senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang mengikat perhubungan seperti persahabatan, pertunangan atau kasih sayang.
senses.nuances: 比喻义，常用于感情、婚约或团结的表达。pengikat kasih 强调维系感情，不必然表示法律义务。

etymology.historical_story: Pengikat is transparently formed from ikat, meaning to tie, with the noun-forming prefix peN-. Its dictionary meanings connect physical binding with human relationships: a cord holds a parcel together, while a symbolic object can hold affection together. This is a documented semantic relationship, rather than evidence for a particular ancient ceremony. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=pengikat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 pe-ngi-kat，抓住 ikat＝绑：pengikat 就是绑东西的物件、绑东西的人，或把感情系在一起的纽带。

word_family.gloss: 多位神父或随军教士；英语复数

senses.zh_definition: 基督教教士，尤指神父；也可用作对教士的称呼。
senses.en_definition: A Christian clergyman, especially a priest, sometimes addressed by this title.
senses.ms_definition: Paderi; padanan bahasa Melayu bagi kata bahasa Inggeris padre dalam penggunaan percakapan.
senses.nuances: DBP 将 padre 收在英马词典一侧，马来语对应词为 paderi；不应据此认定 padre 是规范马来语词形。status 沿用请求指定的条目状态，不表示 DBP 对其马来语身份的认证。ms 搭配列标准马来语对应表达。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=paderi)

senses.zh_definition: 在军队中提供基督教宗教服务及牧灵关怀的随军教士。
senses.en_definition: A Christian military chaplain.
senses.ms_definition: Paderi tentera.
senses.nuances: 英语军队语境中的常见称呼，不必然专指天主教神父。马来语正式叙述宜明确使用 paderi tentera。[Oxford 释义与读音](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/padre)

etymology.historical_story: English padre is recorded from 1584 and comes from Spanish, Italian, or Portuguese forms meaning father, ultimately from Latin pater. The family relationship became a religious title for a spiritual father. English also uses the word for military chaplains. DBP distinguishes the English headword padre from its Malay equivalent paderi. [Merriam-Webster history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/padre) [DBP equivalents](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=paderi)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语读音近似“帕德雷”；把 pa 联想到爸爸，再联想到称作 Father 的神父。这是记忆联想，不是马来语拆词。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入包及现代学习用途作整体词基处理；首音节 pe 读 /pə/，不因外形相似就机械拆成 pe- + sisir。

etymology.historical_story: Pesisir names more than a physical shoreline in regional cultural writing. DBP’s encyclopedia associates coastal civilization with the spice trade from the fourteenth to eighteenth centuries, when maritime communities maintained international connections. That history explains the word’s cultural resonance, but does not establish its ultimate linguistic origin or justify deriving it mechanically from sisir. [DBP cultural account](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=pesisir)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 pe-si-sir，想象 si-sir 像细沙摩擦的声音：眼前是一条平坦、多沙的海岸。声音联想仅用于记忆。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 接以 s 开头的词根时，通常实现为 peny-，词根首音 s 脱落：samar → penyamar。输入将 penyamar 判为词根，此处依据构词关系修正。

word_family.gloss: 乔装或掩饰身份的行为

senses.zh_definition: 通过改变外貌、服装或身份表现来隐藏真实身份的人；乔装者或冒充者。
senses.en_definition: A person who conceals their identity through disguise or pretends to be someone else.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang menyamar.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 所释的施事名词。可指冒充警察、医生等身份的骗子，也可指执行任务的乔装人员；是否涉及犯罪须由上下文判断。它本身不等于“间谍”，也不泛指所有演员或模仿表演者。释义依据 [PRPM：penyamar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=penyamar)。

collocations.en: a person posing as a doctor

dual_scenarios.ms: Polis menahan seorang penyamar yang mengaku sebagai pegawai bank untuk mendapatkan maklumat peribadi mangsa.
dual_scenarios.zh: 警方拘捕了一名冒充银行职员、企图获取受害者个人资料的人。
dual_scenarios.en: Police detained an impostor who posed as a bank officer to obtain the victim's personal information.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dia tu penyamar ke? Asyik nak minta nombor kad aku je.

句末 ke 标记口语疑问。
nak 和 je 分别对应 hendak 或 mahu，以及 sahaja。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ada orang kat luar mengaku pegawai bank. Dia penyamar ke?
messages.ms_standard: Ada seseorang di luar yang mengaku sebagai pegawai bank. Adakah dia seorang penyamar?
messages.zh: 外面有人自称是银行职员。他会不会是冒充的？
messages.en: Someone outside says they're a bank officer. Could they be an impostor?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum tahu lagi. Aku nak semak dengan bank dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Kita belum mengetahuinya. Saya mahu membuat semakan dengan pihak bank terlebih dahulu.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接称某人为 penyamar 可能构成严厉指控；身份尚未核实时，可说 disyaki menyamar，意为“涉嫌冒充或乔装”。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于身份核验、新闻报道、故事和安全提醒。警方乔装人员不宜一概译为骗子；冒充医生等语境则通常带明显贬义。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接称某人为 penyamar 可能构成严厉指控；身份尚未核实时，可说 disyaki menyamar，意为“涉嫌冒充或乔装”。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于身份核验、新闻报道、故事和安全提醒。警方乔装人员不宜一概译为骗子；冒充医生等语境则通常带明显贬义。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary family links samar, associated with indistinctness, to menyamar, hiding one's real identity, and penyamar, the person doing so. This creates a useful semantic bridge: someone becomes difficult to recognize because their identity is concealed. The nasal prefix also changes the initial s into the ny sequence. This explains present-day formation without asserting an unverified ancient borrowing. [PRPM：samar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132088&keyword=samar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: samar 是“模糊不清”；peN- 把动作关联到“人”：让真实身份模糊不清的人，就是 penyamar。ny 读 /ɲ/。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是第二人称代词的附着形式，此处表示“你的”，严格说属于后附着语素而非派生后缀；本模板以 suffix 容纳。它与前词连写，不引起词根音变。输入爪夷文仅写了词根，完整形式补为 ڤوڠݢوڠمو；音节和 IPA 为规则性补全。

word_family.gloss: 臀部；部分语境中的背部或物体背面

senses.zh_definition: 你的臀部；你的屁股。
senses.en_definition: Your buttocks or bottom.
senses.ms_definition: Punggung kamu, iaitu bahagian belakang badan antara pinggang dengan paha yang menjadi tempat bertumpu ketika duduk.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚日常语境中的默认理解是“你的臀部”，不宜不加判断地译成“你的背”。完整形式的释义由 DBP 的 punggung 释义与 -mu 的所属功能合成，并非独立词条原文。official 表示规范构形，不表示已核实存在独立收词。参见 [PRPM：punggung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=punggung) 及 [DBP 关于代词连写的说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kau+terima)。以下为自然搭配，未作频率排序。

senses.zh_definition: 你的背部；见于印度尼西亚语用法或相应文学语境。
senses.en_definition: Your back, especially in Indonesian usage or corresponding literary contexts.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian belakang badan kamu; berasaskan makna punggung yang ditandai sebagai penggunaan Indonesia dalam Kamus Dewan.
senses.nuances: Kamus Dewan 将词根的这一义项标为 Id，即印度尼西亚用法；不能当作马来西亚语境的唯一或默认解释。完整形式及以下搭配为组合性说明。词根另有山脊、物体背面或上面的延伸义，但不自动成为 punggungmu 的常用义项。来源：[PRPM：punggung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=punggung)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Jurulatih memberikan arahan, "Pastikan punggungmu kekal menyentuh tempat duduk sepanjang latihan ini."
dual_scenarios.zh: 教练指示：“在整个训练过程中，确保你的臀部始终贴着座位。”
dual_scenarios.en: The coach instructed, "Keep your buttocks in contact with the seat throughout this exercise."

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Punggungmu dah okey ke lepas jatuh tadi?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah punggungmu sudah pulih selepas kamu terjatuh tadi?
dual_scenarios.zh: 刚才摔了一下，你屁股好点了吗？

lepas 在这里对应 selepas。
-mu 在此带亲近或略显俏皮的语气；普通口语也常说 punggung awak 或 punggung kau，须配合双方关系。

messages.speaker: Farah (亲密朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Punggungmu dah okey ke? Tadi jatuh kuat juga tu.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah punggungmu sudah pulih? Kamu terjatuh dengan agak kuat tadi.
messages.zh: 你屁股好点了吗？刚才那一下摔得挺重的。
messages.en: Is your bottom feeling better? That was quite a fall.

messages.speaker: Amir (亲密朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Masih sakit sikit. Aku nak duduk atas kusyen je dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Punggung saya masih sedikit sakit. Buat sementara waktu, saya hanya mahu duduk di atas kusyen.
messages.zh: 还有点疼。我暂时只想坐软垫上。

etymology.historical_story: Punggungmu is a transparent grammatical combination, rather than a separate historical borrowing: punggung names a body region and -mu identifies its possessor as the addressee. Malay dictionary evidence also records extensions from the body to the backs or upper surfaces of objects. Those extensions illustrate how bodily orientation supplies vocabulary for describing the surrounding world. [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=punggung)

etymology.historical_story: Pena is generally traced to Portuguese pena, a word associated with feathers and writing pens. The connection recalls the quill: a feather prepared for writing with ink. In Malay, expressions such as mata pena and buah pena connect the physical instrument with literary work. Compare [ANU: European loanwords in Ambonese Malay](https://openresearch-repository.anu.edu.au/server/api/core/bitstreams/f663304d-f64e-4093-a2d3-7baa3e258033/content).

etymology.historical_story: The word centres on hakim, a judge or appointed adjudicator. Malay builds a wider vocabulary around this root: menghakimi names the act, penghakiman names judging or its outcome, and kehakiman concerns judicial affairs. This family shows how an established root becomes productive through Malay affixes rather than through a change of spelling alone. [DBP: hakim](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=hakim)

etymology.historical_story: Pelombong is transparently formed from lombong, meaning a mine, with the Malay agent-forming prefix peN-. In cryptocurrency discourse, the same word has acquired a technological extension: the resource being extracted is digital rather than mineral.

etymology.historical_story: Pythagoras is a Greek personal name carried into Malay through international historical and mathematical usage. The thinker came from Samos and established a community in southern Italy. Later traditions attached many mathematical achievements to him, but historians distinguish those traditions from secure evidence. Remembering that distinction keeps the familiar theorem from becoming an invented biography of its namesake. [Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy](https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/pythagoras/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 pi-ta-go-ras 时，联想写着 a² + b² = c² 的直角三角形：Pythagoras → 毕达哥拉斯 → 勾股定理。

senses.zh_definition: 追赶、追捕或追逐的行为，尤指为了赶上或抓获某人、某物而进行的追踪行动。
senses.en_definition: The act of chasing or pursuing someone or something, especially to catch them.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal (perbuatan) mengejar, pemburuan.
senses.nuances: 这是行为名词，强调追赶过程，不保证已经抓获目标；追捕成功应另用 penangkapan 表达。马来语释义引自《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》。[DBP：pengejaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pengejaran)

senses.zh_definition: 为取得某种成就、利益或地位而持续努力的追求。
senses.en_definition: The determined pursuit of an achievement, benefit, or position.
senses.ms_definition: Usaha yang bersungguh-sungguh untuk memperoleh atau mencapai sesuatu yang diingini.
senses.nuances: 这是 mengejar 比喻义的名词化用法，并非上述 DBP 条目另列的独立编号义项。常见于评论或论述；日常交流通常直接用 mengejar，具体语境也可用 usaha mencapai。

etymology.historical_story: Pengejaran belongs to the Malay family built on kejar, meaning to chase. Its noun pattern turns the action into a pursuit that can be described in police reports, stories, or discussions of ambition. The same concrete image of following a moving target also helps speakers describe pursuing wealth or status. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pengejaran)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 kejar＝追；peN-...-an 把动作装进名词框：pengejaran＝一场追逐。k 被 ng 接替。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留数据包的直接基底 perbaiki；最底层词根为 baik。-nya 是附着代词，作宾语时表示它、他或她，并非表示修理动作的派生后缀；这里按结构归入 suffix。ny 表示 /ɲ/。

senses.zh_definition: 把它修好、纠正或改善；由 perbaiki 加附着代词 -nya 构成，具体宾语依上下文确定。表达这一意义时，马来西亚规范用法通常改用 baikinya、membaikinya，或表示改善的 memperbaiknya。
senses.en_definition: Repair, correct, or improve it; perbaiki with the attached pronoun -nya, whose referent depends on context.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk perbaiki yang menerima kata ganti nama terikat -nya, dengan maksud membetulkan atau menjadikan sesuatu lebih baik; padanan baku Malaysia bergantung pada konteks, seperti baikinya, membaikinya atau memperbaiknya.
senses.nuances: 不可把输入形式直接认定为马来西亚规范的“修理它”。DBP 区分 membaiki（修理、纠正）与 memperbaik（使更好）；Kamus Dewan 另把 memperbaiki 的“善待”义标为旧用。当前条目解释输入形式通常意图表达的修理或改善义，马来语释义为综合说明，并非 DBP 原文。搭配和正式例句采用规范对应形式。[DBP：baik 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=baik+pulih%3B+membaik+pulih)

collocations.en: make an effort to improve it

etymology.historical_story: The underlying Malay word baik means good or well. Its derivatives connect goodness with restoring something damaged and making something better. Malaysian dictionaries distinguish membaiki, for repairing or correcting, from memperbaik, for improvement. Reading perbaikinya therefore requires attention to usage and sentence structure: the attached nya identifies a referent, while the verb supplies the intended action. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=baik+pulih%3B+membaik+pulih)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 baik＝好，-nya＝它／他／她：把它变好。马来西亚用法再分清：修好用 membaiki，改善用 memperbaik。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，不拆成马来语前缀 pro- 与词根 duksi；保留词首辅音群 /pr/。词族中的 pra-、pasca- 形式见区域及媒体用语，马来西亚规范对应词为 prapenerbitan、pascapenerbitan。[DBP 用语说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=produksi)

senses.ms_definition: Karya persembahan atau audiovisual yang telah dihasilkan, seperti drama, filem atau rancangan.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚媒体语境可见此用法；DBP 的英马词典也把 produksi 列为 production 的作品义对应词。此处马来文定义为编辑归纳，非逐字引用。[DBP：production 的作品义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pementasan)

senses.zh_definition: 影视、音频或舞台作品的制作工作及相关制作活动。
senses.en_definition: The work and activities involved in producing audiovisual or stage content.
senses.ms_definition: Kerja dan kegiatan menghasilkan kandungan audiovisual atau persembahan pentas.
senses.nuances: 这是实际媒体用语的编辑归纳，不是资料包中基本定义的逐字释义。马来西亚机构确有使用，但 DBP 在术语咨询中建议大众传播领域采用 penerbitan；正式文件应遵从所属机构术语表。[实际机构用法](https://pspk.upm.edu.my/faq?L=bm)、[DBP 术语建议](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=produksi)

etymology.historical_story: Produksi illustrates how a regional loanword can acquire different professional roles across neighbouring language communities. Kamus Dewan records it with the label IB and a definition referring to manufactured goods. Malaysian media usage also extends to production work and finished creative works. DBP's terminology advice nevertheless favours penerbitan in mass communication, showing that familiar usage and recommended terminology can differ. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=produksi)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: produksi 与英语 production 外形相近：想到“做出来的产品或作品”。写马来西亚正式文件时，再按语境选 pengeluaran 或 penerbitan。

morphology.formula: per- + daya + -kan → perdayakan; memperdayakan → perdayakan（祈使或特定被动结构中不带 mem-）
morphology.pattern_note: 输入把 perdayakan 标为词根，但 DBP 将 memperdayakan 收在 daya 词族下，故修正为派生形式。per- 与 -kan 均保留，daya 不发生首辅音脱落；这里的 daya 取“计谋、诡计”义。出处：[DBP：daya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=daya)。

senses.zh_definition: 用诡计、虚假说辞或误导手段欺骗、诱骗某人，使其信以为真或采取某种行动。
senses.en_definition: To deceive, trick or dupe someone through a ruse or misleading representations.
senses.ms_definition: Menjalankan tipu daya atau muslihat terhadap seseorang; menipu. Bentuk tanpa awalan mem- bagi memperdayakan dalam binaan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 依据 DBP 的 memperdaya／memperdayakan 综合释义。可见于 jangan kamu perdayakan… 这样的禁令，以及 mangsa yang kamu perdayakan 这样的第二人称被动结构。普通正式主动陈述用 memperdayakan，如 Dia memperdayakan mangsa。不是“赋能、增强能力”的意思。出处：[DBP：memperdaya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=memperdaya)。

etymology.historical_story: The clue lies in daya: besides strength and ability, DBP records senses involving ingenuity and deception. Memperdayakan belongs to that deceptive branch. DBP's learner dictionary illustrates the related memperdaya through Sang Kancil tricking other forest animals, linking the vocabulary to a familiar folktale setting. Perdayakan retains this meaning when used without mem- in suitable constructions. Sources: [daya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=daya), [memperdaya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=memperdaya).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 perdayakan 和 tipu daya“诡计”一起记：用 daya 的“诡计”义去对付别人，就是“诱骗别人”。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在元音 u 前变为 peng-，词根 udara 不删音；词尾 -a 与后缀 -an 的 a 分属两个音节，读作 ra.an。

senses.zh_definition: 通过空气流入、流出及更换，使室内或封闭空间保持空气流通的过程；通风、换气。
senses.en_definition: Ventilation: the supply and exchange of air in a room or enclosed space.
senses.ms_definition: Proses menggantikan udara di sesuatu ruang dengan udara lain.
senses.nuances: 建筑语境通常译为 ventilation。通风涉及空气交换，不等同于降温或单纯用风扇循环室内空气。马来西亚官方课程区分自然通风与其他通风方式，见 [政府 TVET：通风课程说明](https://mohon.tvet.gov.my/awam-kursus/kursus?id_kursus=12095)。

senses.zh_definition: 使空气进入土壤等介质的过程；通气、透气处理。
senses.en_definition: Aeration: the introduction or movement of air into a medium such as soil.
senses.ms_definition: Proses membolehkan udara masuk atau bergerak dalam sesuatu bahan, khususnya tanah.
senses.nuances: 农业和草坪养护语境中的 pengudaraan tanah 应译为 soil aeration，而不是房屋通风。马来西亚地方政府养护文件采用此用法，见 [吉打地方政府：草坪养护规范](https://pbt.kedah.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/DOKUMEN-SEBUTHARGA-MDBB-0.0261-2021.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Pengudaraan is built from udara, meaning air, with the noun-forming circumfix peN-...-an. The formation turns a substance into a process involving it. In Malaysian building language, that process is ventilation; in grounds maintenance, pengudaraan tanah means soil aeration. The shared image is air gaining access to a space or material.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 udara＝空气；peng-…-an 把它变成过程：让空气进出、更换，就是 pengudaraan。

word_family.gloss: 冒险者；为私利不择手段的人

senses.zh_definition: 漂泊、闯荡或冒险的经历与活动。
senses.en_definition: Adventure or the experience of wandering and undertaking ventures.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal bertualang.
senses.nuances: 多见于叙事、文学及冒险题材，可指令人兴奋或充满艰险的经历。表达普通旅行时，perjalanan 或 pengembaraan 往往更直接。

senses.zh_definition: 鲁莽冒进的行为，尤指涉及欺诈、不诚实等手段的冒险行径。
senses.en_definition: A reckless venture or undertaking, especially one involving dishonest conduct.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan nekad, tidak jujur dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 带批评意味，不能一律理解为值得赞赏的冒险精神；政治、商业等修饰语常使负面含义更加明显。

etymology.historical_story: Petualangan belongs to the tualang family, whose meanings connect wandering with venturing beyond familiar surroundings. Its semantic range also has a darker side: a venture may become reckless or dishonest. This explains why an adventure story and a criticism of political adventurism can use the same noun. Related meanings are documented in [DBP's petualang entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=75076&keyword=+petualang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tua-la-ngan 的连续音节想成一路走远：petualangan 是闯荡经历；遇到政治或欺诈语境，就想到冒险行径。此为联想，不是词源拆解。

etymology.historical_story: Perlombongan is formed from lombong with the Malay circumfix per-...-an. Its cultural resonance is especially strong in tin-mining history: official accounts of Kulim describe former miners arriving from Perak's mining districts and opening settlements. The word therefore connects an economic activity with the landscapes and communities that developed around mineral extraction. See [Kulim's official history](https://pbt.kedah.gov.my/index.php/info-kulim/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 lombong＝矿，再套上 per-...-an：从一个矿，联想到整套采矿活动或矿区。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，无须拆分马来语词缀；单音节，末尾 t 为塞音。没有可靠依据建立常用马来语派生词族。

etymology.historical_story: Pit preserves a trace of Dutch contact in the Indonesian archipelago. Dutch fiets, meaning bicycle, appears as pit in Javanese, illustrating how a borrowed word can acquire a different sound shape. The supplied Malay dictionary records this bicycle sense as archaic and Dutch-Indonesian in origin. The connection is documented in [Nicoline van der Sijs's account of fiets](https://www.dbnl.org/arch/sijs002klei01_01/pag/sijs002klei01_01.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把短促的 pit 想成脚踏板轻轻一点：旧词 pit＝自行车；现代马来西亚用 basikal。此联想不是词源解释。

morphology.formula: pasar + raya → pasar raya；pasaraya → pasar raya（拼写规范化）
morphology.pattern_note: 保留数据包的根词标记，但规范词 pasar raya 是复合词：pasar 表示市场，raya 表示大；raya 不是后缀。标准拼写分为两个词，IPA 对应规范形式。[DBP：复合词拼写](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pasar+II)

senses.zh_definition: 超级市场：采用顾客自选、柜台结账方式，出售食品及其他日常用品的大型零售商店；规范马来语拼写为 pasar raya。
senses.en_definition: A supermarket: a large self-service shop selling food and other everyday goods; the standard Malay spelling is pasar raya.
senses.ms_definition: Kedai besar yang menjual pelbagai makanan dan barang keperluan harian secara layan diri, dengan pembayaran di kaunter; ejaan bakunya ialah pasar raya.

etymology.historical_story: The standard expression pasar raya combines pasar, meaning market, with raya, meaning large or great. Together they name a particular kind of self-service retail shop rather than any market of considerable size. DBP treats the expression as a compound written in two words; the joined input pasaraya should therefore be normalized in ordinary formal writing.

etymology.historical_story: Pembroke corresponds to Welsh Penfro, a name associated with elements meaning head and region. A local historical account connects this name with the town's commanding position on a narrow limestone ridge. Its castle became a Norman stronghold, helping the settlement grow in importance. This is the history of a Welsh place name, not a Malay prefixed word. [Pembroke and Monkton Local History Society](https://www.pembrokeandmonktonhistory.org.uk/documents/pembrokeforweb.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作“PEM-bruuk”，脑中放一座威尔士城堡；看到 pem 也别拆成马来语前缀。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合娱乐报道、节目介绍以及表达慰藉。称同事为 penghibur 时应注意语气，避免让对方觉得其专业贡献只被当作逗乐。

etymology.historical_story: Penghibur belongs to the Malay word family built on hibur, meaning to cheer or comfort. Its prefix forms a noun for the person or thing providing that effect. Kamus Dewan records both a source of consolation and a professional entertainer, connecting private emotional comfort with public performance. No specific date of first use is established here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hibur 是“让人开心”；加 peN- 得 penghibur：带来开心的人或事物。舞台上是艺人，心里是慰藉。

etymology.historical_story: Penyelam illustrates a productive Malay way of naming a person through an activity. Its base selam concerns going underwater; the prefix peN- forms the corresponding agent noun. Before initial s, the prefix appears as peny- and the s disappears. The resulting word connects traditional underwater searching with modern recreational, scientific, commercial, and rescue diving.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把动作变成人：selam“潜水”＋peN-“做这件事的人”→ penyelam“潜水者”。记住 s 让位给 ny：不是 penselam，而是 penyelam。

morphology.formula: pengalih + -an → pengalihan；基础构词分析：peN- + alih + -an → pengalihan

senses.nuances: 释义据《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》。侧重对某对象施加转移或改换；peralihan 较常突出状态、阶段或制度的过渡，二者不能在所有搭配中互换。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pengalihan)。

etymology.historical_story: Pengalihan illustrates productive Malay word formation rather than a borrowed foreign label. Its basic lexical root is alih, associated with moving or changing. The peN-…-an construction names the corresponding action or process. This makes one word useful for concrete relocation and abstract redirection alike, including moving pipes, diverting attention, and transferring power. [DBP reference](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pengalihan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 alih“移、换”：mengalihkan 是“把它转移”，pengalihan 就是“这次转移的行为或过程”。

etymology.historical_story: Pembentangan is formed within Malay from bentang through the nominal pattern peN-...-an. The dictionary records both spreading something physically and presenting an explanation. This pairing offers a memorable conceptual bridge: information can be laid out for others much like a mat is spread open. That bridge explains the meanings without requiring an undocumented story about when the figurative use began. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=bentang)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 bentang“铺开”：把席子铺开是实体动作，把资料铺开给大家看就是 pembentangan“汇报、展示”。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语借词，整词记忆；词首 pl 为辅音连缀，tun 不是后缀。

senses.ms_definition: Sekumpulan tentera, antara 30 hingga 40 orang, yang diletakkan di bawah pimpinan seorang leftenan, biasanya dibahagikan kepada tiga seksyen.

etymology.historical_story: Platun is borrowed from English platoon, illustrating how military terminology travels with institutions and training. In Malaysian Malay, the spelling represents the borrowed word as two syllables. The dictionary describes a lieutenant-led group normally divided into three sections, giving the term a specific organizational meaning rather than the loose sense of a crowd. [Etymology reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/platun).

etymology.historical_story: DBP places pembetung in the betung word family, which includes a large bamboo. The proverb 'Bulat air kerana pembetung, bulat kata kerana muafakat' turns a conduit into an image of agreement: a channel gives water its shape, while discussion brings words together. Modern usage also names culverts and sewers. [Sources: DBP dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pembetung), [DBP proverb guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=pembentung).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 betung 的“大竹筒”形象：长长、中空、让水通过；再把竹筒换成混凝土，就联想到 pembetung 涵管。

etymology.historical_story: Penyebaran illustrates Malay's productive word formation: sebar supplies the idea of spreading, while peN-...-an names the activity or process. Its initial s is replaced by the nasal sound written ny. The same noun can describe seeds dispersing across land or information reaching new audiences, making a physical process useful for discussing communication. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=penyebaran).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 sebar“散开”：penyebaran 就是把“散播这件事”变成名词；看到 ny，记得找回词根首字母 s。

etymology.historical_story: Preman is traced to Dutch vrijman, meaning a free man, in the Indonesian–Malay loanword dictionary. That background helps explain its civilian and private senses. Indonesian usage also developed a negative association with thugs, making context especially important. The ending belongs to the borrowed word: it does not establish a Malay root prem with the suffix -an. [Loanword dictionary](https://sealang.net/lwim/search.pl?dict=lwim&ignoreDiacritic=1&orth=preman).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 preman 整词联系到“脱下制服、恢复平民身份”；不要拆成 prem 加 -an。

etymology.historical_story: English palm has histories connected with Latin palma, referring to the hand and also the tree. The hand sense passed through French forms, while the tree word has an older history in English. These are histories of an English word, not evidence that the unchanged spelling is an established Malay borrowing. Source: [Etymonline: palm](https://www.etymonline.com/word/palm).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 张开手掌，想象手指像棕榈叶展开：palm 可以指“手掌”，也可以指“棕榈”。马来语分别记 tapak tangan 和 palma；这只是形象联想。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay word building rather than a separate borrowing. Kembang provides the idea of opening or expanding; perkembangan names development, growth, or spread. Adding the attached pronoun nya connects that development with an earlier referent. The same construction can therefore discuss a child's growth, an organisation's expansion, or a project's progress. [DBP base-word entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=perkembangan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先想 kembang 像花朵展开，再把 perkembangan 记成“发展的过程”；末尾 -nya 像回指箭头，指向前面那个人或那件事：其发展、其进展。

morphology.pattern_note: per-...-an 构成与 bertembung 相应的事件或状态名词。词根辅音不脱落；加 -an 后，末尾 /ŋ/ 在语音上成为下一音节的声母。这里取 tembung II“相遇、碰撞”这一词族。

senses.zh_definition: 物体相撞或相互接触的事件，尤指车辆等发生碰撞。
senses.en_definition: An instance of objects colliding or coming into physical contact.
senses.ms_definition: Kejadian dua objek bertembung atau berlanggar secara fizikal.
senses.nuances: 这是 bertembung“碰撞”义的名词用法。一般交通事故也常用 pelanggaran；只有涉及正面相撞时才宜加 berhadapan。[DBP：tembung 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=tembung)

senses.zh_definition: 人、群体或不同文化之间的相遇、接触或交汇。

senses.nuances: 可强调偶然相遇，也可描述文化接触及交流；本身不必然带有敌意。一般预先安排的会面通常用 pertemuan。[DBP：pertembungan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pertembungan)

collocations.en: an encounter or clash of civilizations

senses.zh_definition: 不同观点、价值观、利益或对立力量之间的碰撞、冲突或交锋。
senses.en_definition: A clash or confrontation between opposing views, values, interests, or forces.
senses.ms_definition: Pertentangan atau pertemuan yang melibatkan pandangan, nilai, kepentingan atau pihak yang berlawanan.
senses.nuances: 强调差异相遇后形成的张力。文化语境中应根据上下文区分普通接触和实际冲突，不能一律译为“冲突”。[DBP：pertembungan 的交锋用法](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pertembungan)

senses.zh_definition: 两个或多个活动、约会或工作安排在时间上重叠而造成的不相容。

senses.ms_definition: Pertindihan masa antara kegiatan atau urusan yang menyukarkan pelaksanaannya serentak.
senses.nuances: 常见于职场和学校的时间安排。强调撞期；单纯同时发生且互不影响的活动，未必构成 pertembungan。[DBP：时间安排中的 pertembungan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pertembungan)

etymology.historical_story: Pertembungan is transparently formed from tembung with the Malay nominal circumfix per-...-an. DBP groups it with bertembung, whose meanings include unexpected meetings, joining streams, and physical collisions. These related meanings make contact its central image. Cultural encounters and scheduling clashes extend that image to situations where people, traditions, or commitments meet and sometimes interfere. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=tembung)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tembung 记“碰到一起”；per-...-an 把动作变成“一次碰面、碰撞或撞期”。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节词根 cam 加上 peN-...-an 时，前缀采用 penge-，保留词首 c。数据包把整个派生词标为词根，此处依据词典的 cam 词族予以纠正。[DBP：cam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=cam)

senses.zh_definition: 通过面貌、声音或其他特征辨认、识别某人或某物的过程或行为。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of recognizing or identifying someone or something by distinguishing features.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau perbuatan mengecam seseorang atau sesuatu berdasarkan ciri yang dikenal pasti.
senses.nuances: 常用于身份辨认、影像处理和语音技术。此义属于 cam（认出）词族，不应因 mengecam 另有“抨击”义而译为批评。马来文释义为依据词典编写的释义，并非逐字引文。[DBP：cam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=cam)

senses.zh_definition: 为辨识或记住对象而进行的仔细观察、察看。
senses.en_definition: Close observation undertaken to recognize or remember someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal memerhatikan atau mengamat-amati seseorang atau sesuatu dengan teliti supaya dapat dikenali atau diingati.
senses.nuances: 对应词典中的 pengamatan；与第一义相连，并非任何一般观察都宜称为 pengecaman。表达单纯的观察活动时，pemerhatian 往往更直接。[DBP：cam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=cam)

etymology.historical_story: Pengecaman belongs to the Malay family built on cam, meaning to recognize something previously seen or heard. Its formation turns that everyday act into the name of a process. The same connection makes modern expressions such as facial recognition understandable through an ordinary human experience: looking at a face and knowing whose it is.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 cam＝认出；penge-...-an 把“认出”包装成一个过程：pengecaman＝辨认、识别。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根为 kumpul；输入的 pengumpul 是同族派生词，表示收集者或收集处。peN- 在词根首音 k 前取 peng-，k 脱落；加 -an 构成表示收集行为或过程的名词。

senses.zh_definition: 收集；汇集；积累。指把分散的物品、资料、资金等集中起来，或使其逐渐增多的行为与过程。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of collecting, gathering, or accumulating things.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau perbuatan mengumpulkan; penghimpunan.
senses.nuances: 侧重收集的行为或过程。表示收藏品整体常用 koleksi；表示人群聚会通常用 perhimpunan 或 perjumpaan。pengumpulan dana 指筹集资金，pengumpulan modal 则可指资本积累。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=178260&keyword=pengumpulan)；[DBP 词根及派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kumpul)。

etymology.historical_story: Pengumpulan belongs to the Malay kumpul family, whose members describe gathering, groups, collectors, and accumulated things. Its morphology focuses attention on the activity rather than the collector or the resulting collection. DBP illustrates it with the gathering of old objects by the National Museum, connecting an everyday action with the cultural work of preserving material heritage.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kumpul 是“聚到一起”；peN-...-an 把动作装成名词：pengumpulan 就是“收集这件事”。记住首字母 k 被鼻音 ŋ 替换。

senses.nuances: 这是反对者义在政治语境中的专门用法。须明确谈的是联邦还是州层级；同一政党在不同层级的地位可能不同。parti pembangkang 中的 pembangkang 修饰 parti，但本身仍可作名词。

etymology.historical_story: Pembangkang is formed from bangkang through the person-forming prefix peN-, linking an act of opposition to the person performing it. Malay dictionaries record both the general opponent and an archaic obstructer of progress. Parliamentary usage gives the word a familiar institutional setting, where opposition identifies a political position rather than an inherent personal fault.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 membangkang＝反对，再把表示做事者的 pem- 放到 bangkang 前：pembangkang＝提出反对的人；政治中就是反对派。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在词首 c /tʃ/ 前采用书写形式 pen-，c 保留，构成表示施事者或工具的名词。输入包把完整派生词误标为词根；依据 DBP 的 cucuh 词条更正词基及其爪夷文。

senses.nuances: palam pencucuh 是汽油发动机的火花塞；pencucuh 本身的范围更广，也可指炉具等设备的点火装置。不要把所有点火器都译成火花塞。

senses.zh_definition: 【比喻】煽动他人、挑起敌意或事端的人。

senses.ms_definition: Orang yang menghasut pihak lain sehingga timbul permusuhan atau kekacauan.

etymology.historical_story: Pencucuh is transparently formed from cucuh, associated with lighting or applying fire. The prefix peN- allows the same noun to name a person performing the action or a device performing that function. The dictionary also records a figurative instigator: someone who metaphorically starts a social fire. This is a semantic connection, not a dated account of development. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=cucuh)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cucuh＝点火；peN- 加上去，就是“点火的人或工具”。点燃燃料是点火器，点燃争端就是煽动者。

etymology.historical_story: The word illustrates how Malay builds professional vocabulary from an existing activity. Terjemah supplies the idea of translating, while peN- identifies the person doing it. DBP explicitly records this formation with the initial t retained. The related forms terjemahan and penterjemahan distinguish the translated result from the activity, creating a compact vocabulary for translation work. [DBP morphology reference](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2025/04/eDigital_Morfologi-qnsczr.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: The international word family reaches back to Greek patriōtēs, associated with shared ancestry and homeland, through Latin and French. Malay uses patriot for the person, alongside patriotik for the quality and patriotisme for the sentiment. This European history does not, by itself, establish the precise route or date of borrowing into Malay. [Merriam-Webster word history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/patriot)

etymology.historical_story: Patterson commonly belongs to a British surname tradition expressing descent from someone named Patrick. Its history includes Scottish and northern English developments, while some Irish families acquired the same spelling through different naming histories. Consequently, the surname alone cannot establish a person's ancestry, nationality, or relationship to another bearer. [Surname reference](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/patterson).

etymology.historical_story: Persefahaman grows from the Malay family of faham, understanding. The intermediate form sefaham introduces shared opinion, while bersefahaman describes parties agreeing with one another. The noun gathers that relationship into a single concept. Its structure offers a useful cultural image: understanding becomes something held between people, rather than knowledge possessed by just one individual. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=sefaham).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到中间的 se-fa-ham，就想“大家同一个理解”；外围 per-...-an 把它装成名词“共识”。

etymology.historical_story: This entry concerns a spelling variation rather than a separate established root history. DBP documents peduli and its family, including mempedulikan and kepedulian. The inserted r in perduli can misleadingly suggest the productive Malay prefix per. Treating the form as a spelling variant preserves its recognizable meaning without inventing a derivation from duli or an unsupported historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 写规范词 peduli 时，把 perduli 中多出的 r 删掉；记住 peduli = 心里有放着、会关心。

etymology.historical_story: Pemecah illustrates a productive Malay naming pattern: the prefix peN- turns an action into the person or instrument responsible for it. Its base, pecah, concerns breaking or splitting. Dictionary examples extend that concrete image to broken trust and disclosed secrets, showing how one word can name machinery, human agents, and socially damaging behaviour. [DBP: pecah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=pecah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pecah 是“破”，peN- 把动作变成执行者或工具：pemecah 就是“使东西破开的人或器具”。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records perincian within the rinci word family, whose meanings include dividing something into small parts and explaining it point by point. The noun preserves both ideas: an itemised breakdown and a detailed account. Its financial and administrative uses therefore share a practical image—opening a broad statement into individually visible particulars. Source: [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=rinci).

etymology.historical_story: The cultural history of perintah is closely tied to authority: a superior gives an order and others carry it out. Modern Malaysian public language also uses the word in names such as Perintah Kawalan Pergerakan. Adding -nya brings that authority into a particular conversation by identifying whose instruction is meant. [DBP: perintah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=67836&keyword=perintah).

etymology.historical_story: Panahan preserves the image of an arrow leaving a bow and reaching its target. Malay extends that image to a gaze that seems to strike someone, while panahan petir pictures lightning as a sudden projectile. These recorded uses connect a concrete shooting action with literary expression and descriptions of natural events. [DBP: panah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=panah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: panah 是弓箭，-an 把动作变成结果：panahan＝射出的一箭；目光和雷电也能像箭一样“击中”。

etymology.historical_story: Palu brings together an implement and the blow it delivers. Its Malay family extends naturally to memalu, the act of striking, and paluan, the resulting stroke or sound. Drum beating makes this connection especially vivid: an ordinary physical action becomes rhythm. This is a cultural illustration, not a claim about its earliest origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pa-lu 想成木槌敲出的“啪、噜”两拍：palu 是槌，memalu 是敲，paluan 是敲出的声音。此拟声联想不是词源。

etymology.historical_story: Peluncur is built from luncur, the Malay base associated with sliding and gliding. Its prefix can name either the person performing an action or the implement enabling it. That grammatical flexibility explains the dictionary's two branches: a participant in a gliding sport and a device used to glide or move something along. [DBP: peluncur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=peluncur)

etymology.historical_story: English pound in its weight sense descends from Old English pund, ultimately linked to Latin pondo. The animal-enclosure noun and the striking verb have separate histories, despite sharing the modern spelling. Malay records paun for currency, weight, and an animal enclosure; pounds retains English inflection when it appears in mixed-language communication. [Merriam-Webster: pound](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/pound); [DBP: paun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=paun)

etymology.historical_story: Malay connects perhitungan with the hitung family of counting words. Its meanings extend from working out amounts to weighing consequences and settling grievances. The same image of an account being examined also appears in religious reckoning. These connections explain the word's semantic range without requiring a separate origin story for each meaning.

etymology.historical_story: Perempuanku illustrates an established Malay grammatical pattern: a noun followed by the attached pronoun -ku, shortened from aku. Perempuan supplies the reference to a woman or wife; -ku adds the speaker's relationship to her. The combined form needs no separate borrowing history, and its romantic force comes from context and the possessive expression.

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary preserves a connection between bamboo tubes and bodily channels: both are hollow structures through which something can pass. Traditional Malay imagery also places water inside a pembuluh in a proverb about consensus. This provides a useful cultural bridge between the concrete tube and the anatomical vessel, without establishing a precise historical derivation. etymology.historical_story: Penyewa illustrates Malay's productive way of naming participants: peN- combines with sewa, replacing initial s with ny. Its dictionary entry also preserves a less familiar meaning, funds used to pay rent. That pairing connects the person renting with the resources needed for renting, although the person sense dominates ordinary contemporary usage. [DBP: penyewa and sewa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menyewa)

etymology.historical_story: PAS is an acronym of Parti Islam Se-Malaysia. Adding the Malay interrogative particle -kah turns the party name into a focused question: ‘Is it PAS?’ Parliamentary records document PASkah in political discussion. Its lowercase appearance can obscure the acronym and resemble Paskah, a religious name associated with Easter. Here, the supplied party definition determines the reading. See the [parliamentary record](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/files/hindex/pdf/DN-28042003.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Penghapusan belongs to the Malay derivational family built on hapus. The circumfix peN-...-an turns the underlying action into a noun naming its performance or process. This structure connects concrete removal with abstract elimination: deleting information and abolishing an institution share the idea of making something cease to remain. No speculative foreign origin is needed. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=penghapusan)

etymology.historical_story: The English word pencil once denoted an artist's brush. Its ancestry runs through French to Latin penicillus, a diminutive associated with a small tail or brush. That history concerns English pencil; it does not establish the precise borrowing route of pensil. For Malaysian writing, learn the standard spelling pensel. [Merriam-Webster: pencil](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/pencil)

etymology.historical_story: This form tells a small grammatical story: buru supplies the idea of pursuit, peN- forms pemburu, and -nya links the hunter or pursuer to someone already mentioned. Context identifies that relationship. The same written ending also appears after compound expressions, so identifying the whole noun phrase matters before translating ownership. [DBP spelling guidance](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Penganalisis shows how Malay turns an international scholarly term into a locally structured occupation word. The borrowed base analisis takes the productive agent prefix peN-, yielding a person or body that performs analysis. DBP groups it with menganalisis and penganalisisan, making the relationship between the activity, its process, and its practitioner especially clear. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=analisis)

etymology.historical_story: Pembetulan turns betul, meaning correct or right, into the name of an action through the Malay circumfix peN-...-an. Its administrative usefulness is visible in public services that handle pembetulan maklumat, the correction of recorded information. The word connects an everyday judgment, betul, with the practical work of putting an error right. [Malaysian National Registration Department](https://www.jpn.gov.my/perkhidmatan/kelahiran/permohonan-pembetulan-maklumat-seksyen-30-dalam-sijil-kelahiran-bagi-kesilapan-fakta-sabah/)

etymology.historical_story: Prateek belongs to a South Asian naming tradition associated with Sanskrit pratīka. Historical Sanskrit dictionaries record meanings including outward form, image and symbol. This background explains an association of the name; it does not establish a Malay common noun meaning “symbol.” In Malay writing, an individual's name normally retains its chosen spelling. See [Monier-Williams](https://www.sanskrit-lexicon.uni-koeln.de/scans/MWScan/MWScanpdf/mw0675-pratIka.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Pecahkannya illustrates how Malay builds expressions from familiar pieces rather than requiring a separate dictionary word for every combination. Pecah describes breaking; -kan forms a transitive verb, and -nya can supply its object. The same breaking image extends naturally from eggs and glass to tasks, puzzles and records. Context determines what is being broken.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pecah＝破，-kan＝使它发生，-nya＝它：连起来记成“把它弄开”，再按上下文理解为敲碎、拆分或破解。

etymology.historical_story: Perigi carries a cultural history visible in Malay dictionaries and verse. Besides naming a water source, it appears in pantun and proverbs about access to knowledge, wealth, and power. The expression perigi wakaf records another social dimension: a well provided for public use. These associations explain its resonance beyond the physical hole in the ground. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=perigi)

etymology.historical_story: English peach passed through French from a Latin expression meaning Persian apple. That inherited name preserves an old geographical association rather than providing a modern account of the fruit's botanical origin. In Malay, DBP recommends pic as the equivalent. The English spelling can still appear in multilingual conversation, menus, and product descriptions. [Sources: Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/peach), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pic).

etymology.historical_story: DBP records a classical sense of peka meaning attentive rather than negligent, alongside modern senses involving sensitivity and awareness. These meanings share a useful idea: noticing what might otherwise escape attention. A delicate instrument detects a tiny change; a considerate person notices another person's needs. Their coexistence is documented, but their precise historical sequence is not established here.

etymology.historical_story: Perkakas connects several practical worlds in the dictionary: household implements, working tools, bodily organs, and people treated as instruments. A useful interpretive thread is function—something serving a purpose. That connection helps explain the range of meanings, but is a learning interpretation rather than proof of their historical sequence or the word's ultimate origin. etymology.historical_story: Petikan is formed from petik and the Malay noun-forming suffix -an. Its meanings connect picking fruit, plucking strings and selecting words from a longer text. This offers a useful semantic bridge: an excerpt is something selected from a larger whole. DBP records these related uses under the same root, rather than under peti, meaning a box. [DBP: petik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=petik)

etymology.historical_story: English play developed from Old English plegian, associated with lively activity, amusement and music. Its meanings expanded across games, theatre and performance. When recording technology arrived, the musical sense extended to reproducing recorded sound. The familiar media button therefore carries a much older idea of performance into modern digital life. [Etymonline: play](https://www.etymonline.com/word/play)

etymology.historical_story: Indonesian tea-growing sources document peko for a developing tea bud. English pekoe, a tea-grade term, is traced by the American Heritage Dictionary to an Amoy expression meaning white down, probably referring to fine hairs on young leaves. That resemblance suggests a research lead, but does not establish peko's borrowing route or its standing in Malaysian Malay. See [American Heritage: pekoe](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=pekoe).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 仅为这里记录的印尼专业义记忆：看见 peko，就想象茶梢顶端尚未展开的一枚嫩芽；不据此推定马来语读音或词源。

morphology.pattern_note: per-...-an 构成表示相识行为或关系的名词；词根首音 /k/ 保留，末尾 /l/ 与 -an 连读为 lan。数据包的 kenalan 本身是 kenal + -an 的派生词，此处将最终词根校正为 kenal。
