etymology.historical_story: The English compound combines play and boy, but its adult social meaning cannot be recovered by translating those parts literally. English dictionaries associate it with a pleasure-seeking, often wealthy man. In Malay conversation, the romantic implication can become especially prominent, so an English social label also functions as criticism of someone's relationships.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: play + boy：把成年生活也当成“玩乐场”的男子；记住整体义“花花公子”，不要逐字翻译。

morphology.pattern_note: 末尾 au 为双元音，读作 /aw/。监测义派生时，meN-、peN- 遇词首 p，p 脱落并出现 m：meN- + pantau → memantau；peN- + pantau + -an → pemantauan。鱼名与动词须按同形异义词区分。

senses.zh_definition: 监测；持续、仔细地观察和检查某事的发展或运行情况，以便监督、预防问题或作出改进。
senses.en_definition: To monitor something through regular, careful observation and checking.
senses.ms_definition: Memerhatikan dan memeriksa perkembangan atau perjalanan sesuatu secara berkala dan teliti untuk tujuan pengawasan, pencegahan atau penambahbaikan.
senses.nuances: 现代常用义。正式主动陈述通常用 memantau；pantau 可用于祈使句、第一或第二人称被动结构及日常口语。重点是持续观察，未必包含直接操控。马来语释义据 DBP 改写。[DBP：pantau](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=pantau)。

senses.zh_definition: 米南加保语中的一种河鱼名称。
senses.en_definition: A kind of river fish, in Minangkabau usage.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis ikan sungai dalam penggunaan bahasa Minangkabau.
senses.nuances: 对应输入资料中的 pantau I；DBP 标记 Mn 表示米南加保语。该简释未确定学名，不能据此指定鱼种。以下为解释性组合，未经高频认证。

senses.zh_definition: 看；探看；探望。
senses.en_definition: To look at, look in on, or visit.
senses.ms_definition: Menengok, melihat atau menjenguk.
senses.nuances: DBP 在 pantau II 下记录的旧用法，通常以 memantau 出现。现代日常表达宜按语境用 melihat、menjenguk 或 melawat；不能把所有英语 look up 都译为 pantau。以下为释义性组合，未经高频认证。

senses.zh_definition: 止住血液流出；止血，属沙巴地区用法。

senses.ms_definition: Menahan darah daripada keluar, dalam penggunaan daerah Sabah.
senses.nuances: 对应 DBP 的 pantau III，标记 Sb；释义用于派生形式 memantau。此义不属于现代通用的监测义。跨地区交流宜说 menghentikan pendarahan。以下为依词典义构成的短语，未经高频认证。[DBP：memantau](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=memantau)。

etymology.historical_story: One spelling hides several dictionary histories. Kamus Dewan distinguishes pantau as a Minangkabau river fish, a base associated with looking and monitoring, and a Sabah use concerning stopping blood. This is a useful reminder that identical spelling does not prove shared origin. The familiar modern monitoring meaning should therefore be learned separately from the regional senses. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=pantau).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pan.tau 想成“盼着看，持续瞧”：监测就要不断看变化。此联想只帮助记忆监测义，不解释鱼名或止血义的词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 外来人名，整词记忆，不作马来语词缀拆分。音标采用西班牙语音位形式；葡萄牙语及英语读法有所不同，称呼本人时以其读法为准。无已确认的马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 佩德罗：西班牙语、葡萄牙语和加利西亚语使用的男性名字，对应英语 Peter。
senses.en_definition: A masculine given name used in Spanish, Portuguese and Galician, corresponding to Peter.
senses.ms_definition: Nama peribadi lelaki dalam bahasa Sepanyol, Portugis dan Galicia yang sepadan dengan nama Peter dalam bahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正文写作 Pedro；没有上下文时不能指定为某位球员、演员或历史人物。下列为姓名使用示例，未经高频认证。status 沿用指定数据标签，不表示该人名获 DBP 词条认证；马来语释义为编写释义。名字对应关系见 [Real Academia Galega](https://www.academia.gal/nomes/-/nome/Pedro)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 保留姓名的大写与原拼写，不自行改成 Peter。名字的基督教历史背景不能用来判断当事人的宗教、国籍或个人信仰。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 正式马来语场合可用 Encik Pedro，或采用本人认可的完整姓名及职衔；熟人之间可直接称 Pedro。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 保留姓名的大写与原拼写，不自行改成 Peter。名字的基督教历史背景不能用来判断当事人的宗教、国籍或个人信仰。

etymology.historical_story: Pedro belongs to the naming tradition represented by English Peter. Its history runs through Latin Petrus and Greek Petros, associated with stone or rock and the Christian apostle Peter. Spanish, Portuguese and Galician preserve Pedro as a familiar personal name. That historical association does not make Pedro a Malay word meaning stone. [Source: Real Academia Galega](https://www.academia.gal/nomes/-/nome/Pedro).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按西班牙语读音记作“佩—德罗”，再把 Pedro 与 Peter 配成一对名字；不要把它当作马来语“石头”。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着于词尾的代词性成分，此处按给定分类记为 suffix，读 /ɲa/，不引起词干音变。直接基础为 penampilan；更深层为 peN- + tampil + -an → penampilan，其中 t 脱落、鼻音取 n。完整词形可分为 pe.nam.pi.lan.nya；syllables 保留输入的 null。所给 Jawi 实际对应 penampilan；完整 penampilannya 应写作 ڤنمڤيلنڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 他、她或它的呈现、展示或被推出的方式与过程。

senses.nuances: 侧重某人出现或登场这一事件。用于演艺报道时可指演出亮相；若专指发挥水平，prestasinya 或 mutu persembahannya 更明确。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay word building rather than a separate borrowing. Tampil concerns coming forward; menampilkan brings someone or something into view; penampilan names the presentation or appearance. Adding -nya links that appearance to a contextual referent. The connection helps explain uses ranging from public appearances to personal image. Base-word source: [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penampilan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tampil“走到人前”→ penampilan“呈现出的样子”→ 加 -nya“他／她／它的”：一步步看见 penampilannya。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是 kamu 的后附代词形式，此处表示与你相关的所属关系；为适配字段归入 suffix，严格说并非普通派生后缀。接合时不发生辅音交替，读作 per.ta.ma.mu。输入包的 ڤرتام 只体现词根，未体现 -mu；headword.jawi 按要求保留原值，不应视为完整词形的已核定拼写。

etymology.historical_story: Pertama belongs to an old layer of Sanskrit vocabulary absorbed into Malay, tracing back to prathama, meaning first. Modern pertamamu combines that established word with the attached pronoun -mu. Its meaning is therefore built from an inherited loanword and a productive Malay pronoun construction, rather than from the unrelated organizational acronym PERTAMA. [World Loanword Database](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839316533519)

etymology.historical_story: Pengaman combines the Malay agent-forming prefix peN- with aman, a word borrowed from Arabic amān, meaning safety or security. The formation turns a peaceful condition into the person or institution responsible for creating it. Its use in peacekeeping vocabulary makes that relationship especially clear: aman names the desired condition, while pengaman names its provider. [Arabic amān](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%86)

etymology.historical_story: Projektor belongs to the international vocabulary of image projection. In Malay, the complete word names the machine rather than a person performing an action. DBP's definition mentions films and slides, preserving the vocabulary of earlier classroom and cinema equipment; present-day usage also includes digital presentation devices. The supplied evidence does not establish a particular borrowing date.

etymology.historical_story: Publisiti is the Malay adaptation of English publicity. The English word came through French publicité from a Latin word family associated with the public. Its history connects public visibility with deliberate promotion. Malay preserves that useful distinction: publisiti can describe the promotional effort, the information circulated, or the attention eventually received. [English word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/publicity)

etymology.historical_story: Propaganda ultimately comes from Latin propagare, meaning to spread or propagate. Its international history includes the Catholic congregation established in 1622 to spread the faith. The term later expanded into political persuasion. Malay uses this international word for communication intended to influence public opinion, often with a critical undertone. [Historical reference](https://academic.oup.com/edited-volume/28010/chapter-abstract/211781635).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 propaganda 和英语 propagate（传播）连起来记：把一种主张不断传播，让更多人接受。

etymology.historical_story: Penapis illustrates productive Malay word formation rather than an opaque borrowed word. Its base, tapis, concerns filtering; peN- creates a noun for the instrument or agent. The dictionary places physical filters beside people who screen films, making the shared idea easy to see: separating what may pass from what must be held back.

etymology.historical_story: Pissing belongs to English: it adds -ing to piss. The base entered Middle English through Old French pissier, with a deeper origin generally described as imitative. Its presence in a Malay-language dataset does not by itself demonstrate borrowing into Malay. A quotation, subtitle or mixed-language conversation could contain the English form without changing its linguistic identity.

etymology.historical_story: The transparent word-building connection is with picu, meaning a firearm trigger. Adding peN- produces pemicu through nasal substitution: the initial p disappears and the prefix surfaces as pem-. Indonesian usage extends the idea of initiating an action to events and causal factors. DBP documents picu and memicu, but that evidence alone does not establish every Indonesian derivative as an official Malaysian Malay entry. [DBP: picu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=picu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 从 picu“扳机”联想：一扣就启动；pemicu 就是使事情开始的人、装置或因素。

etymology.historical_story: Perebutan belongs to the Malay family built around rebut, involving taking or competing to obtain something. Its nominal form packages an action into an event that can be discussed in reports. The dictionary records struggles for rank, position, and power, showing how the vocabulary of grabbing also describes institutional rivalry. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=perebutan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 rebut 的“抢”：berebut 是大家抢，perebutan 是“这场争夺”。

etymology.historical_story: Penthouse began with forms related to Old French apentis, an attached structure or lean-to. English speakers later reshaped the unfamiliar ending into house. Its architectural history therefore starts with an attachment to a building, rather than luxury. Modern usage associates the word especially with prestigious accommodation at the top of a building. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=penthouse)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 house 想成房子，再把它放到大楼最顶端：penthouse＝顶层豪宅。此画面用于记忆，不是马来语构词分析。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在 c 前取 pen- 形式，保留词根的 c；词根末尾 h 也保留。整体表示使某物变明亮或清楚的过程。

senses.en_definition: The act or process of making something brighter or lighter in colour.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau perbuatan mencerahkan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是词典核心义，在护肤语境中常指提亮肤色。pencerahan 强调过程，kecerahan 强调明亮的状态或程度。[DBP 词典释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cerah)

senses.zh_definition: 使人对某个问题获得更清楚理解的解释、说明或启发。

senses.nuances: 由明暗变化引申为从不明白到明白。DBP 的语言咨询认可这种扩展用法；此处马来文为扩展义释文，并非所附《Kamus Dewan》原条目的直接引文。一般 mohon pencerahan 是请人说明，不必理解成哲学上的启蒙。[DBP 用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?%2F1000=&d=175768&keyword=pencerahan)

etymology.historical_story: Pencerahan is formed from cerah, meaning bright or clear. Its dictionary meaning concerns making something brighter, but Malaysian usage also moves from physical light to understanding. DBP language advice recognizes this extension: a person seeking pencerahan wants to move from not knowing to knowing, making illumination a practical metaphor for explanation. [DBP language advice](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?%2F1000=&d=175768&keyword=pencerahan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cerah＝亮；pencerahan＝把事情照亮。原本看不清，经人说明就明白了。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根不发生鼻音替换；词根末尾 a 与 -an 的 a 分属两个音节，仔细发音时可有声门停顿。输入 root_jawi 末尾含异常控制字符，此处删除该字符。

senses.zh_definition: 宪法；规定国家或州的基本治理制度、政府组织及权力框架的根本法律。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records lembaga with meanings including an original form, a mould, and an organized body. Perlembagaan belongs to this family and names the basic framework governing a state or association. Imagining a constitution as an institutional mould offers a useful semantic connection, although that image is a mnemonic rather than a documented account of its coinage. [DBP: lembaga](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=lembaga)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 per｜lem｜ba｜ga｜an 分五拍；把 lembaga 想成组织的框架，perlembagaan 就是规定这个框架的“宪法／章程”。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，在马来语中常见于技术语境或语码混用，不按马来语词缀拆分。输入 syllables 的 sst 不是有效分音，此处按要求原样保留；实际为单音节 patch。/pætʃ/ 是英语读音，不代表已经确立唯一的马来语规范读音。下列词族形式属于英语。

word_family.gloss: 已修补的；已安装补丁的

senses.zh_definition: 软件补丁；用于修复错误、消除安全漏洞或调整现有软件的更新内容。
senses.en_definition: A software change or update intended to fix faults, address vulnerabilities, or modify an existing program.
senses.ms_definition: Tampalan perisian yang digunakan untuk membaiki ralat, menangani kelemahan keselamatan atau mengubah fungsi perisian sedia ada.
senses.nuances: 常见于马来西亚资讯科技交流，规范马来语可用 tampalan perisian 或 tampalan keselamatan。并非所有 kemas kini 都是小型补丁，patch 也不必然只是临时修复。马来语释义为综合释写；官方文件中的对应表达见[马来西亚国会文件：tampalan (patch)](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/pac/review/docs-123-147.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 给软件或系统安装补丁；修补程序问题，属于英语动词嵌入马来语的混用。
senses.en_definition: To apply a software patch or repair a software fault; used as an English verb in mixed Malay speech.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam pertuturan bercampur bahasa Inggeris, memasang tampalan pada perisian atau sistem untuk membaiki masalahnya.
senses.nuances: 例如 dah patch 表示‘已经安装补丁’。这是语码混用，不应据此认定 patch 已成为规范马来语动词。正式文本宜写 memasang tampalan 或 membaiki ralat。英语技术动词义见[The Jargon File：patch](https://www.catb.org/jargon/html/P/patch.html)。

senses.zh_definition: 贴片或补片；贴、缝或覆盖在物体表面的小片材料，可用于修补、装饰或药物输送。
senses.en_definition: A small piece of material attached to a surface for repair, decoration, covering, or drug delivery.
senses.ms_definition: Kepingan kecil bahan yang dilekatkan atau dijahit pada permukaan untuk menampal, menghias, menutup atau menyampaikan ubat melalui kulit.
senses.nuances: 具体马来语对应词随用途而变，可用 tampalan、tampal 或 lencana。药物贴片与软件补丁应分别解释，不可仅凭英语形式混为一义。实物对应词见[DBP：tampal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=tampal)。

etymology.historical_story: English patch is recorded from late Middle English, with a possible connection to a French word meaning piece. Its familiar image is a small piece used to cover or repair something. Computing extends that repair metaphor to software, while Malaysian technical conversation often retains the English word alongside Malay tampalan. The deeper origin remains uncertain. See [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/patch_1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: patch /pætʃ/，联想‘啪，贴上’：衣服贴补片，软件装补丁。只是声音联想，不是词源。

morphology.formula: per- + mudah + -kan → permudahkan（实际使用的非规范组合）；规范形式：per- + mudah → permudah，或 mudah + -kan → mudahkan
morphology.pattern_note: 输入包把 permudahkan 标为词根，按实际构词更正为 mudah；没有需要解释的词根音变。per-...-kan 在这里仅描述表面结构，不表示认可该组合。mudah 是形容词，规范形式采用 mempermudah／dipermudah，或 memudahkan／dimudahkan；命令式相应为 permudah 或 mudahkan。音节为补全值，词头 Jawi 保留输入的 null。[DBP 规范说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=dipermudah)。

senses.zh_definition: 使事情更容易处理；简化手续、步骤或要求。此拼写常见于口语，正式文本宜改用规范形式。
senses.en_definition: To make something easier or simpler; a nonstandard form of permudah or mudahkan.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk tidak baku yang digunakan dengan maksud menjadikan sesuatu lebih senang dilakukan atau diurus.
senses.nuances: 未将其伪称为 DBP 的独立正式词条；本释义概括实际用法。句中 Kita permudahkan… 可规范改写为 Kita mempermudah… 或 Kita memudahkan…。headword.status 按要求保留 official，仅是本输出的记录标签，不表示 DBP 认可这一词形。[DBP：mudah 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=mudah)；[马来西亚国会中的实际口语用例](https://hansard.parlimen.gov.my/hansard/dewan-rakyat/2024-10-17)。

etymology.historical_story: The starting point is mudah, meaning easy. Standard Malay builds memudahkan and mempermudah from it, while speech also supplies permudahkan. A plausible explanation is analogy between these familiar causative patterns, though that is an analysis rather than a documented origin. Parliamentary speech records its use; DBP guidance establishes the distinction between attestation and grammatical recommendation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mudah＝容易。正式表达记两条：permudah＝使更容易；mudahkan＝使容易。不要把两条形式叠成 permudahkan。

morphology.pattern_note: 直接基底为 pakaian，更深层词根为 pakai。-mu 是表示“你的”的附着代词，并非派生词缀；连接时不发生词根音变。按词包保留的 Jawi ڤاکاين 仅对应 pakaian，完整 pakaianmu 应含后接的 مو。

senses.zh_definition: 你的衣物或服装；可统指衣服、裤子、鞋等穿戴物，也可指某套穿着。
senses.en_definition: Your clothes, clothing, or outfit.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang kamu pakai, seperti baju, seluar dan kasut, atau keseluruhan persalinan kamu.
senses.nuances: -mu 对应 kamu，表示受话者的所属关系；本身不标明衣物数量。日常马来西亚口语常说 pakaian awak 或 baju awak；pakaianmu 更常见于书面表达、歌词或亲近的直接称呼。基础名词义参照 [DBP：pakaian](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=pakaian)。

senses.zh_definition: 你惯常奉行的做法或习性；是把习惯比作常穿衣物的比喻用法。
senses.en_definition: Your customary practice or habitual behavior, in figurative or literary usage.
senses.ms_definition: Amalan atau kebiasaan yang selalu kamu lakukan, digunakan secara kiasan.
senses.nuances: 此义承接 pakaian 的传统比喻义，现代日常交流较少见。以下搭配属于文学或修辞表达，不应当作高频生活口语；表达普通习惯时通常用 amalanmu 或 kebiasaanmu。

etymology.historical_story: Pakaianmu shows how Malay builds a personal expression from ordinary components: pakai concerns wearing or using, pakaian names what is worn, and -mu makes it yours. The dictionary also records clothing as a metaphor for habitual conduct. That figurative sense offers a cultural image: a repeated practice becomes something one wears daily.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pakai“穿”→ pakaian“衣物”；再加 mu“你的”，就像给衣服缝上写着“你的”的姓名标签。

morphology.pattern_note: 前缀 pe- 表示具有某种习性或特征的人；也可分析为 peN- 在 /m/ 前的 pe- 变体。词根 murah 的 /m/ 保留，不发生辅音脱落。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合描述捐助、分享和待客。宗教称谓 Maha Pemurah 用于称颂真主，须尊重其宗教语境及大写惯例。参见 [DBP《Dewan Bahasa》](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/majalah/2020/db82020/files/basic-html/page19.html)。

etymology.historical_story: Pemurah belongs to the Malay family of murah, whose dictionary meanings include abundance, low price, and willingness to give. This makes generosity easier to understand through the wider family: murah hati describes an openhearted disposition, while pemurah identifies someone who readily shares. The connection is documented vocabulary, rather than a claim that generosity developed historically from cheapness. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=murah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pe-murah 连到 murah hati：不是“人很便宜”，而是“心很大方”；听见 pemurah，就想象一个把东西分享出去的人。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆，pik 与 nik 不是马来语词根或词缀。添加 ber- 可构成活动动词 berpiknik，词干不变。

senses.zh_definition: 野餐；为休闲娱乐而在户外共同进食的活动。

senses.nuances: 《Kamus Pelajar》收录与 berpiknik 相同的动词用法。聊天中可说 pergi piknik；正式表达动作时，berpiknik 或 berkelah 更明确。

etymology.historical_story: Piknik belongs to the international picnic word family. Its French relative pique-nique is recorded from the seventeenth century and originally described a meal to which participants contributed money or food. Modern Malay uses piknik for an outdoor shared meal. This comparison establishes a wider word history without assuming an undocumented direct borrowing route into Malay. [Académie française](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9P2516?history=0); [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=piknik)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pik-nik 听起来就像英语 picnic；想象把野餐垫“啪”地铺开，大家拿出食物共享。两音节整词记忆，不拆词根。

morphology.formula: ∅ + Periukan → Periukan（专名组成部分，按整体记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 此处按不可拆分的专名成分处理，不代表已确认其历史词根。输入的 periu + -kan 分析未获证实；不能据此赋予动词义。音节、读音和爪夷文暂缺可靠依据。

senses.en_definition: A component of the Indonesian place name Air Periukan; not verified as an independent standard Malay common word.
senses.ms_definition: Unsur nama khas dalam nama tempat Air Periukan di Seluma, Bengkulu, Indonesia; makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum disahkan.
senses.nuances: 以上为经核实地名用途的编辑说明，并非 DBP 释义。正式书写采用 Air Periukan，不将小写 periukan 自动解释为派生动词。以下为地名组合，不代表普通词的高频搭配。印度尼西亚官方气象机构使用该地名：[BMKG：Air Periukan](https://www.bmkg.go.id/cuaca/prakiraan-cuaca/17.05.06.2005)。

etymology.historical_story: Air Periukan appears on Indonesia’s official weather service as a location in Seluma, Bengkulu. This gives the unfamiliar string a geographical anchor, but does not establish how the name originated. A place name can preserve local history without having a transparent modern Malay analysis; deriving it from an unsupported root would invent that history. [BMKG](https://www.bmkg.go.id/cuaca/prakiraan-cuaca/17.05.06.2005)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Air Periukan 想成地图上的一个完整标签；认地名，不把末尾 kan 自动当词缀。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在元音 u 前取 peng- 形式；词根 undur 保留，不删除首音。词尾 r 与 -an 的元音在语流中衔接，音节划分为 pe.ngun.du.ran。

senses.zh_definition: 后退、撤退或撤离的行为或过程；可指人员、部队或车辆向后移动或离开原位置。

senses.ms_definition: Perihal mengundur atau mengundurkan sesuatu, termasuk pergerakan ke belakang dan penarikan pasukan dari sesuatu kedudukan.
senses.nuances: 输入包的 DBP 核心释义为 perihal mengundur(kan)。军事撤退不必然表示战败，也可属于有计划的行动；车辆语境则指倒退移动。[DBP undur 及派生词释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=undur)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 新闻和正式通知适合用 pengunduran；日常直接表达“我要退出”时，saya mahu menarik diri 更自然。军事撤退、比赛退出和辞任须靠搭配明确区分。

etymology.historical_story: Pengunduran is formed within Malay from undur, meaning to move back, using the noun-forming pattern peN-...-an. The dictionary's military example makes the physical meaning especially clear: troops withdraw from a position. The same backward movement provides a useful conceptual bridge to leaving a competition or stepping down from office. This explains the relationship between its senses without requiring a speculative foreign origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: undur＝往后退；peng-...-an 把动作装进“这件事”的框里：pengunduran＝后退、撤退或退出这件事。

morphology.formula: ∅ + popcorn → popcorn; 来源英语：pop + corn → popcorn
morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语语境中作为英语整词使用，不拆成马来语词缀。IPA 标示英语非卷舌读法；本地口音可有差异。词族栏列复合表达，并非马来语派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 爆米花；玉米粒受热爆开、膨胀后制成的零食。
senses.en_definition: Corn kernels expanded by heating and eaten as a snack.
senses.ms_definition: Bertih jagung, iaitu biji jagung yang mengembang dan pecah apabila dipanaskan, lalu dimakan sebagai snek.
senses.nuances: 马来语正式对应词为 bertih jagung；popcorn 常用于英语夹用语境及商品名称。单说 bertih 也可能指稻米等谷物制成的爆粒食品。参见 [DBP：popcorn](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=popcorn)。

senses.zh_definition: 爆裂玉米；籽粒受热后容易爆开、适合制作爆米花的玉米类型。
senses.en_definition: A type of maize whose kernels burst and expand when heated.
senses.ms_definition: Jenis jagung yang bijinya dapat pecah dan mengembang apabila dipanaskan untuk menghasilkan bertih jagung.
senses.nuances: 此为来源英语的原料或作物义；在马来语农业说明中宜写 jagung untuk menghasilkan bertih jagung，以免与成品混淆。两种英语义项可参见 [Cambridge：popcorn](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/popcorn)。

etymology.historical_story: The English name joins pop, suggesting the bursting sound, with corn. Popping maize has a much older history in the Americas than the modern English label. In Malaysian Malay, the equivalent bertih jagung names the food through a local grain-puffing vocabulary, linking an internationally familiar snack with an existing Malay expression. [Etymonline: popcorn](https://www.etymonline.com/word/popcorn); [DBP: popcorn](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=popcorn).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pop 是“砰”地爆开，corn 是玉米：玉米砰地开花，就是 popcorn。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect perilaku with conduct that reveals a person's attitude. Its cultural interest lies in that outward focus: people infer an inner disposition from visible actions and responses. The recorded derivative berperilaku carries this idea into descriptions of how someone behaves. For modern vocabulary learning, the supplied analysis treats perilaku as a complete lexical base rather than inventing a prefix.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 pe-ri-la-ku 四拍读，脑中同步播放一个人连续四个举动：从举动看态度，就是 perilaku。

etymology.historical_story: Perkatakan belongs to the productive Malay family built around kata, meaning a word or an utterance. DBP records memperkatakan for both speaking about something and discussing a subject. The shorter form illustrates Malay grammar: removing the active prefix leaves a form usable in commands and personal passive constructions. [DBP: memperkatakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=memperkatakan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 kata“话、词”：perkatakan 就是把一件事拿出来说、拿出来讨论。记住 isu yang kita perkatakan＝我们谈的议题。

etymology.historical_story: English prison came through French forms associated with captivity and confinement, ultimately from Latin words for taking or seizing. The history connects the institution with the act of holding someone captive. This explains the English word's ancestry; it does not establish prison as an adopted standard Malay headword. [Source: Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/prison).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prison 和 prisoner 一起记：prison 是监狱，prisoner 是被关在里面的人；马来语对应 penjara 与 banduan。

etymology.historical_story: Pembaikan belongs to the Malay family built around baik, meaning good or in good condition. Its formation connects an everyday judgement of quality with the work needed to restore or improve something. The dictionary includes both repairs and soil improvement, showing how the same noun serves mechanical, infrastructural, and agricultural contexts. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=baik).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: baik 是“好”；peN-…-an 把“使之变好”的行动变成名词：pembaikan＝修好、改善这件事。

etymology.historical_story: Peterson belongs to a surname pattern that identifies someone through a parent's given name: Peter plus son. The historical meaning is therefore 'son of Peter'. Once established as an inherited family name, it no longer describes each bearer's immediate parentage. In Malay discourse, the surname travels intact with the person rather than becoming a Malay-derived vocabulary item.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Peter + son → 历史上“Peter 的儿子”→ 姓氏 Peterson；不要据此推断现代持有者父亲的名字。

etymology.historical_story: Pelayanan belongs to the Malay word family built around layan, attending to or dealing with someone. Its dictionary definition names the activity of melayan, while pelayan names a person who serves. This contrast offers a useful cultural reading: hospitality involves both the person welcoming a guest and the manner of attending to them. No earlier borrowing history is established here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按输入包记：pelayan“服务员”加 -an → pelayanan“服务这件事”；再联结 melayan“招待”，把人、动作和过程串起来。

etymology.historical_story: Penghadang illustrates productive Malay word formation: the prefix peN- combines with hadang to name something that blocks or guards. Modern public life supplies familiar examples in road barriers and protective partitions. DBP distinguishes this concrete structure from the broader penghalang. This is a transparent morphological explanation; it does not establish an earliest historical date for the word.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hadang 是“挡”，penghadang 就是“用来挡的东西”：一见护栏，脑中接上 peN- + hadang。

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds this word through familiar grammatical layers rather than a separate borrowing. Bantu supplies the idea of helping, and peN- forms pembantu, an assistant. Adding -nya connects that assistant to someone already mentioned. The same basic noun serves households and workplaces, so context supplies the occupation rather than the word itself.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bantu＝帮助；pembantu＝帮忙的人；最后的 -nya 把助手连到前文那个人：他／她的助手。

etymology.historical_story: Pejam is best learned as a whole Malay base, not as pe- attached to jam, the word for an hour or clock. Its dictionary family includes memejamkan and terpejam. Expressions such as pejam celik extend the physical movement of eyelids into an image of passing time; a deeper historical origin is not established here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 pe-jam 时顺手闭一下眼，把声音和动作绑在一起：pejam mata＝闭眼；不要拆成 jam“钟”。

etymology.historical_story: Pengepungan illustrates productive Malay word formation: kepung supplies the idea of surrounding, while peN-...-an names the action. DBP records the same family with meanings ranging from sitting in a circle to trapping people or animals. The family therefore connects an everyday spatial arrangement with the specialised language of police operations and military sieges. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kepung)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 kepung＝围住，再套 peN-…-an＝这一行动：pengepungan 就是“把四周围住的行动”。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 遇词首 t 时出现鼻音替换：t 脱落，前缀实现为 pen-；添加 -an 后构成过程名词。输入包的 penawar 已是派生形式，不能作为最终词根；DBP 将 penawaran 列在 tawar 的派生词中。[DBP：tawar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tawar)

senses.zh_definition: 使某物变淡或消解其效力的行为；亦用于传统疗法中消解毒性、咒力等的过程。

senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan menjadikan sesuatu tawar atau menghilangkan bisa dan kekuatannya, termasuk melalui amalan tradisional.

etymology.historical_story: Penawaran belongs to the Malay tawar word family. DBP records its use for offering and for market supply, while a separate tawar meaning concerns blandness or loss of potency. The surrounding sentence identifies the intended sense. Its formation follows productive Malay morphology: peN- and -an create a process noun, with the initial t replaced through nasal substitution. [DBP: tawar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tawar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tawar 联想到“出价、提供”；peN-…-an 把动作包装成过程名词：penawaran＝提供的过程，经济学中就是“供给”。

etymology.historical_story: Perlengkapan belongs to the Malay family built around lengkap, meaning complete or fully supplied. Its formation connects having everything necessary with the objects that make an activity possible. DBP illustrates this concrete meaning with makeup supplies, while its terminology records also include safety equipment. The word therefore expresses completeness through practical equipment rather than through an abstract quality.

etymology.historical_story: Peggy belongs to English naming history rather than an established Malay derivational family. Research on medieval names traces Margaret through shortened forms such as Mag and Meg, with Peg arising through rhyming substitution. Peggy developed within that naming tradition. This explains an English personal name, but does not identify the intended referent of the supplied lowercase token. [DMNES](https://dmnes.wordpress.com/2017/01/25/how-do-you-get-peggy-from-margaret/).

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionary usage preserves panah for both the bow and its projectile, distinguished explicitly as ibu panah and anak panah. Adding -nya brings this older vocabulary into an ordinary possessive expression. The resulting word therefore needs context: pulling its string suggests a bow, while flying toward a target suggests an arrow.

etymology.historical_story: English punch has separate histories. The tool and striking senses connect with Middle English words for piercing and embossing. The drink name may instead derive from Hindi and Urdu pā̃c, meaning five, traditionally associated with five ingredients. Malaysian workplace speech also uses punch for recording attendance, linking the word to the operation of a time clock. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/punch)

senses.en_definition: A fragment or piece resulting from something being broken.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang sudah pecah atau dipecahkan.
senses.nuances: 强调破碎后留下的实体，可指玻璃、陶器或爆炸物碎片；若只是完整物件的一部分，bahagian 往往更中性。此义对应 DBP 第一义中的实物用法。[DBP PRPM：pecahan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=pecahan)

senses.zh_definition: 分数；数学中以分子和非零分母表示的数值或相应表示形式。
senses.en_definition: A fraction; a number expressed as a numerator divided by a nonzero denominator.
senses.ms_definition: Angka atau bilangan yang bukan angka bulat, seperti 1/2 dan 2/3.
senses.nuances: 马来文释义依 DBP 的概括表述整理。实际数学用法也包括假分数，分数的值可以大于一或等于整数，因此不可把 pecahan 一概理解为小于一的数。常用术语为 pengangka（分子）和 penyebut（分母）。[DBP PRPM：pecahan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=pecahan)

senses.zh_definition: 细分；整体按项目、类别或组成部分分列的明细。
senses.en_definition: A breakdown of a whole into its constituent parts or categories.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian yang dipisahkan daripada sesuatu yang lebih besar atau lengkap.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 第一义中“从整体分出的部分”的抽象用法，在报告、预算和统计中常译为明细或分类细分，不表示物体实际破碎。pecahan kos 指成本明细；不能将其直接等同于表示社会分裂的 perpecahan。[DBP PRPM：pecahan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=pecahan)

etymology.historical_story: Pecahan combines pecah, meaning to break or split, with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its meanings connect physical pieces with parts of an abstract whole: broken glass, subdivisions in a report and fractions in mathematics. This provides a useful semantic bridge for learners, although the connection alone does not establish when each meaning first developed. [DBP PRPM：pecahan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=pecahan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pecah 是“破开”，加 -an 就想到“分出来的部分”：杯子留下碎片，数字写成分数，预算列出明细。

morphology.pattern_note: pelihara 是现代马来语中的整体词根，不能拆成 pe- 与 lihara。派生时，meN- 或 peN- 在词首 p 前发生鼻音替代，p 脱落：meN- + pelihara → memelihara；peN- + pelihara → pemelihara。

word_family.gloss: 被照料；被饲养；受到维护
得到妥善照料或保护的
受照料或饲养的人或动物

senses.zh_definition: 照料、养育或护理人及其他生命，使其健康成长或得到妥善照顾。
senses.en_definition: To care for, nurture, or tend a person or other living being.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan jagaan dan layanan yang diperlukan untuk kesejahteraan atau pembesaran seseorang.
senses.nuances: 强调持续照顾，可涉及生活供养、健康和成长；不专指医疗治疗。正式主动句通常使用 memelihara；原形可用于祈使句及 saya pelihara、kita pelihara 等结构。

senses.zh_definition: 妥善经营、培育或维护事物，使其保持良好状态或持续发展。
senses.en_definition: To cultivate, maintain, or preserve something through sustained care.
senses.ms_definition: Mengurus atau mengusahakan sesuatu secara teliti agar keadaannya kekal baik.
senses.nuances: 对象可为语言、文化、农作物、社会关系或公共秩序。用于保护自然或文化时，不自动包含修复已受损对象的意思；pemuliharaan 更明确涉及恢复与保护。

senses.zh_definition: 饲养动物，持续提供食物、住所及日常照顾。
senses.en_definition: To keep or rear animals by providing for their needs.
senses.ms_definition: Menjaga haiwan dengan menyediakan makanan, tempat tinggal dan keperluannya.
senses.nuances: 适用于宠物和牲畜。memelihara 不必然涉及繁殖；表达以生产或商业为目的的养殖时，menternak 通常更具体。

senses.zh_definition: 供养或维持与妾、情妇等的关系。
senses.en_definition: To keep and support a concubine or mistress.
senses.ms_definition: Menanggung kehidupan gundik atau perempuan simpanan dalam hubungan sedemikian.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录的特定义项，多见于历史叙述或涉及供养关系的语境。下列搭配用于识别这一旧有用法，不属于现代中性高频表达，也不能泛指照顾女性。

senses.zh_definition: 留养头发、胡须等，使其持续生长。
senses.en_definition: To grow or retain hair, a beard, or similar bodily hair.
senses.ms_definition: Membenarkan rambut atau bulu badan terus tumbuh tanpa dicukur atau dipotong pendek.
senses.nuances: 这里强调留长或保留，而非单纯清洗护理。描述日常留胡须时，也常使用 menyimpan janggut。

senses.zh_definition: 保护或保全，使人或事物免遭危险、灾祸或损害。
senses.en_definition: To safeguard someone or something against danger, misfortune, or harm.
senses.ms_definition: Menghindarkan seseorang atau sesuatu daripada ancaman, bencana atau kerosakan.
senses.nuances: 与一般维护义有重叠，但更强调免受具体威胁。常见结构为 memelihara X daripada Y；祈愿中可用 Semoga Allah memelihara…。

etymology.historical_story: Pelihara belongs to Malay's Sanskrit borrowing layer. The World Loanword Database traces Indonesian memelihara, built on the same root, to Sanskrit parihāra and associates the borrowing with early Malay contact through Indian trade and cultural exchange. That comparative evidence supports a Sanskrit connection for the Malay root, although it does not establish every intermediate sound change. [WOLD](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839411514618)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pe.li.ha.ra 的四拍配上“喂食—照料—守护—养大”四个画面，记住核心动作是持续照顾。这里只是节奏联想，不是词素拆解。

senses.en_definition: Panama, a country in Central America, formally the Republic of Panama.
senses.ms_definition: Sebuah negara di Amerika Tengah yang nama rasminya ialah Republik Panama.
senses.nuances: 属于地理专名，须大写首字母。通常指国家；提及首都时宜明确写 bandar raya Panama。此处马来语释义为编写释义，并非资料包所载的 DBP 原文。马来西亚地名规范采用 Panama 和 Republik Panama，见 [JUPEM 地名指南](https://www.jupem.gov.my/storage/upload/pdf/Garis-Panduan-Penentuan-Nama-Geografi-Malaysia-Edisi-Ketiga-%281%29-1767073506.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Panama preserves an Indigenous place name that Spanish settlers adopted for the city founded in 1519; the country subsequently inherited the city's name. Its original meaning remains disputed. Fish, butterflies and a local tree feature in different explanations, so none should be presented as a proven literal translation. See the [Panamanian embassy's account](https://embajadadepanama.org/pages/panama/toponimia.php).

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，不按马来语词缀拆分；不能拆成 pri- 与 -or。所列为非卷舌英式英语读音。输入中的 is_root 不构成马来语词根认证。

senses.zh_definition: 英语形容词：先前的；在有关时间、事件或安排之前已经存在或发生的。
senses.en_definition: Existing, occurring, or arranged before a specified time or event.
senses.ms_definition: Kata adjektif bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud telah wujud, berlaku atau diatur lebih dahulu; padanan bahasa Melayu bergantung pada konteks, termasuk terdahulu dan terlebih dahulu. Ini bukan takrif rasmi DBP bagi kata Melayu.
senses.nuances: prior notice 通常译为 notis awal；prior approval 通常译为 kelulusan terlebih dahulu。不是所有 prior 都能自然译成优先，也不能把它当作马来语优先权术语。[词义与词源](https://www.etymonline.com/word/prior)

senses.zh_definition: 英语形容词：在重要性、顺位或权利上具有先位的。
senses.en_definition: Taking precedence in importance, rank, or entitlement.
senses.ms_definition: Kata adjektif bahasa Inggeris yang menunjukkan kedudukan yang perlu didahulukan dari segi kepentingan, susunan atau hak.
senses.nuances: 此义涉及先位或优先性，须结合具体名词理解。正式马来语通常用 lebih utama、mempunyai keutamaan 等适当表达；prior 并非 priority 的任意缩写。

collocations.ms: tuntutan yang mempunyai keutamaan (Inggeris: a prior claim)
collocations.zh: 具有先位的主张或请求

collocations.ms: hak yang perlu didahulukan (Inggeris: a prior right)

senses.zh_definition: 英语固定短语 prior to 的组成部分，整个短语表示“在……之前”。
senses.en_definition: In the fixed expression prior to: before a specified time or event.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam frasa tetap bahasa Inggeris prior to, keseluruhan frasa bermaksud sebelum sesuatu waktu atau peristiwa.
senses.nuances: 这里的 preposition 标签指整个 prior to 短语的句法功能，不表示单独的 prior 通常可以直接充当介词。标准马来语采用 sebelum。

senses.zh_definition: 英语宗教职衔：某些基督宗教修会或修院的负责人，或位次在院长之后的修院职员。
senses.en_definition: A superior of certain Christian religious communities, or a monastic officer ranking below an abbot.
senses.ms_definition: Gelaran bahasa Inggeris bagi ketua sesetengah komuniti atau rumah keagamaan Kristian, atau pegawai biara yang berkedudukan di bawah abas, mengikut aturan komuniti berkenaan.
senses.nuances: 与“先前的”形容词义分开理解。实际职级依修会制度而异；以下组合说明宗教职衔用法，并非官方马来语搭配。[宗教名词的词源](https://www.etymonline.com/word/prior)

memilih seorang prior (Inggeris: elect a prior)

etymology.historical_story: Prior comes from Latin prior, meaning earlier or superior. English developed distinct uses from that relationship: something can come first in time, take precedence, or hold a leading religious office. The monastic noun entered English through medieval transmission, while the adjective reflects Latin directly. Neither history establishes prior as a standard Malay word. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/prior)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prior 和 priority 联想为“排在前”：时间上在前是先前，顺位上在前是优先。两者相关，但不能互相随意替换。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary records pelawa through mempelawa and pelawaan, linking the word to inviting and receiving an invitation. Its supplied example involves offering someone tea, a concrete setting for learning the meaning through hospitality. This evidence supports its social use, but does not establish a donor language or an early historical date. The initial pe is part of the root.

etymology.historical_story: Perhambaan is formed from hamba, a word whose dictionary meanings include both an enslaved person and a humble first-person self-reference. That contrast reveals how Malay vocabulary can encode social hierarchy as well as personal identity. The circumfix per-...-an turns the base into a noun naming the condition or practice, rather than the person experiencing it. [DBP: hamba](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=hamba)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 hamba＝奴仆：per- 把它引入一个状态，-an 收成名词，合起来就是“为奴的处境或制度”。

morphology.pattern_note: 实际构词词根为 tentu。peN- 接以 t 开头的本族词根时，鼻音表现为 n，词根首音 t 脱落，形成 penentu。root_word 和 root_jawi 按数据包保留。

senses.nuances: 可指有决定权的人，也可指决定结果的条件。与 penentuan（决定或确定的过程）不同。在 faktor penentu 中，penentu 修饰因素的作用，整体表示决定性因素。释义依据 [DBP: penentu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=178260&keyword=penentu)。

senses.zh_definition: 语法中的限定成分，用于界定名词短语所指，例如马来语中的 ini 和 itu。

senses.ms_definition: Unsur yang menentukan rujukan frasa nama, seperti 'ini' dan 'itu' dalam bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: 这是语法术语。马来语语法中的 penentu belakang 指位于名词短语后部的限定成分。具体分类须结合所采用的语法体系，不能把英语限定词的全部位置规则直接移植过来。参见 [DBP 语法答疑](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penentu)。

etymology.historical_story: Penentu shows how Malay builds an agent or determining entity from an idea of certainty. Its base tentu means certain, fixed, or definite. Adding peN- produces the person or thing that makes an outcome definite. The same family distinguishes penentu, the determinant, from penentuan, the act of determining, and ketentuan, an established provision or certainty. [DBP: tentu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=tentu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tentu＝确定；penentu＝让结果确定下来的人或因素。记住 t 换成 n：peN- + tentu → penentu。

morphology.pattern_note: peN-...-an 构成行为或过程名词；在 j 前，前缀写作 pen-，词根首字母 j 保留。

etymology.historical_story: Penjelajahan is transparently formed from jelajah with the Malay action-noun circumfix peN-...-an. DBP's dictionary illustrates it with aircraft used for Arctic exploration, while its related entries also describe journeys across regions and into space. These examples connect a familiar act of travelling around with scientific exploration; they do not establish the root's earliest historical origin. Source: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=jelajah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: jelajah 是「走遍探索」；pen-...-an 把动作装成一个过程：penjelajahan＝整趟探索活动。

etymology.historical_story: Paula belongs to a Roman naming tradition: it is the feminine counterpart of Paulus, a name associated with the Latin adjective meaning small. A fourth-century saint named Paula was a companion of Jerome. Its presence across European languages explains why the same spelling can have several pronunciations. These origins describe the name, not its bearer's personality. [Sources: Paula](https://www.behindthename.com/name/paula), [Paul](https://www.behindthename.com/name/paul).

etymology.historical_story: Pappu belongs to Telugu food vocabulary. In Andhra and Telangana cooking, the name appears in dishes made with pulses and vegetables. Andhra Pradesh tourism describes a tamarind-leaf pappu, while a Malaysian restaurant lists tomato and spinach versions. These sources establish a culinary connection, but do not establish when the name entered Malay or whether it became a standardized loanword. See [Andhra Pradesh tourism](https://tourism.ap.gov.in/assets/img/Brochures/Konaseema%20Brochure.pdf) and [Ishtaa](https://www.ishtaa.my/zh/).

etymology.historical_story: Pingsan and pengsan show why neighbouring standard languages need separate usage labels. Indonesian dictionaries use pingsan, while Malaysian dictionary materials use pengsan for unconsciousness. Their correspondence is useful to learners encountering cross-border messages, films, and news. The consulted sources establish this regional distinction, but do not establish a deeper historical derivation. Sources: [KBBI](https://kbbi.kemendikdasmen.go.id/entri/pingsan), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=pengsan).

etymology.historical_story: Paman belongs to the shared vocabulary of kinship across the Malay–Indonesian region. Adelaar's comparative study identifies it as a Javanese loan. Its extension from a family relationship to respectful address illustrates how kinship language can express social closeness. Pamanku adds the possessive clitic -ku, making the relationship explicitly the speaker's. [Source](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/16357/1/Bahasa%20Melayik%20Purba.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分两块记：paman“叔叔”＋ku“我的”＝pamanku“我的叔叔”；不必硬套汉语亲属辈分。

morphology.pattern_note: 输入的 root_word pengawal 保留作关联词记录；实际基础词根是 kawal。peN- 在 kawal 前实现为 peng-，词首 /k/ 脱落，形成 /pəŋawal an/；pengawalan 表示行为或过程，不能简单释为“pengawal 加 -an”。

senses.zh_definition: 为保障人员、场所或活动安全而实施的守卫、警戒或护卫工作。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of guarding or providing security.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau perbuatan mengawal untuk menjaga keselamatan orang, tempat atau kegiatan.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 总释义“perihal (perbuatan) mengawal”在安全语境中的教学细分，并非另引独立词典义项。pengawalan 指守卫行为；pengawal 指执行者。[DBP：kawal 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=kawal)

senses.zh_definition: 为使过程有序、使情况保持在一定范围内或防止不良情况扩展而实施的控制、监督或防治。
senses.en_definition: The process of controlling, regulating or containing something.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan mengawasi atau mengatur sesuatu supaya teratur, terbatas atau tidak merebak.
senses.nuances: 这是同一总释义在管理、防治等语境中的细分。pengawalan 强调实施过程；kawalan 也常用于措施、制度或控制状态，两者须结合惯用搭配选择。

etymology.historical_story: Malay uses kawal for guarding and supervision, and builds a productive family around it. Pengawal names a person who guards, while pengawalan names the activity. Modern usage extends that activity from protecting entrances to controlling disease or pests. The peN-...-an construction and the loss of initial k explain the form without requiring an invented historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕 kawal“看守、控制”记三兄弟：mengawal“去控制”、pengawal“控制的人”、pengawalan“控制这件事”；遇到 peng-，被替换的 k 藏起来了。

morphology.pattern_note: 施事或工具名词前缀 peN- 在 r 前呈 pe-，保留词根首音 r；不能因表面出现 per- 就切分成 per- + awat。首音节 pe 读 /pə/。

etymology.historical_story: Perawat belongs to the rawat family, whose meanings connect treatment with continuing care and maintenance. Its range offers a useful cultural insight: Malay can describe both a person caring for someone and a substance treating an object with the same derived noun. Technical terminology extends this pattern to treatment equipment, including vessels used in petroleum processing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 rawat＝照护、处理；peN- 标出“做这件事的人或工具”。看到 perawat，先问：是谁在照护，或什么在处理？

etymology.historical_story: A useful cultural thread links a parent's remembered advice with a customer's requested purchase: both involve something entrusted to another person. Malay expresses these established meanings through pesanan, formed from pesan with -an. Adding -nya identifies whose message or order is meant, or reconnects it with someone already mentioned. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250764&keyword=pesanan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认 pesanan「嘱咐／订单」，再加 -nya「其」：pesanannya＝其嘱咐／其订单。

morphology.formula: pemilik + -an → pemilikan；基础词族：peN- + milik + -an → pemilikan
morphology.pattern_note: 保留词包的近接基底 pemilik；基础词根为 milik。按 peN-…-an 分析时，peN- 在 /m/ 前呈 pe-，原有 /m/ 保留，不增添第二个 /m/。

etymology.historical_story: Pemilikan belongs to the productive Malay family built around milik. The family separates a thing's belonging, its owner, and the state of owning it through related forms. In administrative writing, this distinction makes pemilikan useful when discussing land, homes, shares, and businesses without confusing ownership with the person who owns them.

etymology.historical_story: Payne developed from a medieval personal name found in Middle English and Old French, ultimately connected with Latin Paganus. The older word had rural associations and later religious ones, but those associations had faded in its use as a personal name. A modern surname therefore identifies a family rather than describing its bearer’s beliefs. [Dictionary of American Family Names](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Payne)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Payne 常读 /peɪn/，与英语 pain 同音；把它记成姓氏“佩恩”，不要翻译成“疼痛”。

etymology.historical_story: Pancuran is formed from pancur with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its dictionary senses connect flowing water, the outlet carrying it, and the place where people collect it. The older example involving bamboo water containers evokes village water collection, while modern compounds such as pancuran mandian apply the same vocabulary to bathroom fittings.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pancur 想成“水喷出”，加 -an 后抓住三个画面：喷出的水、出水的装置、接水的地方。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根以 b 起首时，peN- 的鼻音成分实现为 m，形成 pem-，词根 b 保留。输入包将 pembatalan 标为词根，实际应分析为 batal 的派生名词。

word_family.gloss: 失效；处于被取消的状态

senses.zh_definition: 取消、撤销或使某事失效的行为或过程；可指取消原定安排，也可指撤销协议、规定等的效力。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of cancelling something or rendering it invalid.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal (tindakan, perbuatan, dan sebagainya) membatalkan.
senses.nuances: 这是行为名词，不表示执行取消的人。可用于航班、预订、活动及协议等；具体译为 cancellation、revocation 或 annulment，须依对象和上下文判断。与 penangguhan（延期、暂缓）不同，pembatalan 表示原安排被取消或原效力被撤销。定义依据：[DBP PRPM：batal 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=batal)。

etymology.historical_story: Pembatalan illustrates how Malay builds an action noun from batal through the circumfix peN-...-an. Before b, the nasal component takes the form m, producing pem-. The dictionary groups pembatalan with batal and membatalkan. This connection helps readers recognise cancellation language across travel notices, booking systems, and administrative correspondence. Source: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=batal).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 batal＝取消，再套上 pem-...-an：从“取消”变成“取消这件事”。读 pem-ba-ta-lan，b 保留，前面接 m。

morphology.formula: ∅ + perakaunan → perakaunan（保留资料包的整词检索根标注）；实际构词：per- + akaun + -an → perakaunan
morphology.pattern_note: is_root、root_word 与 root_jawi 按资料包保留，仅代表其整词检索标注。语言学上可分析为 akaun 加 per-...-an，并非不可再分的词根；前缀末尾 /r/ 与其后的元音连读。资料包的 per.a.kau.nan 与实际语音分节 pe.ra.kau.nan 可以并存。

senses.zh_definition: 会计；对财务交易进行记录、分类、汇总和报告的工作或学科。用于名词后时表示与账目或会计有关。
senses.en_definition: Accounting: the practice or discipline of recording, classifying, summarising, and reporting financial transactions; also used attributively for matters relating to accounts.

etymology.historical_story: Perakaunan shows how Malay builds a specialised field term around akaun: the per-...-an construction connects individual accounts with the broader work of accounting. The dictionary groups it with akaun, while professional usage extends across systems, procedures and reporting. This formation is clearer than treating the whole word as historically indivisible. See [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=Akaun).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 akaun＝账目，再用 per-...-an 把“账目”扩展成“处理账目的工作领域”：perakaunan＝会计。

morphology.formula: pantat + -ku → pantatku（我的臀部／肛门／女性生殖器，依语境而定）
morphology.pattern_note: -ku是aku的附着代词，表示第一人称领属，并非派生后缀；词基不发生音变。数据包的ڤنتت仅表示pantat，未写出-ku；音节字段保留数据包的null，实际可分为pan.tat.ku。

etymology.historical_story: Pantatku combines pantat with the attached first-person pronoun -ku. Kamus Dewan records bodily meanings alongside the underside of objects, including cups and kettles. This juxtaposition offers a useful image: a body and a vessel both have a bottom. It does not establish which meaning arose first or identify a historical borrowing source.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记pantat是身体或物体的“底部”，再加-ku“我的”；身体具体所指靠语境判断。

etymology.historical_story: Penyepit is formed within Malay from sepit and the instrument-forming prefix peN-. Its meanings connect the gripping action of tools, chopsticks, and animal pincers. DBP’s encyclopedia also identifies sepit as an eating utensil used in many Asian countries. The Malay name therefore describes how the implement works rather than simply adopting the Chinese name for chopsticks.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sepit是“夹”，peN-造工具名：penyepit就是“用来夹的东西”；餐桌上一双就是筷子。

etymology.historical_story: English pollard belongs historically to the family of poll, meaning to cut or trim the head or top. Earlier uses concerned hornless animals, followed by trees cut back above the ground. A separate established milling sense names fine wheat by-products. These meanings should be learned separately; the evidence does not justify inventing a direct story connecting tree pruning with animal feed. [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/pollard)

etymology.historical_story: English plumber ultimately comes from Latin plumbum, meaning lead, through words for a person who worked with that metal. Lead was historically used in pipework, so the occupational name remained as materials changed. This history also explains the otherwise puzzling written b, which is silent in ordinary modern English pronunciation. See [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/plumber).

etymology.historical_story: Penjajah is transparently formed from jajah with the agent-forming prefix peN-. Its word family distinguishes the ruler, penjajah, from the action or system, penjajahan, and the act of ruling, menjajah. In Malaysian historical discussion, these distinctions help describe colonial power and resistance. The noun identifies a relationship of domination rather than merely someone's foreign birthplace. See [DBP: penjajah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penjajah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: peN- 标出“做这件事的主体”：jajah 是殖民统治，penjajah 就是实行殖民统治者。记住末尾 h，别与 penjaja“小贩”混淆。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根以 s 开头；加上 peN- 时，s 脱落，鼻音实现为 ny /ɲ/，形成 penyingkir-，再接 -an。

etymology.historical_story: Penyingkiran is formed within Malay from singkir through the productive peN-…-an construction. Its meanings connect setting something aside with removing people from positions, eliminating competitors, and moving away from danger. These connections explain its range without requiring a separate foreign origin for each sense. DBP records both removal and evacuation. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=singkir)

etymology.historical_story: Paramedik belongs to the international vocabulary of organised medical care. Its Malaysian dictionary meaning highlights work that assists or complements medicine, including nursing, laboratory assistance and therapy. This broader picture matters: although an ambulance scene readily brings the word to mind, the Malay dictionary does not restrict it to ambulance personnel.

etymology.historical_story: Perkawinan illustrates how closely related national languages can retain different written forms for familiar institutions. Indonesian uses kawin and perkawinan, while Malaysian Malay commonly uses kahwin and perkahwinan. DBP’s regional terminology tables place these forms alongside one another. The shared nominal pattern makes their relationship easy to recognise without treating either national spelling as universally interchangeable.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kawin＝结婚；per-…-an 把动作变成“婚姻之事”。马来西亚对应词多一个 h：perkahwinan。

senses.zh_definition: 某一地区的原住民或世居民族成员；在马来西亚规范普通行文中对应 peribumi。
senses.en_definition: An indigenous inhabitant or a member of a people native to a region; corresponding to standard Malaysian Malay peribumi.
senses.ms_definition: Penduduk asal sesuatu wilayah; bentuk yang dirujukkan kepada peribumi dalam bahasa Melayu baku Malaysia.
senses.nuances: pribumi 是印尼语常用词形，也见于马来西亚文本及专名。DBP 查询将其引向 peribumi，因此不将该拼写标为马来西亚规范普通词条。作 masyarakat pribumi 等名词修饰结构时表达原住民族属性；不等于凡在当地出生的人，也不单凭此词判断行政身份。参见 [DBP：pribumi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pribumi) 与 [DBP：peribumi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=peribumi)。

etymology.historical_story: Pribumi illustrates how closely related languages can favour different written forms. It is familiar in Indonesian and also appears in Malaysian writing, while DBP directs Malaysian users to peribumi. For learners, the cultural lesson is practical: recognise the shared reference to indigenous peoples, but follow local spelling conventions and preserve the wording of names and quotations.

etymology.historical_story: Pepijat brings several dictionary histories together under one spelling. Its insect sense is linked to pijat and pijat-pijat; technical usage also covers computer defects and concealed listening devices, paralleling English bug. A separate botanical entry names a Prunus tree. Keeping that plant entry distinct prevents an attractive but unsupported story connecting every meaning to the insect.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 给 pepijat 配四幅图：床垫上的臭虫、电脑里的错误、桌下的窃听器、标有 Prunus 的树。前三者可借英语 bug 联想，树名另记。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此通常是第三人称领属附着代词，表示他／她的；ny 读作单一腭鼻音 /ɲ/，不是 /n/ 加 /j/。词干不变；输入 Jawi 仅表示 pacar。

etymology.historical_story: Pacar presents a memorable dictionary crossroads: DBP records plant names under one homonym and a Jakarta-labelled word for a sweetheart under another. Adding -nya can therefore describe someone's partner or, in a suitable gardening context, someone's henna. This contrast does not establish a historical connection between romance and dyeing plants. The [DBP entries](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=pacar) keep those meanings separate.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pacar 当成“恋人”整体记忆，尾巴 -nya 表示“他／她的”；遇到 daun、pokok、kuku，再检查是否进入植物义。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是随外来族称进入马来语的构词关系，不能据此任意用 -i 创造马来语族名。j 读 /dʒ/；规范正文写 Punjabi，首字母大写。

senses.ms_definition: Bangsa yang berasal dari Punjab, India.
senses.nuances: 马来语正文通常写 orang Punjabi 或 masyarakat Punjabi。所列马来语释义沿用《Kamus Dewan》；现代广义的旁遮普地区横跨印度和巴基斯坦，族群身份也包括海外社群。Punjabi 是族群或文化称谓，Sikh 是宗教身份，不能直接等同。[DBP：Punjabi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=punjabi)

senses.nuances: 此为语言名称用法的说明性释义；马来语通常明确写 bahasa Punjabi。不可与 bahasa Hindi、bahasa Tamil 或 bahasa Urdu 混为一谈。[UKM：旁遮普语研究](https://ptsldigital.ukm.my/handle/123456789/459349)

etymology.historical_story: Punjabi takes its name from Punjab. That place name comes from Persian panj, meaning five, and āb, meaning water, referring to the region's rivers. The name therefore carries a geographical memory. Punjabi identifies a people and their language across a region now divided between India and Pakistan. [Encyclopaedia Iranica: Punjabi](https://www.iranicaonline.org/articles/punjabi-indo-aryan-language/?generate_pdf=1)

etymology.historical_story: This noun grows from ubah suai, meaning to alter something so that it suits a need. Malay wraps the compound in peN-...-an to name the process. The spelling also changes: the base has two words, but the resulting noun is written as one, reflecting a standard Malay compound-word rule. [DBP: compound spelling](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2025/05/07/18069/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ubah 是改变，suai 联想 sesuai 的合适；peng- 和 -an 把改变到合适变成名词：修改、改造的过程。

morphology.pattern_note: pe- 是 peN- 在 /r/ 前的形式，词根的 /r/ 保留。输入将词根解析为 asa 有误；PRPM 将 perasa 列于 rasa 的派生词中，故修正为 rasa。依据：[PRPM：perasa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=perasa)。

etymology.historical_story: Perasa illustrates how Malay connects bodily sensation, emotion, and cooking through rasa. A tongue detects taste, a sensitive person responds strongly to feelings, and seasoning gives a dish its taste. These dictionary senses share a recognisable semantic centre. The correct morphological base is rasa; splitting the word down to asa would obscure that connection. [PRPM: rasa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=rasa)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 rasa“味道／感受”：器官负责感受，人容易受触动，调味料负责添味。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着成分，此处按给定结构归入后缀；词根不变，ny 表示 /ɲ/。headword.jawi 按输入保留，但 ڤاݢي 实际只拼写 pagi；完整 paginya 应为 ڤاݢيڽ。输入未提供完整词形的音节划分。

senses.en_definition: The morning of the day referred to; used in temporal phrases for that morning or the following morning, depending on context.
senses.ms_definition: Waktu pagi pada hari yang dirujuk, dengan rujukan harinya ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: -nya 可回指语境中的日期，不必译为“他的”。paginya 本身不固定表示“明早”；翌日之义在 keesokan paginya 中才明确。词性为名词，整个时间短语可以作状语。输入的 DBP 释义对应词根 pagi，以上完整词形释义为编辑归纳。[DBP：pagi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=pagi)。

senses.ms_definition: Waktu pagi yang dikaitkan dengan orang atau perkara yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 此时 -nya 表示所属或关联。中文、英文是否使用物主形式取决于上下文；不能把所有 paginya 都机械译成“他的早晨”。

etymology.historical_story: Paginya is formed within Malay from pagi and the attached element -nya. Its meaning follows the surrounding story: a morning can belong to someone’s routine or to a day already mentioned. In keesokan paginya, that reference helps carry a narrative from one day into the next. No separate borrowing history is needed to explain this form.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pagi 是“早晨”，-nya 像一根回指线：先找它指向哪一天或哪个人，再理解 paginya。

morphology.formula: peN- + cabar → pencabar（发起挑战的人或一方）
morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在 c 前表现为 pen-；词根开头的 c 保留，形成 pencabar。该前缀在这里构成施事名词。

senses.zh_definition: 挑战者；向他人、既有地位或权威发起挑战的个人、团体或一方。
senses.en_definition: A person, group, or party that challenges another's position, authority, or supremacy.
senses.ms_definition: Orang (pihak, golongan, dan sebagainya) yang mencabar.
senses.nuances: 可用于体育、政治和商业竞争。强调主动挑战的角色，不必然表示敌意，也不等于已经获胜。pencabar 指挑战的一方；cabaran 指挑战或考验本身。定义依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pencabar)。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 体育报道中通常中性；在职场直接称某人为 pencabar，可能突出对立关系。一般合作场合可按语境选用 pesaing。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 体育报道中通常中性；在职场直接称某人为 pencabar，可能突出对立关系。一般合作场合可按语境选用 pesaing。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合描述明确的竞争或挑战关系。不要把提出普通建议的同事直接称为 pencabar，也不要用来指任务本身的难度；后者用 cabaran。

etymology.historical_story: Pencabar illustrates a productive Malay word-building pattern: a prefix turns the action associated with cabar into the person or party performing it. This makes the word useful wherever someone contests an established position, from a championship to political leadership. Its meaning follows from Malay morphology; no particular sporting event needs to be invented as its origin. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pencabar).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cabar 是“挑战”，peN- 把动作变成角色：pencabar 就是“挑战的人”。

morphology.pattern_note: 国际心理学借词，在现代马来语中作为完整词根使用；para- 与 -ia 不在此分析为马来语词缀。IPA 表示逐元音的清晰读法，音节栏保留资料包形式。

word_family.gloss: 偏执多疑的；患有偏执症状的人，与 paranoia 为相关借词

senses.zh_definition: 偏执性精神障碍或状态，表现为妄想，例如坚信自己地位非凡，或别人一直企图威胁、迫害自己。
senses.en_definition: A mental disorder or state involving delusions, such as exaggerated personal importance or persistent beliefs of persecution.
senses.ms_definition: Gangguan mental yang menyebabkan seseorang mengkhayalkan perkara yang aneh-aneh, seperti merasa dirinya terlalu penting atau percaya bahawa orang lain sentiasa mengancamnya.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 的心理学词义，不能直接当作现代临床诊断标准；paranoia 也可指症状或状态，不一定是独立疾病。中文不能简单等同于普通的“固执”。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=aneh)；[APA 术语说明](https://dictionary.apa.org/paranoia)。

senses.zh_definition: 对他人过度恐惧、猜疑或不信任的心理状态。
senses.en_definition: Excessive fear, suspicion, or distrust of other people.
senses.ms_definition: Perasaan takut, curiga atau tidak percaya terhadap orang lain dengan berlebih-lebihan.
senses.nuances: 可用于非临床描述，但语气比 bimbang 或 curiga 强。单次担心、合理警觉或有依据的不信任，不宜轻率称为 paranoia。它是名词，描述“某人多疑”通常使用形容词 paranoid。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=aneh)；[paranoid 的词义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=paranoid)。

dual_scenarios.en: The report distinguishes ordinary worry from paranoia involving extreme suspicion of other people.

dual_scenarios.en: I just read about paranoia. It turns out it's more than ordinary worry.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 心理健康语境宜说 seseorang yang mengalami paranoia，先指人再说明状态。避免用词语嘲笑、否定或羞辱当事人。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于心理学讨论、健康教育或谨慎的状态描述。不要仅凭聊天内容给他人下诊断，也不要把合理的安全顾虑斥为 paranoia。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 心理健康语境宜说 seseorang yang mengalami paranoia，先指人再说明状态。避免用词语嘲笑、否定或羞辱当事人。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于心理学讨论、健康教育或谨慎的状态描述。不要仅凭聊天内容给他人下诊断，也不要把合理的安全顾虑斥为 paranoia。

etymology.historical_story: Paranoia belongs to an international psychological vocabulary whose history reaches back to Greek paranoia, a word associated with mental disturbance. Its historical elements connect para with being beside or beyond, and noos with mind. Later psychiatric usage gave the term more specialised meanings involving delusions; broader everyday usage also developed around excessive suspicion and distrust. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/paranoia).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 paranoia 的核心画面：脑中的警报一直响，把别人普通的举动也看成威胁；这是意义联想，不是马来语词根拆解。

morphology.pattern_note: 按有历史记录的植物名称整体处理，无已核实的现代马来语派生分析；IPA 是依拼写推定的读音，并非来源包提供的实录。

senses.zh_definition: 一种植物的历史马来名称，旧资料对应 Clerodendron inermis，现代对应物种为苦郎树 Volkameria inermis，亦见异名 Clerodendrum inerme。
senses.en_definition: A historically recorded Malay plant name for Volkameria inermis, also known as Clerodendrum inerme.
senses.ms_definition: Nama tumbuhan yang direkodkan dalam sumber Melayu lama bagi spesies yang kini dikenali sebagai Volkameria inermis, dengan sinonim Clerodendrum inerme.
senses.nuances: 植物名 pawan 见于 [Crawfurd 1852 年马来语词典](https://wallace-online.org/converted/pdf/1852_Crawfurd_WS5.2.pdf)，其中采用旧学名 Clerodendron inermis。现代物种名称及 bunga pawang 这一俗名可参见 [NParks](https://www.nparks.gov.sg/florafaunaweb/flora/1/8/1823)。尚未核实其现代 DBP 规范词条地位；马来语释义为编辑编写。下列搭配为植物义的教学组合，不宣称具有高频语料依据。不能仅凭拼写把它改成 pawang，也不能排除原文实际使用同形专名的可能。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于历史词汇、植物名称和资料考证语境。原文若将 Pawan 用作人名或地名，应保留专名并另行辨认，不能自动套用植物义。

etymology.historical_story: An 1852 Malay dictionary records pawan as a plant name and identifies it using the botanical name Clerodendron inermis. Modern botanical references place the corresponding species under Volkameria inermis and also list Clerodendrum inerme as a synonym. This provides a documented historical identification, but it does not establish the deeper origin of the Malay name or its present-day frequency. [Historical source: Crawfurd](https://wallace-online.org/converted/pdf/1852_Crawfurd_WS5.2.pdf); [modern taxonomy: NParks](https://www.nparks.gov.sg/florafaunaweb/flora/1/8/1823).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pa-wan 和 pokok pawan 一起读，记住“旧词典中的植物名”；末尾是 /n/，不要读成 pawang 的 /ŋ/。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 遇词根起首 t 时，t 脱落，鼻音实现为 n：pen- + indas + -an → penindasan。输入将本词标为词根有误；实际词根为 tindas。

word_family.gloss: 压迫造成的结果；另有副本义

senses.zh_definition: 压迫、欺压或强力压制的行为；尤指凭借权力不公正地控制、剥削或限制他人及其自由。
senses.en_definition: The act of oppressing, exploiting, or forcibly suppressing people, their rights, or their freedoms.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan menindas.
senses.nuances: 带明显负面评价，常见于劳工、社会不公及自由受压制的讨论。它是行为名词，不能直接代替动词 menindas。具体指压迫还是镇压，须看宾语与语境。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=282080&keyword=penindasan) [词根及派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=tindas)

etymology.historical_story: Penindasan illustrates Malay's productive way of naming an action through peN-...-an. Its base, tindas, includes physical pressing as well as oppressive or coercive treatment. That semantic connection makes pressure a useful image for understanding the noun. This is an account of its present morphological structure, rather than a claim about an undocumented borrowing or historical first use. [DBP root entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=tindas)

etymology.historical_story: Pancung brings together several dictionary senses involving an end, a pointed shape, or cutting. Traditional cloth descriptions preserve meanings that learners may miss when they first encounter hukum pancung. DBP also records a separate cake name. These entries document usage, but do not establish that the cake was historically named after cutting or beheading. [DBP entries](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=pancung)

etymology.historical_story: Palsukan combines the borrowed base palsu with the Malay suffix -kan. Palsu comes from Portuguese falso, meaning false, reflecting the vocabulary exchanged through Portuguese contact with the Malay world. The borrowed adjective became productive within Malay grammar, yielding verbs for falsifying things and nouns referring to falsification, falsifiers, and falseness. [UNESCO-hosted study](https://en.unesco.org/silkroad/sites/default/files/knowledge-bank-article/portuguese_words_in_the_malay_language.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Pejamkan is transparently formed within Malay from pejam, referring to closed eyes, and the suffix -kan. Its relationship with memejamkan and terpejam makes the contrast between an action and a resulting state easy to see. Closing the eyes also provides an intuitive metaphor for deliberately ignoring something; no particular date for that extension is established here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pejam 表示‘眼睛闭着’，加 -kan 就想到‘把眼睛闭上’；Pejamkan mata!＝闭上眼睛！

etymology.historical_story: Pushkin is the Latin-script rendering of the Russian surname Пушкин. Its familiar literary association comes from Aleksandr Pushkin, whose works include the verse novel Eugene Onegin. The [Metropolitan Opera biography](https://www.metopera.org/discover/education/educator-guides/eugene-onegin/the-life-and-work-of-alexander-pushkin/) connects that work with its later operatic adaptation. For Malay learners, the name should be remembered whole; its spelling provides no basis for identifying Malay prefixes or suffixes.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Pushkin → 普希金 → 俄罗斯诗人：直接把姓名、人物与作品相连，不拆成英语 push，也不当作马来语派生词。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此为表示第三人称领属关系的后附代词，与前词连写，严格说属于附着语素；ny 读 /ɲ/，不是 /n/ 加 /j/。输入 Jawi 为基本词 peguam 的拼写；完整 peguamnya 写作 ڤݢوامڽ。

etymology.historical_story: Peguamnya is a grammatical combination rather than a separate historical profession name. It joins peguam, meaning lawyer, to the third-person form -nya. Malay writes this dependent pronoun together with the preceding noun. The resulting expression identifies whose lawyer is meant while leaving that person's gender unstated, a useful feature in reporting and everyday reference.

etymology.historical_story: Penyodok belongs to the Malay sodok family, which connects a digging implement with the action of digging or scooping. The prefix peN- supplies an instrument noun, while menyodok names the corresponding action. DBP records sodok itself as a synonym of penyodok, preserving both the shorter implement name and the derived form in the same vocabulary. [DBP：sodok](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=sodok)

etymology.historical_story: Pendorong belongs to the dorong family, linking physical pushing with encouragement. Its dictionary senses preserve both a device that moves something forward and a person or factor that inspires action. This shared image makes the word useful in discussions of machinery, education, personal achievement and economic development. [DBP](https://ekamus.dbp.gov.my/Makna.aspx?kid=219558)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: dorong 是“推”，peN- 把动作变成推动者：pendorong，就是把你往前推的人或力量。

etymology.historical_story: Peredaran belongs to the Malay family built on edar, expressing movement, circulation and change. Its meanings connect several familiar experiences: heavenly bodies travel around an orbit, money passes between people, and circumstances change with time. The expression peredaran zaman makes that connection especially memorable, presenting historical change through the vocabulary of movement. This explains its semantic range without claiming an undocumented origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 edar 记作“转、流转”：per- + edar + -an，把动作变成“循环、流通、变迁”这一过程。

etymology.historical_story: Prasad belongs to a religious vocabulary associated with Sanskrit prasāda, meaning grace or favour. Its cultural significance lies in a cycle of giving: food is offered to a deity, then received by worshippers as a blessing. The same food acquires a devotional meaning through the offering, rather than through any particular recipe. [BAPS explanation](https://londonmandir.baps.org/worship/thal/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prasad 和一个画面绑定：先供奉，再领受；入口的是食物，承载的是祝福。

etymology.historical_story: Paulus is the Latin form corresponding to Paul. The Latin adjective paulus means little or small, providing the historical lexical connection behind the name. Once used as a personal name, however, Paulus identifies a person rather than describing that person's size. Its etymological meaning must therefore remain separate from its function in a Malay sentence. [Paulus：姓名来源](https://www.behindthename.com/name/paulus)；[Lewis and Short：paulus](https://atlas.perseus.tufts.edu/dictionaries/entry/urn%3Acite2%3Ascaife-viewer%3Adictionary-entries.atlas_v1%3Alat.ls.perseus-eng2-n34193/)。

etymology.historical_story: Patel connects a family name with an older administrative office. Historical descriptions identify a patel as a village headman who managed local affairs and dealt with government officers. The surname preserves that occupational background, but a modern bearer need not hold any village office. In Malay writing, capitalizing Patel helps distinguish a person's name from discussion of the historical title. [Source: Hobson-Jobson](https://www.bibliomania.com/2/3/260/1283/20157/1.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 小写 patel 联想到历史村长；大写 Patel 联想到姓氏帕特尔。

morphology.pattern_note: peN-遇到词首s时通常变为peny-，原来的s脱落；ny表示单一辅音/ɲ/。本词表示执行吸入功能的事物或器具。资料包将penyedut列为词根有误，DBP将其列在sedut的派生词下。[DBP：sedut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=sedut)。

word_family.gloss: 吸入的一口；吸取的结果；节选

senses.zh_definition: 通过吸力吸入空气、液体、灰尘等的器具、装置或结构。
senses.en_definition: A device or structure that draws something in by suction.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu, seperti alat, yang menyedut.
senses.nuances: 核心含义是“具有抽吸功能的东西”，并不只指饮料吸管。具体器具通常由后面的名词说明，例如penyedut habuk指吸尘器。[DBP：penyedut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=penyedut)。

senses.zh_definition: 饮料吸管；通过口吸使饮料进入口中的细管。
senses.en_definition: A drinking straw: a narrow tube through which a drink is sucked into the mouth.
senses.ms_definition: Pembuluh untuk menyedut minuman, khususnya dalam ungkapan penyedut air batu.
senses.nuances: 在点饮料的情境中，penyedut常可单独表示吸管。DBP记录的penyedut air batu也是吸管的称呼；这里不是指吸取整块冰。日常交流中也常听到英语straw。[DBP：penyedut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=penyedut)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 在饮料店可直接说penyedut；在采购、维修或工作说明中应补上用途，如penyedut habuk或penyedut asap，以免混淆。

etymology.historical_story: Penyedut illustrates productive Malay word formation rather than an exotic borrowing. Starting with sedut, meaning to suck or draw in, the prefix peN- creates a noun for something performing that function. The same transparent idea connects a drinking straw with a vacuum cleaner: their shapes differ, but both work by drawing material inward. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=sedut).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sedut＝吸，peN-＝执行动作的人或工具；penyedut就是“负责吸的东西”。吸饮料的是吸管，吸灰尘的是吸尘器。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 遇词根首音 /k/ 时实现为 peng-，词根开头的 k 脱落；后缀 -an 构成表示减少行为、过程或结果的名词。

senses.zh_definition: 减少；削减；数量、程度、规模或费用的缩减，以及使其缩减的行为或过程。
senses.en_definition: The act, process, or result of reducing an amount, degree, size, or cost.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau perbuatan mengurangi atau mengurangkan sesuatu; penyusutan.
senses.nuances: 强调相对于原有水平的减少，不必然表示不足。pengurangan kos 是成本降低；kekurangan wang 是资金不足。常见于行政、商业及公共议题。[DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pengurangan)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 语体中性偏正式，适合报告和商务沟通。询问优惠时，Boleh saya mendapatkan pengurangan harga? 比直接要求 Kurangkan harga! 更客气。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 谈工资、福利或人员削减时，应明确减少的对象与幅度。pengurangan pekerja 涉及人员数量削减，可能令人担忧，不宜用于含糊的安抚性表达。

etymology.historical_story: Pengurangan belongs to the Malay family built around kurang, expressing lessness or insufficiency. Its circumfix turns that everyday idea into a noun for reduction. The useful cultural distinction is between making something smaller and having too little: a report may welcome pengurangan kos while warning against kekurangan kakitangan. These describe different situations, despite sharing the same base. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengurangkan+1)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 kurang“少”：mengurangkan 是“使它变少”，pengurangan 是“减少这件事”；kekurangan 才是“不够”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根以鼻音 m 开头时，peN- 在此实现为 pe-，保留 musnah 的 m，形成 pemusnahan；不是删去词根首音。

word_family.gloss: 毁坏或毁灭的状态、结果
毁灭者；具有毁灭作用的事物

senses.zh_definition: 毁灭、摧毁或销毁的行为、过程；使某物遭到彻底破坏或消除。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of destroying, annihilating, or deliberately eliminating something.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau perbuatan memusnahkan; pembinasaan.
senses.nuances: 着重摧毁或销毁这一行为、过程；kemusnahan 通常更着重毁坏的状态或结果。可指有害的环境破坏，也可指按程序进行的文件或物品销毁。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=178260&keyword=pemusnahan)。

etymology.historical_story: Pemusnahan is transparently formed from musnah through Malay action nominalisation. Its cultural setting extends beyond scenes of devastation: Malaysian records administration also uses it for the controlled destruction of documents. That institutional use explains why the word can describe either harmful destruction or an authorised administrative procedure. [Malaysian records management guide](https://pendaftar.upm.edu.my/upload/dokumen/20230626102202Panduan_Pelupusan_Rekod_Awam.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 musnah＝毁掉，再把 peN-...-an 想成给动作装上名词外壳：pemusnahan＝“毁掉这件事”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根本身无词缀；加 meN- 或 peN- 时，首辅音 p 被鼻音 m 替代：memeras、pemeras、pemerasan。首音节 e 读 /ə/。

word_family.gloss: 挤取、剥削或勒索的行为

senses.zh_definition: 通过挤压、压榨或拧挤，取出物体中的液体。
senses.en_definition: To extract liquid from something by squeezing, pressing, or wringing it.
senses.ms_definition: Memerah sesuatu untuk mengeluarkan cecairnya.
senses.nuances: DBP 在词根 peras 下主要以 memeras 展开动词义。马来西亚日常表达挤汁、挤椰浆时，更常见 perah、memerah；peras 也可见于指令或口语省略前缀的形式。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=peras)。

collocations.en: squeeze grated coconut to extract coconut milk

senses.zh_definition: 过度榨取他人的劳动、资源或收益，以谋取自身利益；剥削。
senses.en_definition: To exploit someone by extracting excessive labour, resources, or profit for one's own benefit.
senses.ms_definition: Mengambil keuntungan yang berlebih-lebihan daripada orang lain atau menindas mereka untuk kepentingan sendiri.
senses.nuances: 强调不公平的榨取，带有明确贬义；不一定涉及威胁。正式主动句通常使用 memeras。

senses.zh_definition: 以威胁或胁迫手段索取钱财或其他利益；勒索。
senses.en_definition: To obtain money or other benefits from someone through threats or coercion.
senses.ms_definition: Memeras ugut seseorang untuk mendapatkan wang atau faedah lain.
senses.nuances: 这一义项侧重胁迫，区别于一般的剥削义。常与 ugut 构成 peras ugut、memeras ugut；不是普通的索款或催还借款。

senses.zh_definition: 在固定比喻搭配中，指绞尽脑汁地思考，或付出极大的体力劳动。
senses.en_definition: In figurative expressions, to think intensely or exert oneself through strenuous work.
senses.ms_definition: Berfikir atau belajar dengan bersungguh-sungguh, atau bekerja keras, dalam ungkapan kiasan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 具体意思由搭配决定：memeras otak 指苦思，memeras keringat 指辛勤劳动。此义不表示剥削别人，不宜脱离固定搭配任意使用。
