etymology.historical_story: Peras offers a vivid semantic bridge between physical pressure and social pressure. DBP records squeezing, exploitation, and extortion under memeras, alongside expressions about intense thinking and hard work. These meanings can be understood through the shared image of extracting something under pressure; this is a semantic explanation, not a documented chronology. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=peras).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 peras 想成一只不断挤压的手：挤椰浆、榨劳力、勒索钱；配 otak 时，就是把脑力也“挤出来”。

morphology.formula: penglihatan + -nya → penglihatannya；进一步分析：peng- + lihat + -an → penglihatan
morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在这里是表示第三人称领属关系的后附代词，不是派生词缀；前面的词形不变，ny 读 /ɲ/。root_word 按数据包保留直接基词 penglihatan，最终词根为 lihat。数据包的 Jawi 是基词形式，完整词形为 ڤڠليهتنڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 他、她或该生物的视觉、视力，即看见事物的感官能力；也可泛指其观看活动。
senses.en_definition: His, her, or its sight: the faculty or activity of seeing.
senses.ms_definition: Keupayaan atau pancaindera seseorang atau sesuatu makhluk untuk melihat; juga perihal melihat.
senses.nuances: -nya 本身不区分性别，具体指代须由上下文确定。日常最常见的是视力义；不要与表示“看起来”的 kelihatannya 混淆。义项依据 [DBP：penglihatan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=penglihatan) 整理。

collocations.en: his or her vision is blurred
his or her eyesight is deteriorating

senses.zh_definition: 他或她眼中所见的情形，或基于所见形成的看法。
senses.en_definition: What someone sees, or their impression or judgment of it.
senses.ms_definition: Apa yang dilihatnya atau pandangan yang terbentuk berdasarkan perkara yang dilihat.
senses.nuances: 多见于叙事或文学语体。表达抽象意见时，现代日常语言通常更自然地使用 pada pandangannya 或 menurut pendapatnya。

collocations.en: as he or she sees it

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于健康描述、无障碍安排和人物叙述。第三人称 -nya 需要清楚的前文指代；不要用它直接称呼正在交谈的对方。

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds this expression around lihat, meaning ‘see’. The established noun penglihatan names sight or seeing, and the attached pronoun -nya links that faculty to a previously mentioned person or creature. This makes the word a compact description of someone’s visual experience. Its development is explained through Malay word formation rather than a separate borrowing story.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 lihat＝看：penglihatan＝视觉，再接 -nya＝他／她／它的，合起来就是“他／她／它的视力”。

etymology.historical_story: Pittsburgh preserves a personal name inside a place name. In 1758, General John Forbes named the settlement in honour of William Pitt the Elder. For Malay learners, this history explains why Pittsburgh travels between languages as a geographical name rather than acquiring a meaning through Malay affixes. [Source: Pittsburgh city government](https://www.pittsburghpa.gov/City-Government/City-Information/Pittsburghs-Flag-Great-Seal).

morphology.pattern_note: 直接基底按资料包保留 perkataan，更深层词根为 kata。-nya 在此通常是附着代词，而非派生词缀；为适配字段归入 suffix。基底词尾 n 与 -nya 的 ny 均保留，ny 表示 /ɲ/。输入 Jawi 仅为基底拼写，完整词形须加 ڽ。

senses.en_definition: His, her, or its word or words; also, the word already identified in context.

senses.nuances: perkataan 的基本义为表达意义的语言单位；-nya 不表示性别。此处为依据 DBP 基词义和附着代词规则编写的完整词形释义，并非 DBP 对 perkataannya 的独立原文定义。status 表示其符合标准马来语构形。参见 [DBP：perkataan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=perkataan)及 [DBP：-nya 的说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=hadir+nya)。

etymology.historical_story: The deeper base kata is linked to Sanskrit kathā, associated with speech and narrative. Malay forms perkataan from kata, then attaches -nya to connect the expression with a person or contextual referent. The older storytelling sense survives in classical usage, reminding learners that a word for words can also denote an account. [University of Malaya: KATHA](https://jier.um.edu.my/index.php/KATHA/issue/archive); [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=perkataan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kata 是“词／话”，perkataan 是“词语／话语”，加 -nya 就把它联系到“他、她或前面提到的对象”。

senses.zh_definition: 物体的根部、基部或起始端；身体部位靠近躯干的一端。用于某些器物时，也指柄部或枪托。

senses.ms_definition: Bahagian dasar atau bahagian sesuatu yang bersambung dengan tempat asalnya, berlawanan dengan hujung.
senses.nuances: 强调与末端 hujung 相对的位置，不一定指最低点。pangkal pokok 是树干基部，akar 才是树根；pangkal paha 指大腿根部。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect the physical base of an object with beginnings, causes, and capital. A tree provides a useful image: its base supports what grows above it, just as an initial cause supports an explanation. This is a semantic teaching analogy, not a claim about a documented ancient derivation. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=pangkal).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pangkal 记成树干与地面相接的“起点”：物体的基部、时间的开头、事情的根源，都从这里展开。

etymology.historical_story: Penambang belongs to the tambang family associated with fares and paid transport. Its meaning preserves the practical scene of a boat operator carrying paying passengers across water. Related tambangan can name a ferry boat or a crossing place, linking the worker, the vessel, and the journey. See [DBP: penambang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penambang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tambang＝车船费；peN- 把活动变成人：收船费、载你过河的人，就是 penambang。

etymology.historical_story: This word offers a useful lesson in reading across national varieties. Indonesian descriptions commonly use pirang for hair within a yellowish or reddish-brown range, while Malaysian references use perang for a related colour category. A familiar-looking word can therefore cross borders without carrying identical dictionary status. Its deeper historical origin is not established here.

etymology.historical_story: The underlying Malay word betul means right or correct. Speakers build correction verbs around this familiar idea, then attach -nya to refer back to something already mentioned. Perbetulkannya illustrates how an understandable spoken formation can circulate alongside a different preferred standard form. Its meaning remains transparent: take the earlier mistake and make it right.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 betul＝正确，末尾 -nya＝它：把“它”变正确，就是“把它改正”。

etymology.historical_story: The dakwa family shows how Malay distinguishes an allegation, its maker, and the act of presenting it. Dakwaan names the allegation, pendakwa names the person or party making it, and pendakwaan names the action or proceedings. These related forms make courtroom reporting more precise because an accusation and a completed judicial decision are different things. etymology.historical_story: The English word pancake combines pan and cake, naming the food through the vessel used to cook it. Oxford traces the compound to late Middle English. Malay has the adapted spelling pankek, recorded by DBP. The English spelling can remain visible in food contexts, while the adapted form provides a standard Malay equivalent. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/pancake); [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=pankek).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pan 是平底锅，cake 是饼：锅里煎出的饼就是 pancake；马来语把拼写适应为 pankek。

etymology.historical_story: Piston belongs to an international mechanical vocabulary. Its European history runs through French piston and Italian pistone to words associated with pounding or crushing. That older image helps explain the component's repeated motion inside a cylinder. Malay treats piston as a complete borrowed noun; the immediate borrowing route is not established by the supplied packet. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/piston).

etymology.historical_story: Prague ialah nama antarabangsa bagi bandar yang disebut Praha dalam bahasa Czech. Dalam legenda Libuše, nama bandar dikaitkan dengan seorang lelaki yang sedang membuat ambang pintu, atau práh. Cerita ini menarik sebagai ingatan budaya, tetapi tidak membuktikan asal linguistik nama tersebut. Dalam bahasa Melayu, Prague digunakan sebagai nama khas tanpa pengimbuhan. 来源：[布拉格城市介绍](https://newinprague.cz/wp-content/uploads/letaky/brozura/V%20Praze%20jsme%20doma%20AJ.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Pengedaran illustrates how Malay builds an activity noun around edar. The related verb mengedarkan describes distributing something, while pengedaran names the activity itself. The dictionary's leaflet example makes the relationship concrete: papers pass from a distributor to readers. The same productive word family also supports the vocabulary of publishing and commerce.

etymology.historical_story: Malay descriptions of clothing and posture repeatedly return to pinggang: a belt sits there, cloth is secured there, and hands may rest there. etymology.historical_story: The swimmer sense is transparently formed from renang with the person-forming prefix pe-. A separate dictionary entry preserves perénang inside expressions describing disorder. Their identical ordinary spelling can conceal both a pronunciation difference and unrelated usage. This illustrates why Malay dictionary accent marks and complete expressions matter when interpreting an isolated headword.

etymology.historical_story: Perkakasan is formed from perkakas with the suffix -an. Its dictionary meanings place general tools and equipment beside the physical components of computers. This pairing offers a useful picture of technical vocabulary development: an existing equipment word serves a modern computing distinction, while perisian names the software that runs on those components.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: perkakas 是工具，perkakasan 是整套器具；想到电脑中摸得到的显示器、键盘和部件，就想到硬件 perkakasan。

morphology.formula: ∅ + paddy → paddy；英语整词，源自马来语 padi
morphology.pattern_note: paddy 是英语词形，不能把 -y 当作马来语后缀，也不能把 dd 分拆为构词成分。规范马来语对应词为 padi；两者拼写和发音不同。

word_family.gloss: 英语复合词：稻田；马来语 sawah padi
英语复合词：稻农；马来语 pesawah

senses.zh_definition: 稻谷；尚未脱壳的稻米，也可指田间生长的稻作。
senses.en_definition: Rice in the husk or the rice crop before processing.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah bahasa Inggeris bagi padi, iaitu tanaman padi atau bijirinnya yang belum dibuang sekam.
senses.nuances: 这是英语义项的马来语释义，不是把 paddy 认定为规范马来语拼写。搭配的 ms 字段使用规范对应词 padi；beras 指脱壳米，nasi 指熟饭。参见 [Collins paddy](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/paddy) 与 [DBP padi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=24348&keyword=padi)。

senses.zh_definition: 稻田，尤指用于种植水稻的田地。

senses.nuances: 英语中可单独说 a paddy，也可说 a paddy field；马来语田地义用 sawah 或 sawah padi，不能一律用 padi 替代。参见 [Oxford paddy](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/paddy_1)。

senses.zh_definition: 一阵发脾气或恼怒，尤见于英国英语非正式表达。
senses.en_definition: A fit of anger or bad temper in informal British English.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris British tidak formal, keadaan naik marah atau merajuk dengan kuat.
senses.nuances: 常见于 in a paddy；与稻谷义来源不同，也不是马来语义项。参见 [Oxford paddy](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/paddy_1)。

etymology.historical_story: English borrowed paddy from Malay padi, a word associated with the rice crop and its unhusked grain. English subsequently also used paddy for the field where rice grows. Malay maintains useful distinctions between padi, beras and nasi: the crop or unhusked grain, the husked grain, and cooked rice. The English spelling should therefore not replace Malay padi.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 沿稻米加工顺序记：padi／英语 paddy「稻谷」→ beras「脱壳米」→ nasi「熟饭」；看到 paddy field，就想到 sawah padi「稻田」。

morphology.pattern_note: 依数据包保留直接词基 penyakit；进一步可分析为 peN- + sakit，词根首音 s 脱落，鼻音实现为 ny /ɲ/。外层 -nya 是第三人称领属或回指附着语素。数据包 Jawi 仅对应 penyakit，未包含 -nya；syllables 保留原始 null。

senses.zh_definition: 他、她或所指生物患有的疾病；上下文已确定的那种疾病。
senses.en_definition: The disease or illness affecting him, her, or the organism referred to; the disease already identified in context.
senses.ms_definition: Penyakit yang dihidapi oleh orang atau hidupan yang dirujuk oleh -nya, atau penyakit tertentu yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: penyakit 指疾病或病症，不能一律译为疼痛。-nya 可表示领属，也可回指已知对象；不表性别。马来文释义为依据 DBP 词基义项所作的编辑性改写。[DBP：penyakit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=penyakit)

collocations.en: his or her illness is getting worse

senses.zh_definition: 所指个人、群体或制度中反复造成困扰的弊病、恶习或问题。
senses.en_definition: A persistent harmful habit, failing, or social ill associated with the person, group, or system referred to.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, keburukan, tabiat atau masalah yang menyusahkan dan dikaitkan dengan pihak yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 这是比喻义，例如把反复迟到称作某人的 penyakit。并非医学诊断，语气可能带批评或挖苦。DBP 另收词基 penyakit 的印尼语辱骂义，标作 ki、Id；不宜当作本词在马来西亚的一般用法。[DBP：penyakit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=penyakit)

collocations.en: that's his or her persistent failing

etymology.historical_story: Penyakit belongs to the Malay family built around sakit, meaning ill or painful. Its formation shows nasal substitution: peN- combines with sakit, replacing the initial s with ny. The resulting noun names illness, while figurative uses extend illness into a model for persistent personal or social problems. The final -nya adds contextual reference. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=penyakit)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认出 sakit“病／痛”，再记 peN- 把 s 换成 ny，得到 penyakit“疾病”；最后 -nya 把病情连到前文的人或事物。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着于前词的强调小品词，不是派生词缀；此处 suffix 仅表示后附位置。词根末尾 /k/ 在常见马来西亚读音中实现为 [ʔ]。数据包中的 ڤليق 是词根 pelik 的 Jawi，未包含 -lah。[DBP 小品词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=partikel)

senses.zh_definition: 真奇怪；不寻常啊。表示某事物异于常态，并带有强调、惊讶或不解的语气。
senses.en_definition: Strange or unusual, with added emphasis, surprise, or puzzlement.
senses.ms_definition: Aneh, ganjil atau tidak biasa, dengan penegasan oleh partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: 这是 peliklah 在日常交流中的主要解释。-lah 的具体语气取决于上下文和语调，既可表示随口惊讶，也可表达不满，不能固定译成某一个中文语气词。[DBP：pelik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pelik)

senses.zh_definition: 难懂；难解。强调词语、问题等不容易理解或处理。
senses.en_definition: Difficult to understand or resolve.
senses.ms_definition: Sukar atau sulit.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录于词根 pelik。现代读者也可能将相关表达理解为“古怪”，因此需要明确语境；一般表达“困难”可用 sukar、sulit 或 rumit。以下是词根层面的词典搭配，不宣称是 peliklah 的高频搭配。[DBP：pelik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pelik)

senses.zh_definition: 重要；要紧。
senses.en_definition: Important or consequential.
senses.ms_definition: Penting.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 为词根 pelik 收录的义项，不宜当作现代 peliklah 的默认解释。现代学习与写作宜用 penting 表达“重要”；以下仅为该义的解释性搭配，非经语料验证的高频表达。[DBP：pelik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pelik)

senses.zh_definition: 感到奇怪；觉得纳闷。
senses.en_definition: Puzzled or surprised by something.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa hairan.
senses.nuances: 此义描述人的心理感受，而非事物本身的性质；例如 saya pelik 是“我觉得奇怪”。-lah 可加强说话人不解的语气。[DBP《学生词典》：pelik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pelik)

collocations.en: it is puzzling to see that situation

etymology.historical_story: Peliklah illustrates how Malay builds conversational meaning without creating a new dictionary root. The adjective pelik supplies the idea of strangeness, while the attached particle lah adds emphasis shaped by context and intonation. DBP also records less familiar meanings of pelik, including difficulty and importance, showing why a modern conversational reading must remain sensitive to context.

etymology.historical_story: Pergunakan is best understood through the productive Malay family built around guna, meaning use or benefit. Related forms distinguish using, usefulness, users, and usage. DBP gives mempergunakan both a neutral use meaning and an instrumental meaning involving people. Its advice on pergunakan recommends gunakan for instructions, illustrating why a transparent-looking formation still needs a register check. etymology.historical_story: Philippe is the French form of Philip, ultimately connected with Greek Philippos, combining elements associated with loving and horses. The name travelled through European naming traditions and developed different spellings in different languages. Its historical meaning explains its origin, but a person called Philippe is not being described as a horse lover in ordinary conversation. [Reference](https://www.behindthename.com/name/philippe)

etymology.historical_story: Peluklah combines the embrace verb peluk with the attached particle -lah. DBP records peluk in expressions for physical embraces, traditional measures, and religious affiliation. Those associations connect bodily encircling with wider meanings of attachment. In peluklah, however, -lah adds interpersonal force rather than a new lexical meaning. Its precise effect depends on the situation and the speaker's tone. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=peluk)

etymology.historical_story: Plumbum preserves the Latin name for lead, which also explains its chemical symbol Pb. Lead was historically used for water pipes, linking the same Latin word to English plumber and plumbing. Malay scientific vocabulary makes that old name especially visible: the element name and its international symbol can be learned together. See the [Library of Congress explanation](https://www.loc.gov/everyday-mysteries/browse-all-questions/item/chemical-elements/).

morphology.pattern_note: is_root=false 和 root_word=kat 按输入数据包保留，但该拆分不能作为教学分析：现代马来语应将 pekat 整体作为基本词，不能据词首 pe- 推定存在词根 kat。meN- + pekat → memekat 时，p 脱落并出现 m。派生词参见 [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pekat)。

senses.zh_definition: 浓稠的；液体不稀薄，具有较明显的黏稠度。
senses.en_definition: Thick or viscous rather than thin or watery.

senses.en_definition: Deep or dark in colour; intensely dark.
senses.ms_definition: Gelap atau kelam warnanya; sangat gelap apabila menerangkan keadaan.
senses.nuances: hitam pekat 描述浓黑色，gelap pekat 描述漆黑的环境；这里不涉及物质浓度。

senses.zh_definition: 浓重、深厚或强烈的；形容口音十分明显，或信念等根深蒂固。
senses.en_definition: Strongly marked, especially of an accent; deeply held or intense, especially of a belief.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, tebal, teguh atau kuat, khususnya tentang loghat, pertuturan atau kepercayaan.
senses.nuances: 描述口音时常见；描述信念时较具文学色彩。DBP 另列口语同形词 pekat II，意为 muafakat（共识），应与这里的形容词区分。参见 [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pekat)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay pekat links several experiences: coconut milk feels thick, coffee tastes strong, darkness blocks sight, and an accent sounds pronounced. These connections offer a useful semantic map, rather than a proven chronology of meaning changes. The available dictionary evidence does not justify splitting the word into pe- and kat or assigning it a speculative foreign origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕一个“浓”字记：椰浆浓稠、咖啡浓、烟浓、颜色浓、口音浓；反义词随语境变化，液体常对应 cair。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此通常是附着代词或回指成分，表示其过程、该流程；按本结构归入 suffix，但不是派生名词后缀。词根保持不变，ny 表示 /ɲ/，proses 的 e 为 /e/。输入未提供音节划分，故保留 null；所给 Jawi ڤروسيس 是词根 proses 的拼写，未包含 -nya。

etymology.historical_story: The international word family behind proses ultimately reaches Latin processus, meaning an advance or progression. The precise borrowing route into Malay is not established here. Prosesnya then combines that borrowed base with Malay -nya. The result illustrates how an international term participates in local grammar: a general process becomes the particular process already under discussion. [Word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/process).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: proses 像英文 process；后面接 -nya，就把镜头拉回前面谈过的事情：prosesnya＝它的过程／这套流程。

etymology.historical_story: Persepsi belongs to the international vocabulary of perception and is treated as a whole lexical base in Malay. Its opening letters do not represent the Malay prefix per-. etymology.historical_story: The supplied evidence does not establish the deeper historical origin of peduli. Its documented Malay family nevertheless tells a useful semantic story: attention can mean caring about someone or concerning oneself with another person's affairs. Pedulikannya combines the verbal base pedulikan with an attached pronoun identifying the object of that attention. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=25872&keyword=peduli)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分三步记：peduli＝在意，-kan＝理会某对象，-nya＝他／她／它；jangan 一加，就是“别理会”。

senses.zh_definition: Phogat：印度姓氏，见于吉塔·Phogat、巴比塔·Phogat 等人的姓名；单独出现时，具体所指取决于上下文。
senses.en_definition: Phogat, an Indian surname borne by people including wrestlers Geeta Phogat and Babita Phogat.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga dari India, antaranya digunakan oleh ahli gusti Geeta Phogat dan Babita Phogat.
senses.nuances: 这是姓氏，pos 因给定分类限制记为 noun，不表示“摔跤手”或“冠军”。数据包没有 DBP 词条依据，因此 status 为 unverified，而非 official。以下搭配用于说明姓名和家族名称的用法，未作词频验证。[国际摔跤联合会：Phogat 家族成员](https://uww.org/articles/six-ways-break-shackles)

etymology.historical_story: Phogat is a family name associated internationally with Indian wrestling. Geeta and Babita Phogat and their father, Mahavir Singh Phogat, became widely recognised through the family story portrayed in Dangal. This cultural history explains why the surname appears in sports and film discussions; it does not establish the surname's original lexical meaning, which remains unverified here. [Cultural account](https://www.korea.net/NewsFocus/policies/view?articleId=161255)

morphology.pattern_note: 实际词根为 kritik。peN- 在此实现为 peng-；借词词首辅音群 kr- 的 k 保留，因此是 pengkritik。

senses.zh_definition: 评论家；对文学、艺术等作品进行分析、评价并发表意见的人。
senses.en_definition: A critic who analyses and evaluates literary, artistic, or other creative works.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mengkritik atau memberikan penilaian terhadap karya sastera, seni dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 侧重专业评论角色，评价可以包括赞扬与指出不足，并非专指挑毛病的人。本义是 DBP 所释 orang yang mengkritik 在文艺领域的具体应用。[DBP PRPM：pengkritik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pengkritik+)

senses.zh_definition: 批评者；对某个人、政策、观点或做法提出批评或反对意见的人。
senses.en_definition: A person who expresses criticism of someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mengkritik; pembidas.
senses.nuances: 可指特定议题上的批评者，不必是职业评论家。语气取决于上下文；单独使用并不等于辱骂者或恶意攻击者。[DBP PRPM：pengkritik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pengkritik+)

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: pengkritik sastera、pengkritik filem 是中性的专业称谓。直接称同事为 pengkritik 可能因语调而显得带刺；谈具体意见通常更得体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于文艺评论、公共讨论和政策报道。批评应针对作品、观点或行为，并给出理由；避免把不同意见直接说成人身攻击。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: pengkritik sastera、pengkritik filem 是中性的专业称谓。直接称同事为 pengkritik 可能因语调而显得带刺；谈具体意见通常更得体。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于文艺评论、公共讨论和政策报道。批评应针对作品、观点或行为，并给出理由；避免把不同意见直接说成人身攻击。

etymology.historical_story: Pengkritik shows how Malay builds a person's role from an established base: the prefix peN- attaches to kritik to name someone who critiques. In Malaysia's literary culture, that role includes interpretation and balanced evaluation. DBP's discussion of criticism explicitly describes it as ethical, systematic work that helps readers and writers, rather than merely finding faults. [DBP: Kritik Bukan Kerja Semberono](https://dewansastera.jendeladbp.my/2024/10/28/14894/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kritik 联想英语 critic；加上表示人的 peng-，就是‘做评论的人’。

morphology.pattern_note: 实际词根为 dosa。peN- 在 d 前实现为 pen-，鼻音为 /n/，词根的 d 保留；派生词指有罪过的人。

senses.zh_definition: 罪人；犯有宗教或道德意义上的罪过的人。
senses.en_definition: A sinner; a person who has committed a religious or moral transgression.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang berdosa.
senses.nuances: 主要属于宗教、道德反省或文学语境，不等同于法律上的罪犯 penjenayah。该称谓本身不表示此人不可悔改，也不应一概译成‘恶人’。[DBP PRPM：pendosa 释义说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=berdosa)

dual_scenarios.en: I'm a sinner too, but I want to change.

ni 在此带有指向自己、突出自我反省的语气。
nak 是 hendak 的口语形式；pendosa 本身保留宗教语域色彩。

messages.speaker: Amir (好友)

messages.zh: 我觉得自己像个不配被原谅的罪人。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是带有强烈道德判断的称谓。自称 pendosa 可表达谦卑或悔意，直接这样称呼别人则可能构成羞辱或宗教上的指责。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合宗教劝勉、自我反省、文学叙述及相关讨论。不要把一般失误者、不同信仰者或尚未定罪的人随意称为 pendosa。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是带有强烈道德判断的称谓。自称 pendosa 可表达谦卑或悔意，直接这样称呼别人则可能构成羞辱或宗教上的指责。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合宗教劝勉、自我反省、文学叙述及相关讨论。不要把一般失误者、不同信仰者或尚未定罪的人随意称为 pendosa。

etymology.historical_story: The base dosa belongs to Malay's Sanskrit-derived vocabulary, alongside other terms associated with religion and moral life. Malay adds its own person-forming prefix to produce pendosa, a sinner. The word therefore combines an older borrowed base with productive Malay morphology, illustrating how inherited cultural vocabulary remains available for new expressions of conscience, wrongdoing, and repentance. [DBP: Sanskrit vocabulary in Malay](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/majalah/2021/db2/files/basic-html/page63.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: dosa＝罪过；pen- 指人：带着 dosa 的人，就是 pendosa。

morphology.formula: per- + cepat + -kan → percepatkan（非规范组合）；规范表达：per- + cepat → percepat，或 cepat + -kan → cepatkan
morphology.pattern_note: 此处仅描述输入形式的表面构成，不把 per-...-kan 认定为该形容词的规范构词。cepat 的 c 读 /tʃ/；所列 IPA 是按拼写推定的读法。DBP 建议形容词 cepat 使用 mempercepat，而非 mempercepatkan；相应祈使形式可用 percepat。[DBP 构词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=mempercepatkan)

senses.zh_definition: 非规范形式：使速度加快，或使某项工作更早完成；规范表达依句式采用 percepat、cepatkan、mempercepat 或 mencepatkan。
senses.en_definition: A nonstandard form used to mean speed up, expedite, or hasten.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk tidak baku yang digunakan dengan maksud menjadikan sesuatu lebih cepat atau menyegerakan pelaksanaannya.
senses.nuances: 输入包没有提供官方释义；这里解释其可推知的用意，不冒充 DBP 的独立词条。以下搭配是展示该形式的组合示例，未经语料频率验证；正式写作改用规范形式。[PRPM：mempercepat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mempercepat)

collocations.zh: 加快流程〔非规范形式；规范祈使表达：percepat proses〕
加快工作〔非规范形式；规范表达：cepatkan kerja〕
collocations.en: get the work done faster [nonstandard wording]

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报；规范用法说明

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 催促同事或服务人员时，可用 Boleh…? 或 Mohon bantuan untuk…，并说明时间要求，避免只丢下一句命令。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 聊天中可以理解这一形式，但考试、公函和正式报告宜使用 mempercepat、mencepatkan 或相应的规范祈使形式。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 催促同事或服务人员时，可用 Boleh…? 或 Mohon bantuan untuk…，并说明时间要求，避免只丢下一句命令。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 聊天中可以理解这一形式，但考试、公函和正式报告宜使用 mempercepat、mencepatkan 或相应的规范祈使形式。

etymology.historical_story: The identifiable base is cepat, meaning fast or quick. Malay dictionaries distinguish mempercepat, making something faster, from mencepatkan, hastening an action or bringing it forward. Percepatkan appears to combine familiar causative elements, but its precise formation history is unverified. Its intended meaning is understandable even though DBP's grammatical guidance supports different standard forms.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 cepat＝快。要说加快，记规范配对：mempercepat／percepat；mencepatkan／cepatkan。

morphology.pattern_note: is_root、root_word 和 root_jawi 按资料包保留，但其词根判定有误：语言学上的词根是 atur（اتور），pengaturan 是派生名词。peN- 在元音 a 前实现为 peng-，保留词根的起始元音；-an 构成名词。

senses.zh_definition: 安排、编排或调节事物，使其具有一定次序或按计划运行的行为或过程。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of arranging, organizing, or regulating something.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau perbuatan mengatur atau mengaturkan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 侧重安排或调节的过程。具体座位布局常说 susunan tempat duduk，活动筹备也常用 penyusunan 或 pengurusan；表示必须遵守的规章通常用 peraturan。技术语境中的 pengaturan 可指调节，不宜一律译为法律监管。词义依据：[DBP：atur 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=atur)。

messages.ms_standard: Adakah pengaturan tempat duduk ini sudah selesai? Para tetamu akan tiba sebentar lagi.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于行政说明或工作协调时语气中性。提出调整建议可说 Bolehkah pengaturan ini disemak semula?，比直接指责安排混乱更委婉。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合讨论活动、座位、时间及技术调节。评价他人安排时，具体指出问题并提出修改建议；日常请人收拾物品时，用 susun 或 kemaskan 更自然。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 用于行政说明或工作协调时语气中性。提出调整建议可说 Bolehkah pengaturan ini disemak semula?，比直接指责安排混乱更委婉。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合讨论活动、座位、时间及技术调节。评价他人安排时，具体指出问题并提出修改建议；日常请人收拾物品时，用 susun 或 kemaskan 更自然。

etymology.historical_story: Pengaturan belongs to the Malay family built around atur, associated with putting things in order. Its peN-…-an construction names the organizing process rather than the organizer. The same family connects arranging objects, coordinating events, and regulating mechanisms. This semantic continuity offers a useful cultural picture: orderly placement becomes a model for orderly activity.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 atur＝安排：peng-…-an 把动作装进名词框，pengaturan 就是“安排这件事”。

morphology.pattern_note: 按资料包作为整体借入的基本形容词处理，无马来语生产性词缀变化。末尾 -ik 属国际借词构形，不宜在此直接当作普通马来语派生后缀。

senses.zh_definition: 爱国的；表现出对国家的热爱、忠诚或奉献精神的。
senses.en_definition: Showing love for, loyalty to, or devotion to one's country.
senses.ms_definition: Bersifat patriot.
senses.nuances: 可形容人、态度、情感、行动、歌曲或活动。patriotik 是形容词，patriot 指人，patriotisme 指爱国精神或思想。它本身不限定政党立场，也不等同于排斥其他国家。词义及 lagu patriotik 的用法见：[DBP：patriotik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=patriotik)。

etymology.historical_story: Patriotik belongs to the international patriot word family. That family's deeper history reaches Greek terms associated with one's homeland and fellow countrymen, although this does not establish the precise route into Malay. Its modern meaning centres on attachment to one's country. Etymological background: [Oxford: patriot](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/patriot).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 patriotik 与英语 patriotic 配对：意思同为“爱国的”，结尾写 -ik。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 与 kendali 结合时，鼻音实现为 /ŋ/，词首 k 脱落。root_word 按数据包保留 pengendali；严格的构词词根是 kendali，不能把本词仅分析为 pengendali 加 -an。数据包音节字段原样保留；IPA 按标准读音分节。

word_family.gloss: 管理者；操作员；控制装置
所管理的事务；操作结果

senses.zh_definition: 对事务、活动或组织进行管理、安排和主持的过程。
senses.en_definition: The management or conduct of an activity, organization, or affair.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal mengurus, mentadbir atau mengawal perjalanan sesuatu urusan, kegiatan atau organisasi.
senses.nuances: 侧重实际组织和执行；pengurusan 的范围通常更广。此处将 DBP 的综合释义按使用领域细分，马来文定义为释义性改写。[DBP：kendali](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kendali)

senses.zh_definition: 对物品、设备或材料进行处理、搬运或操作的过程。
senses.en_definition: The handling of goods or materials, or the operation of equipment.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan mengendalikan barang, bahan atau peralatan mengikut cara yang tertentu.
senses.nuances: 常见于培训、工作程序及安全说明。具体译为“处理”“搬运”还是“操作”，取决于宾语。

senses.zh_definition: 对价格、行为或其他变化实施约束，使其保持在可控范围内。
senses.en_definition: The control or restraint of a process, condition, or behaviour.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal mengekang, menguasai atau mengawal sesuatu supaya tidak melampaui batas.
senses.nuances: 价格方面，DBP 收录 pengendalian harga；现代马来西亚行政语境中，kawalan harga 也很常见。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan labels kendali as Javanese and records its concrete meaning as a bridle or reins. Its Malay derivatives also describe restraint, management, and administration. The reins therefore provide a useful image for understanding pengendalian: directing a process so that it follows an intended course. This image explains the semantic connection without establishing a dated borrowing history.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kendali 想成“缰绳”：pengendali 是掌缰的人，pengendalian 是掌控和操作这件事。

morphology.pattern_note: 动词词根加 meN- 时，词首 p 脱落，鼻音实现为 m：meN- + pikat → memikat；peN- + pikat → pemikat。名词 pikat“牛虻／大蝇”是同形词，不应据此套用动词派生关系。

word_family.gloss: 诱捕者；诱饵；吸引人的事物

senses.zh_definition: 利用驯养的鸟或其他诱饵，引诱并捕捉鸟兽。
senses.en_definition: To lure and catch birds or other animals using a decoy.
senses.ms_definition: Menangkap burung atau haiwan lain dengan menggunakan denak atau umpan.
senses.nuances: 这是 pikat I 的具体捕猎义。正式陈述通常用 memikat；口语或祈使句可用词根 pikat。denak 指用于引诱同类的动物。各义依据 DBP 释义改写：[PRPM：pikat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=pikat)。

collocations.en: to catch birds using a decoy

senses.zh_definition: 设法把人引入圈套；诱使对方进入预设的情境。
senses.en_definition: To lure someone into a trap or a deliberately arranged situation.
senses.ms_definition: Menarik seseorang supaya masuk ke dalam perangkap atau keadaan yang sengaja diatur.
senses.nuances: 重点在诱导和设局，通常带有策略或欺骗意味。不能把所有邀请、说服或招募都称为 pikat。

collocations.en: to lure a thief into a trap

senses.zh_definition: 以魅力、言行或某种优点吸引、打动别人，使其产生兴趣或好感。
senses.en_definition: To attract, charm, or win someone's interest or affection.
senses.ms_definition: Melakukan sesuatu atau mempunyai daya tarikan yang menyebabkan seseorang tertarik atau tertawan hati.
senses.nuances: 可用于恋爱、表演、旅游和商业宣传，不一定指追求异性，也不保证对方已经爱上某人。口语常省略 meN-；正式陈述一般用 memikat。

senses.zh_definition: 常聚集在牛、水牛等牲畜周围的一类大蝇，通常译作牛虻或虻。
senses.en_definition: A large fly, commonly a horsefly, that gathers around cattle or buffalo.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis lalat besar yang mengerumuni lembu, kerbau dan haiwan seumpamanya.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 单列的同形词 pikat II，与“吸引”的动词义分开处理。一般词义不足以确定具体物种，不能仅凭词名指定学名。[PRPM：pikat II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=pikat)。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary places practical trapping and emotional attraction within the same pikat word family. A decoy draws a bird closer; charm draws someone's attention. This provides a memorable semantic connection, although it does not establish which meaning developed first. The large-fly noun is listed separately, so its origin should not be invented from the trapping sense.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pikat 想成“吸引过来”：诱鸟靠近是 memikat burung，吸引人心是 memikat hati。牛虻义另开一个记忆格。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 遇词根首音 k 时发生鼻音替代：k 脱落，以 ŋ 衔接后面的 u；-an 构成表示过程、状态或结果的名词。保留数据包的音节字段；IPA 另外标示元音相邻时的读音。

senses.zh_definition: 对语言、知识或技能的掌握；熟练运用某项能力的程度或状态。
senses.en_definition: Mastery or command of a language, subject, or skill.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan mengetahui sesuatu bidang dengan mendalam atau mampu menggunakan sesuatu bahasa atau kemahiran dengan baik.
senses.nuances: 指实际掌握程度，不只是接触或学习过。penguasaan bahasa 是语言能力语境中的常用表达；tahap penguasaan 指掌握水平。此义是对数据包所载 DBP 总释义的细分和转述，相关词义参见 [PRPM：kuasa 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menguasakan)。

senses.zh_definition: 对地区、资源、市场、局势或自身行为的控制、支配或掌控。
senses.en_definition: Control, command, or domination over something.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan atau keadaan mempunyai kawalan, pengaruh atau kuasa terhadap sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 可用于政治、经济、体育和个人自制等语境；控制可能源于管理、实力、影响力或占有，并不一概表示合法所有权。DBP 总释义亦涵盖 menguasakan，即授权或委托；现代行文若专指授权，使用 pemberian kuasa 通常更明确。

etymology.historical_story: Penguasaan is a Malay formation built around kuasa, a word associated with power and ability. The same family connects governing a territory, controlling a situation, and knowing a language thoroughly. This makes mastery intelligible as having command of something. In education, the expression tahap penguasaan turns that broad idea into a description of a learner's attainment.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kuasa 是“力量、权力”，penguasaan 就是把某事掌握在手中：掌握语言，也能掌控比赛。

etymology.historical_story: Pembaharuan belongs to the Malay family built around baharu, meaning new. The circumfix peN-...-an turns that idea into a process noun. Its vocabulary connects two familiar experiences: changing established practices and making an existing document valid again. The same family includes membaharui and pembaharu, linking renewal with both action and agency. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=139612&keyword=baharu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 baharu＝新：pem- 和 -an 把“新”包起来，变成“让旧事物重新变新这件事”。

etymology.historical_story: The relationship between pikir and fikir is visible in Malay proverbial tradition. DBP records a proverb with both spellings, comparing thought to a lamp for the heart. Pikiranku adds the noun ending -an and the first-person clitic -ku. This makes its structure transparent even when readers encounter a spelling different from their usual Malaysian form. [DBP proverb record](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=fikir)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分三步记：pikir“想”＋-an“想出来的内容”＋-ku“我的”＝“我的想法”；在马来西亚书写时记得对应 fikiranku。

etymology.historical_story: Penggantungan belongs to the Malay family built around gantung, meaning hanging. The same family describes objects held above the ground and duties or permissions temporarily put on hold. Dictionaries also preserve a place sense, including a gallows. Modern readers therefore need the surrounding words to distinguish hanging decorations, disciplinary suspension, a legal stay, and execution.

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 在正式汇报中自然、得体。若前文出现多名人物，直接写 persetujuan pengarah 或 persetujuan Puan Farah，比单用 -nya 更清楚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于请示、活动安排、资料使用和个人授权。询问对方本人时可说 Adakah puan bersetuju?，不要把第三人称 -nya 当作礼貌的第二人称。

etymology.historical_story: This form shows how Malay builds a compact expression from several grammatical layers. Setuju expresses agreement; persetujuan names approval or an agreed outcome; attached -nya links that noun to someone or something already understood. The resulting word can carry an entire English phrase such as 'her approval', without marking the person's gender.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认出 setuju＝同意；persetujuan＝同意这件事；尾巴 -nya 把它交给上下文里的那个人：他／她的同意。

morphology.pattern_note: 按包内分析作为完整词基处理，不误拆为前缀 per-。派生 memerihalkan 时，meN- 在 /p/ 前变为 mem-，词基首音 /p/ 脱落。

senses.zh_definition: 某人或某事物的情况、情形或状况。
senses.en_definition: The circumstances, condition, or state of someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Hal dan keadaan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 强调所谈对象的情况，常见于书面介绍、叙述和说明；如 perihal diri 指个人情况。口语中常用 hal 或 keadaan。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=279992&keyword=perihal)。

senses.zh_definition: 发生的事情；事件；事变。
senses.en_definition: Something that happens; an event or incident.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang berlaku; peristiwa; kejadian.
senses.nuances: 这一事件义较具文学色彩，尤其见于传统叙事。现代新闻中，具体事故通常用 kejadian，历史或社会事件常用 peristiwa；不能假定所有此类名词均可自由替换。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=279992&keyword=perihal)。

senses.zh_definition: 关于；有关；就某一事项而言。
senses.en_definition: About; concerning; with regard to.
senses.ms_definition: Tentang atau berkenaan dengan sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 用作引出话题的介词性表达，语气偏书面。可见于标题、说明和汇报；日常交谈中 tentang 或口语 pasal 更常见。DBP同义词资料将此用法与 mengenai、tentang 等联系起来。[DBP 同义词资料](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=279992&keyword=perihal)。

etymology.historical_story: Perihal preserves a storytelling flavour alongside its practical modern uses. DBP illustrates it through accounts of a Malay country and an incident witnessed by a ruler, reflecting its suitability for describing circumstances and events. The related verb memerihalkan means to describe or explain. This lexical connection helps explain why the word also works naturally when introducing the subject of an account. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=279992&keyword=perihal).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pe-ri-hal 最后的 hal 记成“事情”：perihal 可指“事情的情况”，放在话题前又可表示“关于这件事”。这是记忆联想，不是词源拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: perah 是完整词根，不能拆成 pe- + rah；输入中的 rah 分析需纠正。派生 memerah 时，meN- 在 /p/ 前变为 mem-，词根起首 p 脱落。树名 perah 是同形名词，不能据此认定与挤压义同源。

word_family.gloss: 挤出物；榨取所得；供挤奶的

senses.zh_definition: 通过挤、捏、揉压或拧绞，使水、汁、奶等液体流出。
senses.en_definition: To extract liquid by squeezing, pressing, or wringing.
senses.ms_definition: Mengeluarkan cecair daripada sesuatu dengan memicit, meramas, menekan atau memulasnya.
senses.nuances: perah 自然用于命令句、口语和特定被动结构；正式主动陈述通常用 memerah。perah kelapa 指从椰肉中挤取椰浆，perah kain 指拧出布中的水。义项与派生词依据：[DBP：perah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=perah)。

senses.zh_definition: 比喻竭力运用脑力或体力；绞尽脑汁或辛勤劳动。
senses.en_definition: To exert oneself intensely in thought or physical work.
senses.ms_definition: Menggunakan daya fikiran atau tenaga dengan bersungguh-sungguh, khususnya dalam ungkapan tentang otak dan keringat.
senses.nuances: 主要见于固定搭配。perah otak 表示认真苦思，perah keringat 表示辛勤出力；正式主动句通常写 memerah otak、memerah keringat。不能脱离搭配就把 perah 当成一般的“努力”。参见：[DBP：perah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=perah)。

senses.zh_definition: 一种热带树木，学名 Elateriospermum tapos，俗称 perah。
senses.en_definition: A tropical tree, Elateriospermum tapos, known locally as perah.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis pokok tropika daripada spesies Elateriospermum tapos.
senses.nuances: 这是植物名称义，与挤压动作义分开理解。buah perah 和 biji perah 分别指其果实与种子。植物身份依据：[马来西亚森林研究院：PERAH](https://herbaxpress.frim.gov.my/kenaliHerbaDetail_bi.cfm?namaHerba=PERAH)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries distinguish the squeezing verb perah from a tree bearing the same name. The verb connects familiar household actions, such as wringing cloth and extracting coconut milk, with figurative effort: squeezing the brain means thinking intensely. The tree name belongs to a separate botanical entry. Their identical spelling is therefore a useful lesson in separating homonyms rather than inventing a shared origin. [Dictionary reference](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=perah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 perah 记成“挤到流出来”：挤青柠出汁、拧布出水；挤 otak，就成了“绞尽脑汁”。树名另记。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在元音 a 前采用 peng- /pəŋ/，词根 anjur 保留；前缀末尾 /ŋ/ 在读音中接入下一音节，故分音为 pe.ngan.jur。词根爪夷文未在输入包中提供，保留 null。

word_family.gloss: 举办活动的工作或过程

senses.zh_definition: 走在前面、率先前进的人；领头者。
senses.en_definition: A person who goes ahead of others or leads the way.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang berada atau berjalan di hadapan orang lain sebagai pendahulu.
senses.nuances: 对应输入包《Kamus Dewan》的第一义，偏叙事或较旧的表达。此处强调实际位置上的领头；现代日常活动通知通常使用第三义。以下搭配用于说明此较少见义项。

collocations.en: to walk ahead as the leader

senses.zh_definition: 带头发起或推动某项事业、运动的人；倡导者、领导者。
senses.en_definition: An initiator, leader, or promoter of a cause or undertaking.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang memulakan, memimpin atau menggerakkan sesuatu usaha atau perjuangan.
senses.nuances: 对应输入包第二义，强调倡导和带领，而非单次活动的行政安排。不能因英文提示出现 developer 就直接理解为房地产开发商；后者通常是 pemaju。

collocations.zh: 某项斗争或事业的倡导者
collocations.en: a leader of a struggle or cause

senses.zh_definition: 负责筹办、举办活动的个人或机构；主办方。
senses.en_definition: A person or organization responsible for organizing an event.
senses.ms_definition: Individu atau pihak yang mengurus dan mengadakan sesuatu majlis, pertandingan atau kegiatan.
senses.nuances: 对应输入包第三义，是现代马来西亚活动公告、新闻及职场语境中的常用义。penganjur 是主办方；penaja 是赞助方；peserta 是参与者，三者职责不同。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 在海报、致谢和报道中区分 penganjur、penganjur bersama 与 penaja，分别表示主办方、联合主办方和赞助方，避免误列机构职责。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary connects anjur with forward movement and prominence. With the person-forming prefix peN-, penganjur names someone who goes ahead, leads an undertaking, or organizes an event. These meanings offer a useful spatial image: the organizer stands at the front of collective activity. This explains the semantic connection without assuming a documented chronology for each sense.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: anjur 联想“向前带头”，peN- 标出做事者：penganjur 就是带头把活动办起来的人。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 接以 s 开头的 sejuk 时，产生鼻音替换：原首音 s 脱落，由 ny /ɲ/ 承接，形成 penyejuk。词尾 k 在常见马来西亚读音中实现为 [ʔ]。输入包将派生词误作词根，现纠正为 sejuk；分音依据构词及读音补拟。

senses.zh_definition: 使物体、空气等变凉或产生凉感的装置、物质或其他事物；冷却器、冷却剂等。
senses.en_definition: A device, substance, or other thing that cools something or makes it feel cooler.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang menjadikan sejuk, seperti kipas, alat pendingin atau bahan yang digunakan untuk menyejukkan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 核心为输入包的 DBP 义“使之变凉的事物”。具体译法随搭配而变：alat penyejuk 是冷却设备，cecair penyejuk 是冷却液。penyejuk 表示起冷却作用的事物，penyejukan 表示冷却过程。它不必然指冰箱，也不保证发生实际降温，例如风扇可使人感觉凉快。参见 [DBP sejuk 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sejuk)。

senses.zh_definition: 在比喻搭配中，指使人心情平静、舒畅或得到慰藉的人或事物。
senses.en_definition: Figuratively, someone or something that soothes, comforts, or brings peace of mind.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, orang atau sesuatu yang menenangkan perasaan dan memberikan ketenteraman.
senses.nuances: 这是 penyejuk hati 等表达中的比喻延伸，不另冒充输入包已列出的 DBP 独立义项。以 sejuk 的“心情平静”义为基础，强调情感安抚，不是身体温度下降。

etymology.historical_story: Penyejuk is transparently formed from sejuk, meaning cool or cold, with the productive Malay prefix peN-. The initial s undergoes nasal substitution, producing ny. The resulting noun names something that cools, from a simple fan to a technical coolant. Expressions such as penyejuk hati extend the same cooling image to emotional relief and reassurance.

etymology.historical_story: Pengekstrakan illustrates how Malay builds technical vocabulary around an established scientific base, ekstrak. The circumfix peN-...-an turns that base into a process noun, while related forms identify the action and the equipment. This makes the family useful in laboratories and industry: the extract, the act of extracting, and the extraction process each receive a distinct grammatical form.

etymology.historical_story: Panggillah is best understood through Malay grammar rather than a separate borrowing story. It joins panggil to the bound particle -lah, which standard writing attaches to the preceding word. The resulting expression can encourage, soften, or insist. Its social effect depends on delivery: the same written form may sound welcoming, matter of fact, or impatient.

etymology.historical_story: English potato came through Spanish patata, ultimately connected with batata, a Caribbean name for sweet potato. Early English usage therefore referred to a different crop from the ordinary potato familiar today. That naming history explains the surviving expression sweet potato, even though sweet potatoes and ordinary potatoes belong to different botanical families. etymology.historical_story: Penutupnya combines penutup with the attached form -nya. The base penutup is formed from tutup and the productive noun-forming prefix peN-. Its meanings connect a physical cover with the closing part of a speech or composition. This offers a useful semantic bridge: a lid closes a container, while concluding words close a text. [DBP：penutup](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=penutup+).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tutup＝关；penutup＝用来关住或收尾的东西；加 -nya＝“它的盖子／它的结尾”。

senses.zh_definition: 以印刷为职业的人；印刷工人。
senses.en_definition: A person whose occupation is printing; a printing worker.

senses.ms_definition: Alat yang digunakan untuk mencetak teks, gambar atau bahan lain.

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是中性的标准词。请同事协助操作时，可说 Boleh tolong cetak dokumen ini?，比直接命令更礼貌。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 办公室里通常指打印机；出版业务中可能指承印公司。谈设备故障时说明型号或位置，谈出版责任时区分 pencetak 与 penerbit。

etymology.historical_story: Pencetak belongs to the Malay cetak family, which connects printing work, printed products, and printing businesses. Its peN- prefix names an agent or instrument. The dictionary records both human printers and printing equipment, making the word a useful bridge between the craft of producing books and the everyday office task of printing documents.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 cetak＝印；前面加 peN-，就得到负责印的人或机器：pencetak。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在 j 前呈现为 pen-，词根首音 j 保留。root_word 与 root_jawi 按数据包保留；实际构词词根为 judi，数据包的 is_root=true 属于误判。

senses.zh_definition: 赌徒；喜欢或经常参与赌博的人。
senses.en_definition: A gambler; someone who regularly engages in or enjoys gambling.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang suka main judi.
senses.nuances: 通常指具有赌博习惯的人，语气可能带有负面评价。该词本身不表示已经达到临床成瘾程度，也不必然表示职业赌徒。马来文释义依数据包所引《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》展开缩写；词族亦见 [DBP：judi／berjudi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=berjudi)。

etymology.historical_story: Penjudi illustrates a productive Malay way of naming people through their activities. The base judi names gambling, while peN- forms a person associated with it. Compare berjudi, the activity, and perjudian, the practice or sphere of gambling. This transparent relationship explains the word without requiring an unsupported story about when gambling first entered Malay society.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 judi＝赌博：berjudi 是去赌，penjudi 是赌的人，perjudian 是赌博这件事。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为一个词素记忆，不拆成 pl- 与 -ak；词首 pl- 连读，整体为一个音节。

word_family.gloss: 多个斑块或多块纪念牌，具体取决于语境

senses.zh_definition: 牙菌斑；附着于牙齿表面的微生物膜，由细菌及其基质等构成，并含唾液成分和食物残留。
senses.en_definition: Dental plaque: a bacterial biofilm that accumulates on tooth surfaces.
senses.ms_definition: Enapan yang terbentuk pada permukaan gigi, terdiri daripada campuran air liur, bakteria dan saki-baki makanan, yang boleh menyebabkan penyakit gusi.
senses.nuances: 输入包提供的是牙科义。plak gigi 指牙菌斑；已矿化的牙结石通常称 karang gigi。另有纪念牌义，参见 [DBP：plak I、plak II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=plak)。

senses.zh_definition: 纪念牌；以金属、木材等制成并带有题字或装饰，用于纪念、表彰或记录某一事件的牌板。
senses.en_definition: An inscribed or decorated plate used for commemoration or recognition.
senses.ms_definition: Plat daripada gangsa, kayu atau bahan lain yang dihias dan diukir sebagai tanda peringatan.
senses.nuances: 常见于颁奖、致谢、落成和纪念活动。通过 menerima、menyampaikan、gangsa、penghargaan 等上下文与牙科义区分。

senses.zh_definition: 医学上的局部斑块；尤指动脉内壁形成的脂质性斑块。
senses.en_definition: A localized pathological deposit or lesion, especially a fatty plaque in an artery.
senses.ms_definition: Timbunan bahan atau lesi setempat pada tisu, khususnya timbunan lemak pada dinding dalam arteri.
senses.nuances: 属于专科扩展义，通常须加限定语。动脉斑块、牙菌斑和血栓是不同概念。参见 [DBP：plak 相关医学术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=plak)。

nak 对应 hendak，表达打算。
句末 lah 加强自己的决定；doktor 在牙科语境中可指牙医。

messages.ms_standard: Adakah doktor sudah menunjukkan cara membersihkan ruang di antara gigi?
messages.zh: 医生教过你怎么清洁牙缝了吗？

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈论别人的牙菌斑时宜私下、客观表达，避免当众评论其口腔清洁。颁奖或致谢时，plak penghargaan 是得体的正式名称。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 牙科、医学和典礼场合均可使用，但应补充限定语以免歧义。聊天拼写 plak 有时也被用来表示 pulak／pula；这种网络写法应结合句法另行辨认。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈论别人的牙菌斑时宜私下、客观表达，避免当众评论其口腔清洁。颁奖或致谢时，plak penghargaan 是得体的正式名称。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 牙科、医学和典礼场合均可使用，但应补充限定语以免歧义。聊天拼写 plak 有时也被用来表示 pulak／pula；这种网络写法应结合句法另行辨认。

etymology.historical_story: Plak can name either something attached to a surface or a plate displayed for remembrance. DBP records dental deposits and commemorative plates as separate dictionary entries, while specialist terminology also uses the word for arterial deposits. These meanings offer a useful cultural contrast: a dentist discusses plak on teeth, whereas a ceremony organizer prepares a plak to honor a guest.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用“贴在表面的一片”串联词义：牙面上的菌斑、动脉壁上的斑块、墙面上挂的纪念牌；再靠 gigi、arteri、penghargaan 判断具体含义。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着代词，严格说属于附着语素，并非普通派生后缀；此处按字段归入 suffix。连接时词根不变，ny 表示 /ɲ/。输入 Jawi ڤريقسا 只对应 periksa；完整形式应加上 ڽ，写作 ڤريقساڽ。输入未提供分音节；按构成可分为 pe.rik.sa.nya。periksa 是完整词根，不拆成 per- + iksa。

senses.zh_definition: 检查、查验或诊察他、她或前文所指的对象；具体指代须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Examine or check him, her, or the previously mentioned object, especially in an instruction.
senses.ms_definition: Periksa orang atau perkara yang dirujuk oleh -nya untuk mengetahui keadaannya.
senses.nuances: 这是 periksa 与 -nya 的规范组合分析，不表示已核实 periksanya 是 DBP 独立词条；马来文释义为组合释义。祈使句可用 Periksanya dahulu；正式主动陈述句通常用 memeriksanya，例如 Doktor akan memeriksanya。IPA 为按构词推定的宽式标音。词义依据：[DBP：periksa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=periksa)；附着代词依据：[DBP：-nya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tatabahasa+nya)。

collocations.en: check him, her, or it first
examine him, her, or it carefully

senses.zh_definition: 其调查、查究或审察；见于旧式书面语，具体含义取决于上下文。
senses.en_definition: His, her, or its inquiry or investigation, in older literary usage.
senses.ms_definition: Penyelidikan atau siasatan yang berkaitan dengan pihak yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 词根 periksa 也有名词性的“调查、查究”义，因此 -nya 可表所属。孤立词形不足以判定它一定是动词。此义的现代常用表达是 pemeriksaannya 或 penyiasatannya；以下为释义性组合，不视为已核实的现代高频搭配。词根依据：[DBP：periksa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=periksa)。

collocations.en: his or her inquiries and investigation
the findings of his or her investigation

etymology.historical_story: Periksa ultimately comes from Sanskrit parīkṣā, meaning investigation or examination. Its initial per- belongs to the borrowed root rather than being a Malay prefix. Malay subsequently built forms such as memeriksa and pemeriksaan around it. Periksanya adds the attached pronoun -nya, whose reference must be recovered from the surrounding sentence. Source: [linguistic study of Malay affixes](https://brill.com/view/journals/bki/165/2-3/article-p291_4.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Plutonium was first produced at Berkeley in 1940 and identified in 1941. Its name follows an astronomical sequence: uranium recalls Uranus, neptunium recalls Neptune, and plutonium recalls Pluto, then classified as a planet. Malay uses the international chemical name, preserving a small piece of twentieth-century scientific history whenever the element is named. [PubChem: Plutonium](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/element/Plutonium)

etymology.historical_story: Pisaunya illustrates how Malay builds reference around an ordinary household word. Pisau names the cutting tool, while attached -nya connects it to someone already mentioned or something understood in conversation. The supplied dictionary evidence establishes the root meaning, but does not establish its ultimate origin. This entry therefore explains the transparent formation rather than inventing an ancient borrowing story.

etymology.historical_story: Puteri ultimately comes from Sanskrit putrī, meaning daughter. Its royal and respectful associations became established in Malay, where the word can describe either a princess or a daughter addressed affectionately. Puteriku adds the Malay possessive clitic -ku. The resulting expression connects the elevated language of princesses with the intimate language of family affection. [Etymological reference](https://www.behindthename.com/name/puteri).

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here concerns spelling rather than a separate word origin. Standard Malay has pekerjaan within the kerja family. The supplied perkerjaan contains an additional r and provides no evidence of an independent lexical history. Treating it as a spelling correction preserves the genuine connection among kerja, bekerja, pekerja and pekerjaan without inventing a new derivative.

etymology.historical_story: Peletup is transparently connected with letup through Malay instrument-noun formation. The same family distinguishes an event, letupan, from causing that event, meletupkan, and the device used, peletup. This pattern helps readers follow technical reports without treating every related form as the same object. It explains present-day morphology rather than claiming a documented date or inventor for the word.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: letup 联想砰的一声；meletup 是发生爆炸，meletupkan 是使它爆炸，peletup 是使炸药起爆的装置。

word_family.gloss: 将某事或食物列为禁忌
令人忌讳或厌恶的事物

senses.zh_definition: 依据习俗或信仰而禁止的行为、言语或事物；禁忌。
senses.en_definition: A prohibition or taboo grounded in custom or belief.
senses.ms_definition: Larangan melakukan atau menyebut sesuatu berdasarkan adat atau kepercayaan.
senses.nuances: 常见于 pantang larang；不同家庭与社群的具体禁忌可能不同。义项依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=Pantang)。

senses.zh_definition: 因疾病、信仰或其他忌讳而不能食用的食物或饮料。
senses.en_definition: Food or drink that a person must avoid because of illness, belief, or another restriction.
senses.ms_definition: Makanan atau minuman yang tidak boleh diambil kerana penyakit, kepercayaan atau larangan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 指被禁食的东西；实际遵守忌口通常用 berpantang。这个词本身不说明禁食依据是否属于医学建议。

senses.zh_definition: 须遵守饮食和行为限制的状态或时期，尤指妇女产后的休养期。
senses.en_definition: A period or state of prescribed restrictions, especially postpartum confinement.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan atau tempoh menjalani sekatan tertentu, khususnya selepas bersalin.
senses.nuances: 传统描述常提约四十四天；实际安排随家庭与个人情况而异。日常谈产后休养时常说 dalam pantang。

senses.zh_definition: 坚决不肯做某事，或极不愿容忍某种行为。
senses.en_definition: To refuse firmly to do or tolerate something.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak mahu melakukan atau tidak suka menerima sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常表达原则、倔强或强烈反感；pantang menyerah 是绝不认输。

senses.zh_definition: 不可以；绝不能，用来限制后面的行为。
senses.en_definition: Must not; may not; under no circumstances.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak boleh melakukan sesuatu; perbuatan itu ditegah.
senses.nuances: 强调禁令或行为界限，常见于格言与警语；本条按其修饰后续行为的功能标注词性。

senses.zh_definition: 某人特别讨厌、忌讳或不能接受的事物。
senses.en_definition: Something a person particularly dislikes or finds unacceptable.
senses.ms_definition: Perkara yang sangat tidak disukai atau dibenci oleh seseorang.
senses.nuances: 偏个人好恶，可与 kepantangan 对应，不一定涉及传统或宗教禁忌。

collocations.zh: 对他本人而言不可接受的事

senses.zh_definition: 一遇到某种情况就忍不住作出反应；一……就……。
senses.en_definition: Unable to encounter something without immediately reacting to it.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak dapat menghadapi sesuatu keadaan tanpa segera memberikan reaksi tertentu.
senses.nuances: 口语构式 pantang + 触发情况 + 反应，是“不能自制”的延伸；例如 pantang nampak makanan 表示一见食物就想吃，并非禁止看食物。

collocations.zh: 一见食物就忍不住想吃
collocations.en: unable to resist food whenever one sees it
unable to take even a little criticism

etymology.historical_story: Pantang preserves a cultural vocabulary in which conduct, food and belief meet. Customs governing forest visits, family life and childbirth give the word concrete settings. Its meanings also reach personal resolve: someone who is pantang menyerah refuses to surrender. These connections explain its semantic range without requiring an unverified ancient root. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=Pantang)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pan.tang 想成一道“碰不得”的门槛：习俗上不能碰，饮食上不能吃，原则上绝不退让。

morphology.pattern_note: 此处按英语完整词形处理，不拆成马来语词缀。IPA 为英式英语读音；不把历史词源成分当作现代马来语构词成分。

senses.zh_definition: 天堂；宗教信仰中蒙福者所居的幸福境界。
senses.en_definition: Heaven, understood as the blessed dwelling of the righteous.
senses.ms_definition: Syurga, iaitu tempat kebahagiaan bagi orang yang mendapat ganjaran menurut kepercayaan agama.
senses.nuances: 此处解释英语词义。PRPM 将 paradise 列于《Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan》，对应 syurga；这不等于确认 paradise 为马来语普通词。宗教所指须依具体传统理解。以下搭配保留英语原文，马来语定义为释义性转述。[PRPM 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1/Cari1/cari1/Cari1/cari1/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=ideal)

senses.zh_definition: 伊甸园；《圣经》叙事中最初人类居住的乐园。
senses.en_definition: The Garden of Eden in the biblical account of the first humans.
senses.ms_definition: Taman Eden dalam kisah Bible tentang tempat tinggal manusia pertama.
senses.nuances: 这是特定宗教叙事中的所指，不能在所有语境中与一般“天堂”完全互换。英语书名或宗教专称可用大写 Paradise。[PRPM 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1/Cari1/cari1/Cari1/cari1/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=ideal)

senses.zh_definition: 乐园；环境优美宜人，或特别适合某种活动、满足某类人需求的地方。
senses.en_definition: A delightful place, especially one offering ideal conditions for a particular activity or group.
senses.ms_definition: Tempat yang sangat indah atau menyenangkan, atau yang menyediakan keadaan ideal bagi kegiatan atau golongan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 常用于旅游和消费宣传，不一定具有宗教含义。马来语可译为 syurga dunia、tempat idaman 或具体说明其优点；原英语词不宜直接当作正式马来语普通名词使用。[PRPM 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pengumpul)

senses.zh_definition: 极其幸福、舒适或愉悦的状态与体验。
senses.en_definition: A state or experience of complete happiness, comfort or delight.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan atau pengalaman yang memberikan kebahagiaan, keselesaan atau kenikmatan yang amat besar.
senses.nuances: 不限于具体地点，常带夸张的赞美语气。马来语可译为 kenikmatan、kebahagiaan 或 nikmat sekali。[PRPM 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=hong)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 旅游闲聊中可用作赞美；宗教交流中应尊重对方对天堂的具体理解，避免用自己的信仰解释代替对方的概念。

etymology.historical_story: Paradise reached English through French and Latin from Greek paradeisos, referring to a garden or enclosed park. Its earlier Iranian ancestry preserves the image of an enclosure with a surrounding wall. That concrete garden image sits behind a word now used for Eden, heaven, delightful places and experiences of happiness. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=paradise)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 paradise 想成“走进去就不想离开的花园”：宗教中是天堂，旅游中是乐园，感受上是极致享受。

morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的附着形式，此处表示“我的”，严格说是代词后附着语；按本结构归入 suffix。连接时没有音段脱落，写作一个词。Jawi 按输入保留，但 ڤاسوقن 仅对应基词 pasukan，未包含 -ku。[DBP：ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ku)

word_family.gloss: 他或她的队伍；所属者由语境确定

senses.zh_definition: 我的团队、队伍或代表队；指说话者所属、带领或支持的一组人。
senses.en_definition: My team or group: a team that I belong to, lead or support.
senses.ms_definition: Pasukan yang saya sertai, pimpin atau sokong; pasukan saya.
senses.nuances: 这是 pasukan 加第一人称单数所属成分的组合义，不是另一个独立词根。“我的”可表示归属或支持，不一定表示指挥权，也不表示法律上的所有权。

senses.zh_definition: 我所属或指挥的部队、分队或行动小组。
senses.en_definition: My unit or squad, especially a military, police or operational unit.
senses.ms_definition: Pasukan tentera, polis atau kumpulan operasi yang saya anggotai atau pimpin.
senses.nuances: 具体编制须由上下文确定，不能仅凭 pasukanku 判断为班、排或连。基词 pasukan 的词典义也包括动物群，但当前形式在现代常见语境中主要指人的队伍，不宜机械套用为日常的“我的兽群”。

collocations.zh: 我所在部队或行动小组的成员

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: pasukanku 带个人化或文学叙述色彩。正式公文、对上级汇报或初次交谈时，pasukan saya 通常更稳妥；代表集体发言时可按实际意思使用 pasukan kami。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: -ku 不表示“我们的”。提到自己所属的团队时，这个词不自动宣称自己是负责人；若需要明确身份，应另说 saya anggota pasukan 或 saya mengetuai pasukan。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: pasukanku 带个人化或文学叙述色彩。正式公文、对上级汇报或初次交谈时，pasukan saya 通常更稳妥；代表集体发言时可按实际意思使用 pasukan kami。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: -ku 不表示“我们的”。提到自己所属的团队时，这个词不自动宣称自己是负责人；若需要明确身份，应另说 saya anggota pasukan 或 saya mengetuai pasukan。

etymology.historical_story: Pasukanku illustrates a compact Malay way of expressing personal connection. The noun pasukan supplies the group or team, while ku is the shortened form of aku. Attached after the noun, it identifies the speaker's relationship to that group. The same pattern appears in everyday and literary expressions such as rumahku and namaku, making possession immediately recognisable. [DBP: ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ku)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pasukan＝队伍，-ku＝我的：队伍后面挂上 ku，就成了“我的队伍”。先认出整个基词 pasukan，再接 -ku。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是表示第二人称领属的后附代词，即“你的”，不改变 paman 的词干，也不是派生词缀；suffix 在此仅标记其位置。完整形式分为 pa.man.mu 三音节。数据包 Jawi ڤامن 只对应 paman，含 -mu 的完整形式应补作 ڤامنمو。

word_family.gloss: 叔伯舅等男性长辈；对年长男性的尊称
我的叔伯舅等男性长辈
他或她的叔伯舅等男性长辈

senses.zh_definition: 你的叔伯、舅父等男性长辈亲属；具体亲属关系须由上下文判断。
senses.en_definition: Your uncle.
senses.ms_definition: Bapa saudara kamu; pak cik kamu.
senses.nuances: paman 本身不区分汉语中的伯父、叔父、舅父等关系，不能仅凭此词确定父系、母系或长幼。马来西亚日常表达通常用 pak cik awak 或 pak cik kamu；pamanmu 较容易带文学或印度尼西亚语境色彩。马来语释义根据基础词与 -mu 组合编写。基础义参见：[DBP：paman](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=paman)；连写规则参见：[DBP 拼写指南](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

collocations.zh: 与你的叔伯或舅父见面

senses.zh_definition: 你称作“叔叔”或“伯伯”的年长男性；不一定与你有亲属关系。

etymology.historical_story: Paman belongs to a kinship vocabulary in which family terms can also express social respect. Kamus Dewan records both an uncle and an older person deserving respectful address. The ending -mu adds the listener's connection to that person. This explains the present structure; the supplied evidence does not establish the word's deeper historical origin. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=paman).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: paman 是“叔伯舅”，末尾 mu 是“你的”：pamanmu＝你的那位叔伯舅；它不会告诉你究竟是哪一边的亲戚。

etymology.historical_story: Penggali belongs to the Malay gali family, connecting the action of digging with the person or implement performing it. The same everyday image appears in the proverb diam penggali berkarat: unused knowledge deteriorates like an idle digging tool. This cultural association turns physical maintenance into a lesson about keeping learning active.

etymology.historical_story: Paige developed as a personal name from an English surname related to page, the historical term for a young attendant. That occupational background explains the surname, but it does not define a modern bearer’s identity or occupation. The name later became established as a given name, especially for girls. Its more distant linguistic ancestry is disputed. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Paige), [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/paige)

senses.zh_definition: 打吧；敲吧；击打吧。用于命令、指导、鼓励或允许对方作出击打动作。

senses.nuances: 力度和对象由语境决定，可用于击球、敲鼓或其他击打动作。-lah 可使指导较自然，也可加强催促，不能一律译成礼貌的“请”。本义依据词干 pukul 与 -lah 的语法组合归纳，并非独立的 DBP 引文。pukul 表示钟点的用法不能直接解释为“打吧”。参见 [DBP：pukul](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=94740&keyword=pukul) 与 [DBP：lah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=lah)。

etymology.historical_story: Pukullah combines the Malay base pukul with the bound particle -lah. Its interest lies in how grammar shapes social meaning: the same instruction can sound encouraging during a game or forceful during an argument. It is a transparent grammatical formation, so its explanation does not require an invented foreign ancestor. See [DBP on -lah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=lah).

morphology.pattern_note: 依输入将 pilihan 保留为直接构词基础；更深层词根是 pilih。-ku 是 aku 的后附代词形式，表示“我的”，须与前词连写；它不是派生词缀。无词干音变。输入 Jawi 仅对应 pilihan，未包含 -ku；词形可分读为 pi.li.han.ku。

senses.zh_definition: 我的选择；我选中的人、事物或方案，也可指我所偏爱的对象。
senses.en_definition: My choice; the person, thing, or option I have selected or prefer.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu atau seseorang yang kupilih atau kuutamakan; pilihan yang dibuat oleh aku.
senses.nuances: 强调选择属于说话者；可指决定，也可指选中的对象。不能自动译成“最好的”，也不等于“挑选的过程”；后者通常用 pemilihan。-ku 带有 aku 的人称色彩，在亲密交流、歌词和抒情文字中自然。此释义由输入中的 pilihan 释义与 -ku 组合而成。参见 [DBP：pilihan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pilihan) 与 [DBP：-ku 连写规则](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=anakku)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合谈个人偏好、职业决定或伴侣选择。讨论他人的婚恋和重大决定时，避免用“我的选择”抹去对方意愿；正式报告一般采用 pilihan saya。

etymology.historical_story: Pilihanku packages a choice and its owner into one written word. Pilih supplies the idea of choosing, -an forms pilihan, and -ku identifies the speaker as the chooser. This compact structure suits personal declarations and lyrical language. It also explains why the immediate base pilihan differs from the deeper root pilih. See [DBP on -ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=anakku).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pi-li-han-ku 按意义记成“选择＋我的”：pilihan 是选择，ku 是我的，连起来就是“我的选择”。

etymology.historical_story: Pencegah belongs to the productive Malay family built on cegah, meaning to prevent or stop. The prefix peN- names the person or thing performing that function. This explains why the same word can describe an enforcement unit or a protective substance: both stand between an unwanted event and its occurrence.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cegah＝阻止；peN- 给它一个‘执行者’：pencegah 是负责阻止的人或东西，pencegahan 则是预防这件事。

senses.zh_definition: 共同经营事业的合伙人；共同参与项目或合作关系的伙伴。

senses.ms_definition: Orang yang menjadi pasangan seseorang dalam permainan, tarian atau kegiatan yang dilakukan secara berpasangan.

senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mempunyai hubungan intim atau hubungan cinta dengan seseorang; pasangan, tanpa semestinya menyatakan status perkahwinan.
senses.nuances: 不能自动译为丈夫或妻子，也不能据此推断对方性别。一般对应 pasangan。关系义参见 [DBP 英马词典：partner](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=partner)。

etymology.historical_story: Partner illustrates how one English word can span several social relationships. A business associate, a doubles teammate, and a romantic companion can all receive this label. Malay translation makes the relationship clearer through rakan kongsi, pasangan beregu, or pasangan hidup. Its appearance in Malaysian conversation therefore requires attention to context rather than one fixed translation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 partner 想成“配在一起的人”：谈生意是合伙人，上球场是搭档，谈感情是伴侣。仅为意义联想，不作词源拆解。

etymology.historical_story: Penangguhan belongs to the tangguh family meaning delay or deferment. Malay turns this idea into an action noun through peN- and -an. The dictionary illustrates it with a postponed association meeting, placing the word naturally in collective scheduling and administration. Its structure names the postponement itself rather than the person who causes it.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tangguh＝往后推；peN-…-an 把动作包装成名词：penangguhan＝“延期这件事”。

morphology.pattern_note: 名词前缀 peN- 在 /l/ 前呈 pe- 形式，词根 lali 的 /l/ 保留；表示使人进入 lali 状态的物质。

word_family.gloss: 使失去感觉的过程；另可指免疫接种

senses.zh_definition: 使感觉减弱、消失或使意识降低的药物等物质；麻醉剂或镇静剂，具体所指取决于语境。
senses.en_definition: A drug or other substance that reduces or abolishes sensation or awareness; an anaesthetic or sedative, depending on context.
senses.ms_definition: Ubat atau bahan lain yang boleh melalikan.
senses.nuances: 常见于 ubat pelali。它是较宽泛的名称，不能单凭该词判断是局部麻醉、全身麻醉还是镇静，也不等同于所有止痛药。不要把 pelali 与 pelalian 的“免疫接种”义混为一谈。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pelali)。

etymology.historical_story: Pelali illustrates how Malay builds technical vocabulary from an everyday root. Lali describes a loss of feeling and also familiarity so strong that something no longer troubles a person. With the nominal prefix pe-, pelali names something that produces numbness or reduced awareness. This transparent word formation explains its meaning without requiring an unverified borrowing story. [DBP: lali](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=lali).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 lali＝没感觉；再加 pe-，就把它想成“让人没感觉的东西”——pelali。

morphology.formula: ∅ + perbadanan → perbadanan；构词分析：per- + badan + -an → perbadanan
morphology.pattern_note: 依资料包保留整词词基标记；从马来语构词看，本词由 badan 加环缀 per-...-an 构成，并非不可分析的原生词根。per- 中的 e 读 /ə/，b 保留。

senses.ms_definition: Agensi yang ditubuhkan oleh kerajaan untuk menjalankan atau melaksanakan fungsi yang tertentu.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 所列核心义。常见于政府机构名称，不能一概译为私人公司。普通名词用小写；完整机构专名中的 Perbadanan 用大写。[DBP：perbadanan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=perbadanan)

senses.ms_definition: Badan yang mempunyai keperibadian undang-undang tersendiri serta boleh memiliki harta dan bertindak atas namanya sendiri.

etymology.historical_story: Malay badan can refer both to a physical body and to an organization. Perbadanan develops the organizational idea through per-...-an: people and functions become an institutional body. Its dictionary meaning places it firmly in public administration, while its broader corporate meaning explains how an organization can act as a distinct entity. etymology.historical_story: Peluncuran shows how Malay builds nouns around luncur, associated with sliding motion. Its dictionary meanings cover both a place and an activity. Public usage has also extended it to introducing books and programmes. DBP's later advice acknowledges this extension while identifying pelancaran as the more established Malaysian choice for such events. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=peluncuran).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 lun-cur 的“滑出去”动作，再套 peN-…-an：peluncuran 就把这个动作变成“滑行、发射的过程或场所”。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary evidence presents pancut as the base of memancut, describing liquid forced rapidly outward. The same physical image underlies the familiar expression air pancut, a fountain. Informal sexual usage applies that outward-discharge image to ejaculation. This is a useful semantic connection, but the supplied evidence does not establish when the extension arose or justify a more distant historical origin. [Lexical reference](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/pancut).

etymology.historical_story: Pabrik reflects the history of Dutch contact with Indonesian: it derives from Dutch fabriek, meaning factory. Industrial vocabulary travelled alongside manufacturing and trade. The word remains ordinary in Indonesian, while Malaysian Malay generally uses kilang. DBP records pabrik with an Indonesian usage label, making it useful for understanding neighbouring varieties. See [research on borrowing](https://repository.persadakhatulistiwa.ac.id/id/eprint/240/1/282-690-1-SM.pdf) and [DBP](https://ekamus.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?cari=p&spec=false&type=1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pabrik 联想到 factory 的生产场景：机器在工厂里运转；再记住马来西亚常说 kilang。

etymology.historical_story: Malay uses terbang for flying, whether the subject is a bird or an aircraft. Penerbangan turns that action into a noun covering flight, an air journey, and aviation more broadly. Adding -nya then connects the noun to someone or something already mentioned. The same form can therefore describe a passenger's journey or a country's aviation sector.

senses.nuances: 核心是造成打扰，不一定涉及违法行为。用于人时可译为捣乱者、烦人者或骚扰者，须按行为判断；不能一概译为跟踪狂。gangguan 指干扰行为或现象，pengganggu 指造成干扰的主体。释义依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》ganggu 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=ganggu)。

collocations.en: a person who disturbs public peace

etymology.historical_story: Malay uses the productive prefix peN- to name an agent associated with an action. From ganggu, meaning to disturb, pengganggu identifies whoever or whatever causes the disturbance. The related forms mengganggu and gangguan offer a useful cultural distinction: everyday conversation can name the bothersome person, while formal reporting often describes the disruptive conduct.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ganggu 记成“干扰”，再把 peng- 看成施事标签：pengganggu 就是“制造干扰的人或东西”。

headword.verification_note: DBP 收录的派生名词；音节和爪夷文沿用输入包，IPA 为标准读音转写。参见 [DBP：pemisahan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pemisahan)。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在词根首音 /p/ 前呈 pem-，词根首辅音 p 脱落。输入包的 pemisah 本身也是派生词；基础词根应为 pisah。词族关系参见 [DBP：pisah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=pisah)。

senses.zh_definition: 分离、分隔或拆分的行为、过程或情况；使原本相连、混合或合并的事物彼此分开。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of separating, dividing, or splitting something into distinct parts.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau perbuatan memisah atau memisahkan; penceraian atau pemecahan, termasuk pembelahan.
senses.nuances: 适用于物质分离、空间分隔、组织划分及职责区分。侧重“把事物分开”的过程；perpisahan 常侧重人与人分别或离别。不能不加语境地把 pemisahan 一律译为“离婚”。马来语释义依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pemisahan) 展开缩略词。

etymology.historical_story: Pemisahan belongs to the Malay family built on pisah, meaning separation or parting. The peN-…-an construction turns the separating action into a noun naming its process. The same family includes berpisah, memisahkan, and pemisah. Its vocabulary extends naturally from separating physical materials to distinguishing responsibilities and institutional powers.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pisah 是“分开”；peN-…-an 把动作装进名词框架：pemisahan = 分离这件事。记住 p 脱落，留下 m。

senses.zh_definition: 全部毁坏或毁灭；整体遭到破坏而不复完好。
senses.en_definition: Completely destroyed or ruined.
senses.ms_definition: Binasa atau rosak semuanya; musnah sama sekali.
senses.nuances: 强调破坏的彻底程度，语气强于一般的 rosak。这里表示状态；要表达施事者毁掉某物，可用 memunahkan。义项依据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=punah)。

senses.zh_definition: 全部死亡而无一存留；灭绝。
senses.en_definition: Extinct; having no surviving members.
senses.ms_definition: Mati semuanya sehingga tidak ada lagi yang tinggal.
senses.nuances: 涉及物种时可指灭绝；马来西亚保护与科普语境也常用 pupus。数量减少或处于危险之中，不等于已经 punah。

senses.zh_definition: 希望、梦想等完全消失或破灭。
senses.en_definition: Completely lost or shattered, especially of hopes or dreams.
senses.ms_definition: Hilang atau lenyap semuanya, terutama tentang harapan dan impian.
senses.nuances: 这是抽象的引申义，带有明显的失望或悲痛色彩；不宜用来描述轻微挫折。

senses.zh_definition: 一种四数木科乔木，学名 Tetramerista glabra，也称 entuyut 或 tuyut。
senses.en_definition: Tetramerista glabra, a tree of the family Tetrameristaceae, also known as entuyut or tuyut.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis pokok daripada famili Tetrameristaceae, iaitu Tetramerista glabra, yang juga dikenali sebagai entuyut atau tuyut.
senses.nuances: 这是树名，与“毁灭”义分属不同的同形词。pokok punah 在林业语境可指树种名称，不能自动理解为树木已经灭绝。树种资料见 [Malaysia Biodiversity Information System](https://www.mybis.gov.my/art/150)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries distinguish destructive punah from an identically spelled tree name. The first moves naturally from ruined possessions to vanished hopes; the second names Tetramerista glabra, a peat-swamp tree whose timber has practical uses. This pairing offers a memorable lesson in lexicography: identical spelling does not establish a shared origin. Their deeper historical relationship is not established here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 harapan punah：希望像被清空一样，彻底不剩。看到 pokok punah 时，先判断是不是树名。

word_family.gloss: 选票；投票，实际构词基础

senses.zh_definition: 选民；投票人，指在选举或其他表决中投票的人，也可按语境指具有投票资格的人。
senses.en_definition: A voter; a person who votes, or is eligible to vote, in an election or other ballot.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mengundi.
senses.nuances: 既可用于公共选举，也可用于社团等组织的投票。pengundi 指人，undi 指票或投票选择，pengundian 指投票过程。行政语境也常用 pemilih 表示选民。核心人称义见 [DBP PRPM：pengundi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=351284&keyword=pengundi)。

senses.zh_definition: 用于投票的物件，如选票或投票用纸。
senses.en_definition: An item used for voting, such as a ballot paper.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang digunakan untuk mengundi, seperti kertas.
senses.nuances: 这是词典另收的物件义，见 [DBP PRPM 所载《Kamus Pelajar》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=351284&keyword=pengundi)。当代一般交流优先把 pengundi 理解为投票人；表达“选票”宜用 kertas undi。下列为帮助理解此义的说明性组合，不应视作当代高频固定搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Pengundi belongs to the Malay word family built on undi. The root's dictionary meanings connect choosing by lots with choosing through ballots, linking different ways of settling a decision. The prefix peN-, realised here as peng-, identifies the participant. Modern electoral usage makes that participant the voter, while pengundian names the process. [Source: DBP PRPM, undi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=undi).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 undi“票”：peng- + undi → pengundi“投票的人”；mengundi 是去投票，pengundian 是投票过程。

etymology.historical_story: Paan carries a small history of leaves in its name. Hindi and Urdu pān trace through Middle Indic paṇṇa to Sanskrit parṇam, meaning a leaf or feather. The name came to identify a prepared betel-leaf chew. This history explains the cultural term, but does not establish when or how it entered Malay. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=paan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 paan 想成被叶子“包”起来的一口嚼料：记住“蒌叶包”，不要只记成槟榔果。这是联想记忆，并非词源解释。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 与 is_root 保留输入的未还原记录；真实英语词基是 play，因此 is_root=true 不应解读为形态学结论。-ing 是英语后缀，不是马来语词缀；直接接在 play 后，保留 y，不双写辅音，通常读作两个音节。词形对应见 [British Council](https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/comment/174535)。

senses.zh_definition: 玩耍，参加游戏、体育运动或比赛；play 的 -ing 形式。

senses.zh_definition: 玩耍、比赛或演奏这一活动；也可特指演奏表现或技巧。
senses.en_definition: The activity of playing, especially a musician's performance or technique.
senses.ms_definition: Kegiatan bermain atau cara dan mutu seseorang memainkan alat muzik.
senses.nuances: 英语中的名词性用法，如 her piano playing；对应马来语时须按活动选择 permainan、kegiatan bermain 或 permainan piano 等表达。并非所有带 playing 的结构都是名词。参见 [Cambridge play](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/play)。

etymology.historical_story: Playing is built from English play and the ending ing; it is not a Malay derivative of main. Its range connects games, musical performance, acting and pretence through different established uses of play. The same written form can appear in a progressive construction or name an activity, so context matters more than a single translation. [Sources: British Council](https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/comment/174535), [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/play).

etymology.historical_story: The place-name Princeton appeared in 1724. The institution now associated with it began as the College of New Jersey in 1746, moved to Princeton in 1756, and adopted the name Princeton University in 1896. This history explains why the same name can identify either the town or the university. [Municipal history](https://www.princetonnj.gov/678/Historic-Princeton), [university history](https://www.princeton.edu/meet-princeton/history).

senses.zh_definition: 稻；稻属植物，其籽实脱壳后成为供食用的大米。

senses.nuances: 指植物时用 padi，脱壳后的生米是 beras，煮熟的米饭是 nasi。稻田通常称 sawah 或 sawah padi。cili padi 等固定名称中的 padi 不宜直接推广为独立的“小”义。[DBP：padi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=24348&keyword=padi)

senses.nuances: 收割后的谷粒仍可称 padi；去壳加工成为 beras 后，名称随之改变。此义不是米饭，也不是稻壳本身。[DBP：padi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=24348&keyword=padi)

etymology.historical_story: Padi belongs to an ancient Austronesian vocabulary of rice cultivation. Comparative linguists connect Malay padi with reconstructed *pajay and related forms such as Tagalog palay and Javanese pari. These related words preserve a distinction familiar to farmers: rice growing in a field or still enclosed in its husk, rather than the grain prepared for cooking. [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/30474)
