etymology.historical_story: Pengubah is built from ubah, meaning change, with the agent or instrument prefix peN-. Its structure naturally accommodates both someone who alters something and a device that produces a change. Electrical terminology gives this pattern a concrete application in the transformer. The spelling also distinguishes it from penggubah, whose root gubah concerns composition or arrangement.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: peN- 表示做事者或工具，ubah＝改变：pengubah 就是“使东西改变的那个”。记住 pengubah 没有第二个 g；penggubah 才是创作者、编曲者。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 遇词根首音 p 时通常变为 pem-，同时词根的 p 脱落：pasang → pemasangan；ng 表示一个 /ŋ/ 音。

etymology.historical_story: Pemasangan illustrates a productive Malay way of naming work: pasang supplies the action, while peN-...-an turns it into a process noun. The dictionary example mentions telegraph wires, showing its use for infrastructure. The same formation also accommodates modern equipment and software without requiring a new root for each technology. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pemasangan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 pa-sang「装上」：me-masang 是「动手装」，pe-masang 是「安装者」，pe-masang-an 是「安装这项工作」；原来的 p 被鼻音 m 替换。

etymology.historical_story: Pewangi is transparently formed within Malay from wangi, meaning fragrant, with a prefix naming something that produces that quality. Its scope extends beyond modern perfume bottles: the dictionary illustrates it with aromatic materials in Egyptian religious and funerary ceremonies. This cultural example explains its breadth, rather than establishing an Egyptian origin for the Malay word. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pewangi).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 wangi＝香，再加 pe-：pewangi 就是“让东西变香的物品”。ng 读 /ŋ/，不是两个独立辅音。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 与 s 开头的词根结合时，s 脱落，鼻音实现为 ny /ɲ/。输入将 penyusup 标为词根有误；它是 susup 的施事名词。参见 [DBP：susup](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=susup)。

etymology.historical_story: Penyusup belongs to the susup family, whose recorded meanings include moving beneath things and entering secretly. The agent prefix turns that action into the person who performs it. The connection offers a concrete cultural image: someone slipping through a gap becomes the infiltrator described in security reports. No particular historical incident is required to explain the formation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: susup 是“悄悄钻进去”，peN- 把动作变成执行者：penyusup，就是潜入的人；ny 读 /ɲ/。

etymology.historical_story: Malay uses the laku family to connect doing with conduct: melakukan describes performing an action, while kelakuan describes behaviour or manners. Perlakuan names the action itself. Its cultural range is broad: Kamus Dewan illustrates it with ritual dancing, showing that the noun can describe meaningful ceremonial acts as well as ordinary or objectionable behaviour. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=perlakuan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住读音中的laku：melakukan是“去做”，perlakuan是“做出来的行为”。把动作定格成一帧画面，就记住这个名词。

morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的附着形式，此处表示“我的”，与名词连写，不引起音变。更深层构词为 pandang + -an → pandangan。输入爪夷文 ڤندڠن 对应 pandangan；完整 pandanganku 应写作 ڤندڠنکو。音节可分析为 pan.da.ngan.ku；syllables 字段保留输入的 null。

senses.zh_definition: 我的看法、意见或对某人某事的判断。
senses.en_definition: My opinion, perspective, or assessment of someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Pendapat, tanggapan atau pertimbangan aku tentang seseorang atau sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 这是现代语境中最常见的理解。Pada pandanganku 表示“在我看来”，明确标示个人判断，不自动表示已经证实的事实。基础词义参见 [DBP：pandangan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=pandangan)。

senses.zh_definition: 我的目光、视线或注视。

etymology.historical_story: Pandanganku brings together three familiar Malay elements: pandang, meaning to look; -an, forming pandangan; and -ku, the attached form of aku. The dictionary records both physical sight and personal opinion under pandangan. Their connection offers a useful interpretive bridge: a person's view can be something seen with the eyes or understood with the mind.

etymology.historical_story: Pamela has a literary history beyond its use as a modern personal name. Philip Sidney's Arcadia features Princess Pamela, whose character later influenced Samuel Richardson's novel Pamela. These literary connections help explain the name's cultural visibility, but they do not establish lowercase pamela as a Malay common noun. [University of Glasgow literary discussion](https://thecityoflostbooks.glasgow.ac.uk/sir-philip-sidney-unsettling-fantasies-of-desire-and-reason/)

etymology.historical_story: Properti is an Indonesian adaptation of English property. Its real-estate sense appears in Indonesian government writing, while performance education also uses the word for props. These two settings explain why a house and a stage object can share the same label. Malaysian Malay ordinarily uses hartanah for the real-estate meaning. [Indonesian academic discussion of the borrowing](https://journal.unpak.ac.id/index.php/triangulasi/article/viewFile/6875/pdf_1)

etymology.historical_story: This form shows how Malay builds meaning in layers. Pandang supplies the idea of looking; pemandangan names what is seen or the capacity to see; and -nya connects that noun to an established referent. Its dictionary senses extend from physical sight to observation and opinion, linking seeing with understanding.

etymology.historical_story: Penggigit is transparently built from gigit, 'bite', using the productive Malay agent prefix peN-. Its meaning follows an everyday cognitive shift from an action to the creature performing it. Malaysian veterinary publications use serangga penggigit for biting insects. This illustrates established institutional usage without requiring a separate borrowing story or an invented date of origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: gigit＝咬；peN- 把动作变成施事：penggigit＝会咬的家伙。看到 ngg，记得鼻音后面的 g 仍保留。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在词根首音 k 前采用 peng- 变体，k 按鼻音替代规则脱落；加 -an 后形成表示过程或行为的名词。词末 i 与后缀 a 分属不同音节。

senses.zh_definition: 上锁、锁闭或通过锁定机构固定某物的行为、过程或操作。

senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan atau proses mengunci sesuatu supaya tidak dapat dibuka atau digerakkan dengan bebas.
senses.nuances: 常用于安全规程、设备说明和车辆功能描述。penguncian 是过程或操作，pengunci 是装置，terkunci 是状态。日常口语谈具体动作时，通常直接用 kunci 或 mengunci。

senses.zh_definition: 计算机系统中暂时限制文件、记录或其他资源的访问或修改，以控制并发操作的锁定机制或过程。
senses.en_definition: The temporary restriction of access to or modification of a computing resource to control concurrent operations.
senses.ms_definition: Proses mengehadkan capaian atau pengubahan fail, rekod atau sumber komputer buat sementara waktu untuk mengawal operasi serentak.
senses.nuances: 属于信息技术语域。此义不等同于 penyulitan（加密），也不必然表示文件受密码保护。

senses.zh_definition: 雷达等跟踪系统建立并保持对目标自动跟踪的锁定过程。
senses.en_definition: The acquisition and maintenance of automatic target tracking by a radar or similar tracking system.
senses.ms_definition: Proses memperoleh dan mengekalkan pengikutan sasaran secara automatik oleh radar atau sistem penjejakan.
senses.nuances: 属于工程技术语域，对应 locking 或 lock-on。不能将这里的锁定理解成实体门锁。

etymology.historical_story: Penguncian turns the concrete idea of a kunci, a lock or key, into a process noun through peN-...-an. Its modern range extends from securing doors to controlling shared computer resources and tracking radar targets. The connecting image is holding something in a controlled condition. These meanings are documented in Malaysian institutional usage and DBP terminology.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kunci＝锁；peN-...-an＝进行这件事的过程。把 k 隐去再套上词缀：penguncian＝上锁、锁定的过程。

morphology.formula: pendapat + -ku → pendapatku（我的看法）；进一步：peN- + dapat → pendapat
morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的后附代词，表示第一人称单数领属，并非派生词缀；此处按字段要求归入 suffix。连接时不改变 pendapat 的拼写。peN- 接 dapat 时形成 pen-，保留 d。包中爪夷文仅对应 pendapat；完整 pendapatku 应补写 -ku，为 ڤنداڤتکو。

senses.zh_definition: 我的意见、看法或经思考形成的判断。
senses.en_definition: My opinion, view or considered judgment.
senses.ms_definition: Pandangan, fikiran atau kesimpulan aku tentang sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 这里采用现代常用的“意见”义。ms_definition 是依据包中 pendapat 释义与 -ku 的语法功能合成的释义，不是独立词条的逐字引文。official 表示此形式符合标准构词和拼写规则，不表示 DBP 为其单列词条。pendapatku 可用于规范书面语，但带有 aku 的个人化语气；正式职场交流通常用 pendapat saya。[DBP 代词连写规则](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Pendapatku illustrates how Malay attaches a shortened pronoun directly to a noun. Pendapat supplies the idea of an opinion, while ku identifies its holder as the speaker. The same productive pattern appears in bukuku and rumahku. Its formation is transparent; no separate borrowing story is needed. [Source: DBP spelling guidelines](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Pakhan is a Latin-script rendering of Russian пахан. Russian–English dictionaries record it as slang for a crime boss or gang leader. etymology.historical_story: Pune enters Malay usage as a place name rather than a transparently derived Malay word. DBP's encyclopedia identifies the city in Maharashtra and records its older spelling, Poona. That spelling difference helps readers connect older English-language references with the modern name. word_family.gloss: 突然或不由自主地喷出

senses.zh_definition: 喷流；喷射出的水、空气等，通常从开口集中或有力地喷出。

etymology.historical_story: Pancutan makes a visible movement into a noun: pancut supplies the idea of spurting, and -an names the resulting jet. DBP illustrates the word with water used to dislodge soil and also records pancutan angin. These examples connect the word to practical observation of moving fluids. Its formation is clear; the root's deeper historical origin remains unestablished here. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=384984&keyword=pancutan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 pancut“喷出”，再加 -an：把“喷”变成看得见的一股“喷流”，就是 pancutan。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在 j 前实现为 pen-，保留词根首音 j；词根末尾 a 与 -an 的 a 分属两个音节。输入将整词标作词根，此处依据可核实的 jelma 词族更正。[PRPM：jelma](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=jelma)

etymology.historical_story: Penjelmaan is formed from jelma with the Malay nominal circumfix peN-...-an. Its meanings connect stories of spirits taking bodily form with biological changes and the realization of ideas. This shared image of something acquiring a different or tangible form also makes the word useful in mathematical discussions of transformations. [PRPM: jelma](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=jelma), [mathematics glossary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=pembesaran)

etymology.historical_story: Pengambil illustrates Malay’s productive way of naming people through their actions. The base ambil means to take, while peN- creates an agent noun. Before a vowel, that prefix appears as peng-. Familiar combinations then specify the role: pengambil bahagian names someone who takes part, making participation a kind of taking.

etymology.historical_story: This word shows how Malay builds abstract nouns from familiar actions. Henti supplies the idea of stopping; berhenti describes stopping, and memberhentikan describes making someone or something stop. Pemberhentian names that act or process. In employment contexts, the same stopping concept becomes dismissal or termination, explaining why an everyday root also appears in formal administrative language.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 henti“停”：berhenti 是停下来，memberhentikan 是让其停下来，pemberhentian 是“让其停止这件事”；工作语境中就是终止雇佣。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 按数据包表示直接基础词 perbuatan；其更深词根是 buat。-mu 是 kamu 的后附代词，表示“你的”，须与前词连写；suffix 是此处的模式分类，严格语法身份为附着代词。没有词根辅音脱落；音节由标准词形补充。

etymology.historical_story: Perbuatanmu combines two productive layers of Malay grammar. The base buat concerns doing; perbuatan names an act or conduct; the attached pronoun -mu identifies the person addressed. Its meaning therefore emerges from ordinary word formation rather than a separate historical borrowing. Malay spelling joins -mu to its host, preserving this grammatical relationship within one written word.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: buat＝做；perbuatan＝所做的事；-mu＝你的。连起来：perbuatanmu＝你做的事。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着于词尾的代词附着语，此处按字段归入 suffix，并非派生后缀；表示他／她的，具体指代由上下文确定。词干不变，ny 读 /ɲ/。输入 Jawi 对应 pandangan；完整形式为 ڤندڠنڽ。

etymology.historical_story: The transparent Malay formation links pandang, looking, with pandangan, a gaze or view. Its meanings connect physical sight with mental judgment: what someone sees becomes how someone understands a situation. Adding the bound pronoun -nya identifies whose view is involved. This explains the semantic relationship without claiming an unverified ancient borrowing or historical episode.

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds pengganti from ganti, replacement or substitution, using the productive noun-forming prefix peN-. Before g, the prefix appears as peng-, while the original g remains audible. The resulting noun can name either a person taking over duties or a substitute object. Adding -nya connects that replacement to someone or something already mentioned.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ganti 是“换”，pengganti 是“来顶替的”，-nya 把它接回前文：他／她的接班人，或它的替代品。

etymology.historical_story: English prophet reached Middle English through French and Latin, ultimately from Greek prophētēs, a person who interprets divine will. Its history emphasizes speaking on behalf of a divine power, not simply guessing tomorrow. English later developed broader uses for forecasters and influential advocates. Malay generally uses nabi for the religious sense. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/prophet).

morphology.formula: pelan（慢、轻声） + -kan → pelankan（使放慢、使声音变小）

etymology.historical_story: Pelankan illustrates how everyday speech can turn a descriptive word into a request. DBP records pelan as a colloquial equivalent of perlahan, while another pelan means an open space in Jakarta usage. These are separate dictionary senses: the packet selected the latter, so its definition cannot explain a request to lower the volume. [DBP: pelan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=Pelan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pelan 记成“慢一点、轻一点”，-kan 表示“使它变成这样”：pelankan 就是让速度慢下来或让声音轻下来。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，按现代马来语作为独立词基记忆；不能拆成马来语前缀 pro- 与词根 duktif。词中音节末的 /k/ 可不除阻；produkt iviti 所对应的正确拼写为 produktiviti，是相关借词，并非添加马来语后缀而成。

word_family.gloss: 多产或富有成效的性质
生产率；生产力，与 produktif 相关的借词

senses.zh_definition: 能大量产出产品、作品或其他成果的；生产能力强的；多产的。

senses.ms_definition: Berupaya atau boleh mengeluarkan hasil yang banyak.
senses.nuances: 形容人、产业或生产活动的产出能力；不等于单纯忙碌，也不等于 proaktif（主动采取行动）。义项依据 [DBP PRPM：produktif](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=produktif)。

senses.zh_definition: 能产生有用成果或实际进展的；富有成效的。

senses.ms_definition: Mencapai banyak hasil; berhasil.
senses.nuances: 常用于会议、讨论、谈判或一段工作时间，重点是取得成果，而非活动持续多久。义项依据 [DBP PRPM：produktif](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=produktif)。

senses.zh_definition: 具有繁殖或生育能力的；处于能繁育后代阶段的。
senses.en_definition: Capable of reproducing or producing offspring; fertile.
senses.ms_definition: Berupaya membiak, melahirkan anak atau menyebabkan kelahiran; subur.
senses.nuances: 属于生物繁殖义，须由上下文与生产、工作义区分；例如 umur produktif 在不同语境中也可能指能积极工作的年龄阶段。义项依据 [DBP PRPM：produktif](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=produktif)。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies produktif as an English borrowing. Its Malay meanings connect abundant output, useful results, and reproductive capacity through one shared idea: bringing something into existence. This makes the word equally at home in descriptions of writers, workplace discussions, and fertility. Learn it as a complete borrowed adjective rather than inventing a Malay prefix inside it. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=produktif)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 produktif 与英语 productive 联想：忙完之后有成果，才叫 produktif。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records guam as an older word for a dispute, including a dispute in court. Its family includes peguam and guaman. Adding bela, meaning to defend, forms the professional expression peguam bela. The transparent connection is between a dispute, the person handling it, and advocacy for a client. [DBP: guam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=guam)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两块记：peguam＝律师，bela＝维护、辩护；合起来是“为当事人辩护的律师”，书写时两块之间留空格。

morphology.pattern_note: 是口语短语缩约，不是加词缀。lepas 省去首音节 le-，itu 缩为 tu，再连写。按输入作为独立检索词处理；is_root 不表示它没有可分析的来源。

senses.zh_definition: 然后；之后；表示某件事发生后，另一件事接着发生。
senses.en_definition: Then; after that; subsequently.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk percakapan bagi lepas itu, yang bermaksud kemudian atau selepas sesuatu perkara berlaku.
senses.nuances: 常见于马来西亚日常会话与聊天文字。正式书面语一般改用 kemudian 或 selepas itu。这里的马来文释义是对口语用法的规范表述，并非声称 DBP 为 pastu 提供了独立释文。[Hoogervorst：马来西亚半岛青年语言研究](https://tufs.repo.nii.ac.jp/record/1384/files/nusa5803.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 用于承接对方的话并追问“然后呢？”；特定语气下也表示“所以呢？”。
senses.en_definition: A conversational prompt meaning “and then?” or, with a challenging tone, “so?”
senses.ms_definition: Ungkapan percakapan untuk meminta sambungan cerita atau menanyakan maksud dan kesan sesuatu pernyataan.
senses.nuances: 是“之后”在互动中的延伸。疑问语调可表示好奇；短促或冷淡的语气可能显得不耐烦、轻蔑或质疑。不能把每个 pastu 都机械译成带挑战意味的“所以呢”。

etymology.historical_story: Pastu compresses the familiar sequence lepas itu into a compact conversational connector. The initial syllable of lepas disappears, itu becomes tu, and the remaining pieces join together. Research on West Malaysian youth language documents this kind of shortening, showing how everyday speech supplies informal writing with forms that differ from classroom Malay.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lepas itu 越说越快：lepas tu → pas tu → pastu。意思始终接着往下走：“然后”。

word_family.gloss: 多个前提；多处营业场所

senses.zh_definition: 前提；为进行论证并得出结论而暂时视为真实的陈述或命题。

senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu pernyataan dan sebagainya yang diandaikan atau dianggap sebagai sesuatu yang benar untuk tujuan membuat huraian yang membawa kepada sesuatu kesimpulan kelak.
senses.nuances: 常见于逻辑、学术论证和方案讨论。前提可以接受检验；称某陈述为 premis 并不保证其实际为真。不要与表示地点的 premis 混淆。义项及 berpremiskan 见 [DBP PRPM：premis](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=premis)。

senses.zh_definition: 营业或机构运作所使用的建筑物及其所在场地。
senses.en_definition: A building and its associated grounds used for business or institutional activities.
senses.ms_definition: Bangunan dan kawasan tempat diuruskan perniagaan dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 常见于营业执照、检查通知、租赁和机构管理。马来语可说 sebuah premis，表示一处场所；此词本身不带英语 premises 的复数语法限制。见 [DBP PRPM：premis](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=premis)。

etymology.historical_story: The two meanings have a revealing parallel in English. Premise traces through French to medieval Latin praemissa, a proposition placed before an argument. In legal documents, the plural referred to matters previously stated, including descriptions of property. That use developed into premises meaning buildings and grounds. Malay records both meanings under premis. [American Heritage Dictionary：premise](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=premise)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: premis 记两种“立足点”：论证立足的前提，生意立足的场所。看搭配判断是哪一种。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，不按马来语词缀拆分；词首 ps- 可读 /ps/ 或简化为 /s/，两种读法均见输入词典资料。

word_family.gloss: 精神病性状态；相关同源术语
抗精神病的；抗精神病药

senses.zh_definition: 出现精神病性症状、经历精神病性状态的人。
senses.en_definition: A person experiencing psychosis.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mengalami psikosis.
senses.nuances: 输入的《Kamus Dewan》收录这一指人名词义，但直接以病况称呼一个人容易造成标签化。现代关怀语境宜用 orang yang mengalami psikosis。以下名词搭配用于识别既有表达，不作为推荐称呼。

collocations.zh: 一名经历精神病性状态的人（标签式称呼）
collocations.en: a person with psychosis, described by a diagnostic label

collocations.zh: 经历精神病性状态的人群（标签式统称）
collocations.en: people with psychosis, grouped under a diagnostic label

senses.zh_definition: 精神病性的；具有现实辨识受损等精神病性症状特征的。
senses.en_definition: Relating to, characterized by, or involving psychosis.
senses.ms_definition: Bersifat atau mempunyai ciri-ciri psikosis.
senses.nuances: 用于描述症状、发作或病况，不等于一般的生气、古怪或情绪激动，也不能与 psikopatik 混同。精神病性症状可包括幻觉、妄想及思维紊乱，不能仅凭日常行为随意判定。[NIMH](https://www.nimh.nih.gov/health/publications/understanding-psychosis)

etymology.historical_story: Psikotik belongs to the international vocabulary of psychiatry and corresponds to English psychotic. Merriam-Webster dates the English adjective to around 1890. Malay treats psikotik as a complete borrowed base rather than a native affixed construction. Its relationship with psikosis helps learners distinguish a description of symptoms from the name of the condition. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/psychotic)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 psikosis（精神病性状态）与 psikotik（具有这种状态特征的）配对记忆；同一概念，一词命名状态，一词描述特征。

senses.zh_definition: （英语夹用）从若干选项中挑选、选定。

senses.nuances: 马来西亚音乐交流中可见英语名词与马来语名词组合。正式马来语可用 plektrum；这是工具名词，与动词“挑选”须分开理解。[Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/pick_2)

etymology.historical_story: English pick has a medieval history involving Middle English piken and connections with words for pricking and piercing. Its meanings developed beyond pointed actions to include selecting and plucking. In a Malay sentence, the unchanged spelling is best explained here as English code-switching; this packet does not establish an officially standardized Malay borrowing. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=pick)

etymology.historical_story: Perbankan shows how Malay builds vocabulary for an entire field around an institutional name. Bank identifies the institution, while per-...-an extends attention to its activities and transactions. The dictionary example perbankan Islam illustrates how the same formation accommodates a specifically named banking system within a broader category of financial activity. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=perbankan)

senses.zh_definition: 否认某项说法、指控或事实的行为；否认声明。
senses.en_definition: The act or a statement of denying an allegation, assertion or fact.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau perbuatan menafikan; penyangkalan.
senses.nuances: 新闻和正式声明中常见。penafian 描述否认这一行为，本身不能证明指控属实或不实。核心释义见 [DBP PRPM：penafian](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=penafian)。

senses.zh_definition: 语法或逻辑上对命题、属性或意义的否定。
senses.en_definition: The grammatical or logical negation of a proposition, property or meaning.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan atau fungsi menidakkan makna sesuatu kata atau pernyataan.
senses.nuances: 属于核心否认义的语言学用法。可讨论 tidak、bukan 等否定表达；不要与表示被动语态的 imbuhan di- 混淆。

senses.zh_definition: 说明责任、立场、保证或适用范围受到限制的声明；免责声明。
senses.en_definition: A disclaimer stating limits on responsibility, endorsement, warranties or applicability.
senses.ms_definition: Pernyataan yang menjelaskan batas tanggungjawab, jaminan, pendirian atau penggunaan sesuatu maklumat.
senses.nuances: 常作网站、报告或影片的栏目标题，对应 disclaimer。此处马来语定义为用法释义整理，并非输入词典原句；该用法见 [DBP 语言咨询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penafian)。

senses.zh_definition: 对某人应有权利、机会或获得某项事物的资格的拒绝给予；剥夺。
senses.en_definition: The withholding or deprivation of a right, opportunity or access.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan tidak memberikan atau tidak membenarkan seseorang menikmati hak, peluang atau kemudahan tertentu.
senses.nuances: penafian hak 强调不让人享有权利，并非单纯口头否认该权利存在。译作 deprivation 时须依具体领域和宾语判断；DBP 亦列有这一对应用法。

etymology.historical_story: Penafian combines Malay nominalising morphology with nafi, which Kamus Dewan identifies as an Arabic borrowing. The root centres on rejection and denial. Malay develops it into menafikan and penafian, showing how an imported root becomes part of a productive local word family used in statements, argument and grammatical explanation. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=nafi).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 nafi＝否认；peN-...-an 把动作变成名词：penafian＝否认这件事，也可指一则否认声明。

etymology.historical_story: Partai entered Indonesian through Dutch partij, whereas Malaysian parti reflects English party. The contrasting spellings preserve different histories of European contact within closely related languages. Dutch partij can denote both a political grouping and a quantity of merchandise, helping explain why the supplied Malay dictionary entry records both political and commercial meanings. See the [Indonesian language ministry's archived discussion](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/4461/1/Bahasa%20dan%20Susastra%20Dalam%20Guntingan%20-%20Maret%202010%20Nomor%2003.pdf) and the [Dutch etymological entry](https://www.ensie.nl/etymologisch-woordenboek/partij).

etymology.historical_story: Pengertian belongs to the Malay family built around erti, meaning meaning or significance. Its circumfix turns that base into an abstract noun. The dictionary records a revealing range: individual understanding, conceptual meaning, mutual agreement, and explanation. These connected senses show how grasping an idea can extend into reaching understanding with another person.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 erti“意义”：pengertian 就是脑中形成的“意义与理解”。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies proses as an English borrowing. Malay then uses its own productive prefix peN- to form pemproses, naming something that performs processing. The same formation serves kitchens, factories, and computing. Its retained p illustrates how an imported consonant cluster can survive while the borrowed base participates in Malay word formation. [DBP: proses](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=proses).

etymology.historical_story: English pawn brings together two separate histories. The chess word came through French from a term for a foot soldier, explaining its humble place on the board. The pledge word came through French from a term for security. Their shared spelling does not make them one historical word, and neither establishes an official Malay headword. [Etymonline: pawn](https://www.etymonline.com/word/pawn)

etymology.historical_story: Malay uses pedih for both a stinging body and a wounded heart. This connection makes physical sensation a language for emotional experience: smoke can hurt the eyes, while words can hurt the heart. The dictionary records both meanings. This is a documented semantic relationship, rather than evidence for a particular borrowing history or a precisely dated origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pe.dih 联想成“皮，疼！”：皮肤受刺激会 pedih，心受伤也会 pedih。此联想仅用于记忆，并非词源。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是表示第二人称领属的附着代词，此处借 suffix 字段记录，并非派生后缀。它与前词连写，不改变词根读音。包内 Jawi 仅记录 pedang，未包含 -mu。连写规则见 [DBP 拼写指南](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 你的剑或长刃刀；指属于对话对象、通常具有长而锋利刀刃的兵器。
senses.en_definition: Your sword: a weapon with a long, sharp blade belonging to the person addressed.
senses.ms_definition: Pedang kepunyaan orang yang dilawan bercakap, iaitu senjata berbilah panjang dan tajam.
senses.nuances: 这是 pedang 与领属附着代词 -mu 的透明组合，不是另一种兵器名称。pedang 不限于中文严格意义上的双刃直剑，也可指单刃或弯刃兵器。-mu 常见于文学、对白和亲近称呼；日常马来西亚口语也常说 pedang awak 或 pedang kau。兵器释义依据 [DBP：pedang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=pedang)。

etymology.historical_story: Pedangmu tells a grammatical story: Malay attaches the short pronoun -mu to pedang to identify the sword's owner. The base also appears in names of ceremonial and curved swords, showing that its range is broader than one blade design. This entry does not establish a deeper historical origin for pedang. See [DBP's sword entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=pedang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pedang 是“剑”，-mu 是“你的”：看到 pedangmu，就想象剑柄上贴着“你的”标签。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留英语原词；这里不把它分析为正式马来语词根。IPA 为英语读音；正式马来文应按语境使用 pek、bungkusan、membungkus 或 mengemas。英语派生形式不列作马来语词族。

senses.zh_definition: 包；一包商品或成套物品。此处为英语词义，在马来语正式表达中通常按语境译为 pek、peket 或 bungkusan。
senses.en_definition: A package or a set of items supplied together; an English word whose Malay equivalent depends on context.
senses.ms_definition: Perkataan Inggeris yang merujuk kepada pek, bungkusan atau sekumpulan barang yang disediakan bersama-sama.
senses.nuances: 不将英语拼写 pack 标记为已核实的正式马来语词头。DBP 提供 pek、bungkus、paket 等不同语境的对应表达；具体选择须看所指物品。[DBP：pack 的对应表达](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=paket)。以下搭配属于混合语码教学例。

senses.zh_definition: 把物品装入包、箱等容器；打包或收拾行李。此处为英语动词在混合语码中的用法。
senses.en_definition: To put belongings or goods into a bag, box or other container for storage or transport.
senses.ms_definition: Perkataan Inggeris yang bermaksud memasukkan barang ke dalam beg atau bekas, membungkus barang, atau mengemas barang untuk dibawa.
senses.nuances: 所列为英语原词的混合语码用法，非 DBP 马来语词头释义。收拾行李可说 mengemas barang；包装商品可说 membungkus barang。[Cambridge：pack](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/pack)

etymology.historical_story: The supplied spelling is English pack. English dictionaries record both the action of putting belongings into containers and the package or collection itself. DBP supplies different Malay equivalents according to context, including pek and bungkus. These references explain the English–Malay relationship here; they do not establish pack as a standardized Malay headword or date its local adoption. [DBP terminology](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=BUNGKUS)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pack 想成“把东西装进包”：动作是收拾、打包；装好的一份就是一包。正式马来文再按语境换成 mengemas、membungkus 或 pek。

morphology.pattern_note: is_root、root_word及词缀分类沿用数据包的整词归档方式；实际构词是 pantul 加名词后缀 -an，词干辅音不变，词尾 l 与后缀元音连读。

senses.zh_definition: 物体碰撞表面后弹回的运动；反弹。
senses.en_definition: The movement of an object bouncing back after striking a surface; a rebound.
senses.ms_definition: Gerakan memantul atau mengambul, seperti gerakan bola selepas terkena sesuatu permukaan.
senses.nuances: 用于球、弹簧等的回弹。pantulan 通常指一次反弹或反弹现象；pemantulan 更突出过程。

senses.zh_definition: 光、声音或其他波遇到界面后返回原介质的现象；反射，也可指反射形成的影像。
senses.en_definition: The return of light, sound, or other waves from a surface; also, an image produced by reflected light.
senses.ms_definition: Gerakan cahaya, bunyi atau gelombang yang berbalik apabila mengenai sesuatu permukaan; juga bayangan yang terhasil daripadanya.
senses.nuances: pantulan cahaya 是光的反射，pantulan wajah 是反射形成的脸部影像。不要与 pembiasan（折射）混淆。

senses.zh_definition: 受到刺激后自动发生、不由意志控制的反应；反射动作。
senses.en_definition: An automatic, involuntary response to a stimulus; a reflex.
senses.ms_definition: Tindakan atau gerak balas yang berlaku secara automatik atau tidak disengajakan terhadap sesuatu rangsangan.
senses.nuances: 此义用于生理或心理反应；现代说明中也常见 refleks 或 gerak balas refleks。不能据此把所有有意识的回应都称为生理反射。

senses.zh_definition: 比喻对某件事作出的反应或回应。
senses.en_definition: A reaction or response to something, used figuratively.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, reaksi atau tindak balas terhadap sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 此义较具修辞色彩，日常表达一般用 reaksi 或 tindak balas；下列是符合此义的搭配示例，不宜视为常见固定术语。义项依据：[PRPM：pantul](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pantul)。

etymology.historical_story: Pantulan is formed from pantul with the Malay noun suffix -an. Its dictionary meanings connect a bouncing ball, reflected light, and an automatic response through the idea of something returning or responding. These established uses offer a useful semantic connection without requiring an invented account of the root's earliest origin. [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pantul)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按三拍读 pan-tu-lan，想象球落地后“弹、弹、弹”；再把弹回的球换成返回眼睛的光，就是反射。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆，没有可据此拆出的马来语词缀。管状物义与中国乐器义须按语境区分；不把 paip 当作其派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 管子；用于输送液体、气体等的中空管道。
senses.en_definition: A hollow tube or pipe used to convey liquids, gases, or other substances.
senses.ms_definition: Pembuluh atau saluran berongga untuk mengalirkan air, gas atau bahan lain.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录的管道义；在当代马来西亚日常及技术表达中，paip 通常更自然。这里的 pipa 不应一概译作水龙头。马来文释义据词典改写：[DBP：pipa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pipa)。

senses.zh_definition: 烟嘴；用于连接或夹持香烟的吸烟器具。
senses.en_definition: A cigarette holder fitted between a cigarette and the smoker's mouth.
senses.ms_definition: Alat penyambung rokok yang diperbuat daripada bahan seperti tulang, gading atau kayu.
senses.nuances: 对应词典中的 alat penyambung rokok；与具有烟斗钵、可直接装填烟草的烟斗有别。下列搭配为说明性组合，不表示已核定为高频搭配。[DBP：pipa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pipa)。

senses.zh_definition: 烟斗；具有装填烟草的斗钵和吸嘴的吸烟器具。
senses.en_definition: A smoking pipe with a bowl for tobacco and a stem through which smoke is drawn.
senses.ms_definition: Alat untuk menghisap tembakau yang lazimnya mempunyai bekas tembakau dan batang penghisap.
senses.nuances: 常见于 pipa tembakau。马来西亚也使用 paip 表示烟斗；须依上下文与管道义区分。马来文释义据词典改写：[DBP：pipa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pipa)。

senses.zh_definition: 工厂的排烟烟囱；词典标注为印度尼西亚用法。
senses.en_definition: A factory chimney or smokestack, marked as Indonesian usage.
senses.ms_definition: Cerobong yang menyalurkan asap keluar dari kilang.
senses.nuances: 词典以 Id 标注，典型表达为 pipa pabrik；不作为当代马来西亚常用说法教授，当地通常说 cerobong asap kilang。下列为词典表达及其说明性扩展。[DBP：pipa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pipa)。

senses.zh_definition: 桶；盛装物品的圆形容器，属于古典马来语用法。
senses.en_definition: A barrel or cask used to hold goods; an archaic literary sense.
senses.ms_definition: Bekas berbentuk bulat seperti tong untuk menyimpan atau mengisi sesuatu.
senses.nuances: DBP 标注 sl，表示旧文学用语；现代通常使用 tong。下列为帮助阅读古文而编制的组合，不宣称是现代高频搭配。[DBP：pipa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pipa)。

senses.zh_definition: 琵琶；中国传统四弦弹拨乐器。

etymology.historical_story: Pipa brings together several histories under one spelling. Malay dictionaries preserve pipe, smoking implement, chimney, and old cask senses. Malaysian cultural institutions also use pipa for the Chinese lute, whose name corresponds to Chinese 琵琶. These meanings should not be presented as a single story in which a water pipe developed into a musical instrument. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pipa), [JKKN](https://pemetaanbudaya.jkkn.gov.my/senibudaya/detail/974).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 音乐场景里，pipa 就联想中文“琵琶”；读到 pipa air 则看 air＝水，判断为水管。先看搭配，再选词义。

morphology.formula: ∅ + pake → pake；若指 pakai 的口语变体，则规范化为 pakai
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入的表层词根标记，但这不表示 pake 已确认为标准马来语词根。若对应 pakai，可分析为部分口语中的 /ai/ 单元音化为 /ɛ/ 或 /e/，并非加词缀。所列 IPA 仅对应这一条件性读法；缺少原句，无法确认具体方言及读音。以下词族属于标准词 pakai。

senses.nuances: 这是有条件的释义，不能仅凭孤立拼写认定为标准马来西亚马来语词。研究材料记录了 Betawi 口语 pake 对应 pakai；标准穿戴义可参照 DBP 的 memakai。以下为按该对应关系构造的口语组合，未验证其马来西亚使用频率。[口语研究](https://jurnal.stkipkw.ac.id/index.php/pji/article/download/102/53/341)，[DBP：memakai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=+memakai+)。

etymology.historical_story: Research on classroom speech documents pake as a Betawi form corresponding to Indonesian pakai. This offers evidence for an informal wear-or-use interpretation, but it does not establish the provenance of this isolated token. In a Malaysian Malay dictionary, its relationship to standard pakai should therefore remain explicit and conditional, without claiming official recognition. [Speech study](https://jurnal.stkipkw.ac.id/index.php/pji/article/download/102/53/341).

senses.zh_definition: 旅途中暂时停留、停泊或降落的地点；中途停靠处。
senses.en_definition: A place where travellers, ships, or aircraft stop temporarily during a journey.
senses.ms_definition: Tempat singgah, berlabuh, berhenti atau mendarat.
senses.nuances: 核心是行程中的暂留地点，不必是最终目的地，也不必提供住宿。常见于交通、旅游及较书面的叙述。[DBP《Kamus Dewan》词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=persinggahan)。

senses.zh_definition: 船舶等在行程中的一次停靠或到访，尤用于运输记录和统计。
senses.en_definition: A stop or call made during a journey, especially a ship's call recorded in transport statistics.
senses.ms_definition: Peristiwa singgah atau berhenti sementara dalam perjalanan, khususnya oleh kapal di pelabuhan.
senses.nuances: 这是运输机构实际使用的事件义；例如 bilangan persinggahan kapal 统计停靠次数，而非港口数量。该释义为依据用例编写的概括。[马来西亚国会港口统计资料](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/ipms/eps/2022-07-25/ST.93.2022%20-%20ST%2093.2022.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Persinggahan grows transparently from singgah, meaning to stop briefly along the way. The circumfix per-...-an turns that action into a noun. Its dictionary examples connect sea routes with air travel: a harbour and an airport can both serve the same human need, a temporary pause before the journey continues.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 singgah＝顺路停一下；外面套上 per-...-an，就把动作装进一个“中途停靠处”。

etymology.historical_story: Pengamal combines the Malay agent prefix peN- with amal, a word borrowed from Arabic ʿamal, meaning action or work. Its structure makes the connection memorable: a pengamal is someone who puts something into practice. Malay dictionaries record both professional practitioners and people who practise particular teachings or knowledge, linking occupation with habitual action. [Arabic loanword research](https://ejournal.um.edu.my/index.php/JUD/article/download/4257/2103/10321); [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=pengamal).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: amal 是“做、实践”，peng- 把实践连到人：pengamal 就是实际去做的从业者或践行者。

etymology.historical_story: Penarik is formed within Malay from tarik, meaning pull, using the agent or instrument prefix peN-. Its initial t disappears during derivation, leaving penarik. Dictionary examples include the familiar penarik beca, linking the word with human transport work. In penarik perhatian, the same pulling image becomes figurative: something draws the mind rather than moving a physical load. [DBP morphology](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tarik); [DBP usage](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=perhatian).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tarik 是“拉”，peN- 指拉的人或工具：penarik 能拉动车，也能把人的注意力“拉过来”。

etymology.historical_story: Perli is recorded in Malay dictionaries as a noun for sarcastic or mocking speech, with related verbs such as memerli. Its deeper historical origin is not established by the supplied evidence. The useful cultural picture is indirect criticism: a remark may sound playful while still leaving its listener hurt. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=perli).

etymology.historical_story: The tyre sense of pancit is commonly traced to English punctured, reshaped into a compact Malay form. A linguist discussing Malay borrowings notes that its final t reflects the English ending. DBP also records a separate liquid-squirting entry; sharing a spelling does not establish that both meanings have the same historical origin. [Linguist's discussion](https://brunei-linguistics.blogspot.com/2010/); [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pancit)

etymology.historical_story: Perangkat preserves a vocabulary of things belonging together: equipment for a purpose and, in seperangkat, a complete outfit or set. DBP also records an older departure meaning under perangkatan. Today, regional terminology matters: Indonesian perangkat lunak corresponds to Malaysian perisian. Recognizing this difference helps readers understand neighbouring usage without importing it automatically into Malaysian writing. [DBP: perangkat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=perangkat); [DBP: regional software terminology](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=perisian)

etymology.historical_story: The base pecut denotes a whip, while its verb memecut also means to move faster or make something accelerate. Pemecut uses the productive Malay prefix peN- to name an accelerating device. The vocabulary thus connects a familiar means of urging movement with modern computing and physics, although the precise date of this technical formation is not established here. [DBP: pecut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pecutan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pecut 是“催快、加速”的核心；peN- 给动作配上工具身份：pemecut 就是“让处理或运动更快的东西”。

morphology.pattern_note: 不作马来语词缀分析。西班牙语重音在末音节；区分 s 与 z 的口音读 /pinˈθon/，采用 seseo 的口音读 /pinˈson/。末尾 -ón 不能据字形直接认定为此词的增大后缀。

senses.ms_definition: Nama burung dalam bahasa Sepanyol, lazimnya merujuk kepada Fringilla coelebs; perkataan ini juga terdapat dalam nama beberapa burung finch yang lain.
senses.nuances: 未据输入包确立为规范马来语词。这里处理小写西班牙语普通名词，不擅自解释为姓氏或地名 Pinzón。以下搭配保留西语鸟名，并在 ms 栏加马来语说明；它们不是马来语常用搭配。pinzón vulgar 指 Fringilla coelebs，pinzón real 指 Fringilla montifringilla。[SEO/BirdLife：苍头燕雀](https://seo.org/ave/pinzon-vulgar/)、[Audubon：燕雀](https://www.audubon.org/es/guia-de-aves/ave/pinzon-real)。

etymology.historical_story: Pinzón belongs to Spanish bird vocabulary rather than established Malay morphology. Spanish bird guides use pinzón vulgar for the common chaffinch and pinzón real for the brambling. These related names illustrate why a translated bird label needs context: the accompanying adjective can identify a different species. No deeper etymological claim is established here. [Spanish bird names](https://seo.org/ave/pinzon-vulgar/); [brambling](https://www.audubon.org/es/guia-de-aves/ave/pinzon-real).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pinzón 末尾重读的声音想成一声清亮鸟鸣，联想到“雀鸟”；这是联想口诀，不是词源解释。

morphology.pattern_note: -an 构成名词，可指被转移的事物，或在专业搭配中指转移事项；词根末尾 h 保留，接元音后形成 pin.da.han。

word_family.gloss: 转移、搬运或迁置的行为

senses.zh_definition: 被搬移、转移或移植的东西；常置于名词之后，说明该事物是从别处转来的。
senses.en_definition: Something moved, transferred or transplanted; also used after a noun to identify a transferred item.
senses.ms_definition: Barang, harta atau sesuatu yang dipindahkan.
senses.nuances: barang pindahan 指搬迁或转运的物品，并不自动表示二手货。固定搭配 kaum pindahan 在传统词典中指生活上迁徙不定的群体，不等同于所有移民。基本释义见 [DBP：pindahan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=pindahan)；移植搭配见 [DBP：transplant](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=transplant)。

senses.zh_definition: 转移、划拨或转认的事项；用于资金、学分及数据等专业搭配。
senses.en_definition: A transfer, especially of funds, academic credits or data.
senses.ms_definition: Pemindahan wang, kredit, data atau perkara lain daripada satu akaun, institusi atau sistem kepada yang lain.
senses.nuances: 这是专业搭配中的用法扩展。pindahan wang 指转账，pindahan kredit 在教育中指学分转移或认可，不应直接理解为金钱信用转账。资金用法见 [DBP：电子资金转移](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=fund)，教育用法见 [马来西亚教育部：MQA 认证说明](https://www.moe.gov.my/pentingnya-akreditasi-mqa-bernama-26-mei-2019)。

etymology.historical_story: The everyday verb pindah describes changing place. With -an, Malay can name what has been moved, as in goods carried to another home. The same family also serves modern institutions: money moves between accounts, credits between study programmes, and data between systems. These uses preserve the concrete image of something passing from one location to another.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pindah＝搬走，-an＝把相关事物或事项命名：搬的是物品，就是 barang pindahan；转的是钱，就是 pindahan wang。

morphology.pattern_note: 此处 -nya 是附着代词，按给定字段归入 suffix；常指前文的人或事物。/ɲ/ 写作 ny，接在 perhatikan 后不使词干末尾 /n/ 脱落。perhatikan 是输入包指定的直接基础形式。

senses.en_definition: Observe or pay attention to it, him, or her, with the referent supplied by context.
senses.ms_definition: Lihat atau amati orang atau perkara yang dirujuk oleh -nya dengan teliti; berikan perhatian kepadanya.
senses.nuances: -nya 的具体指代依上下文决定，不标性别；不能机械地译成“他的注意”。这通常是带代词的动词形式，并非独立词根。正式主动陈述常用 memerhatikannya，如 Pegawai itu memerhatikannya。释义据相关动词归纳，非独立词条引文；参见 [PRPM：memperhatikan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=memperhatikan)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay vocabulary connects hati with feeling and attention, as seen in the family containing perhatian and memerhatikan. Perhatikannya adds the familiar attached pronoun -nya to perhatikan. This makes the expression depend on shared context: a speaker can point attention towards a person, object, or event already mentioned without repeating its name.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: perhatikan＝留意；接上 -nya＝留意“它／他／她”。先找前文指代，再翻译。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 实际是附着于名词后的代词性附着成分，表示“它的／他的／她的”或承接已知对象；此处按给定枚举归 suffix，不是另造名词的派生后缀。词根读音不变，ny 为 /ɲ/，可分作 pi.cu.nya。headword.jawi 按原包保留，但 ڤيچو 只对应 picu；完整形式依构词应写作 ڤيچوڽ。

senses.ms_definition: Pemetik pada pistol, senapang atau alat seumpamanya yang dirujuk dalam konteks; -nya menandakan hubungan milik atau rujukan kepada perkara yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: DBP 所给词条是 picu，picunya 则是 picu 加 -nya 的语境形式，不是本包另行证实的独立词条。-nya 的指代须从上下文判断，不固定译为“他的”。不能仅凭本包把它释为抽象的“原因／诱因”。status 的 official 保留指定标签，不表示完整形式已获单独收录。[DBP：picu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=picu)

etymology.historical_story: Picunya joins picu, the Malay word for a trigger, with the attached pronoun -nya. DBP also records memicu for pulling a firearm's trigger. The ending lets a speaker refer back to an object without repeating its name. This explains the form's modern structure; the supplied evidence does not establish picu's deeper historical origin. [DBP: picu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=picu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: picu＝扳机，-nya＝它的：picunya 就是“它的扳机”。先找前文的器具，再确定“它”是谁。

etymology.historical_story: Pettigrew is a Scottish and English surname of Norman origin. The Dictionary of American Family Names cautiously connects it with Anglo-Norman words meaning little and growth, probably a nickname for a small man. This historical explanation concerns the surname, not the personality of every bearer or Rowling’s reasons for choosing it. [Surname reference](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/pettigrew)

etymology.historical_story: English puppy originally referred to a lapdog in the late fifteenth century. Oxford cautiously connects it with French poupee, meaning a doll or plaything, a connection that evokes a small companion animal. Its familiar meaning is now a young dog. In Malay conversation, using puppy involves English code-switching; the standard Malay equivalent is anak anjing. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/puppy)

etymology.historical_story: Pertanyaanku shows how Malay builds a personal expression in layers. Tanya supplies the act of asking; per- and -an form the noun pertanyaan; the attached pronoun -ku identifies the question as mine. The same compact possessive pattern appears in namaku and rumahku. It gives diaries, dialogue and reflective writing a concise first-person voice.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tanya＝问，pertanyaan＝问题，ku＝我的；连起来就是“我的问题”。

headword.verification_note: 本词是 posisi 加第二人称领属附着语 -mu 的组合形式，并非已核实的独立词典词头。输入爪夷文仅表示词根 posisi，未包含 -mu；音标按构词推定。

morphology.formula: posisi + -mu → posisimu（你的位置／你的职位）
morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是表示 kamu 的后附着代词，并非派生后缀；此处按字段归入 suffix。直接连写，词根不发生音变。

senses.zh_definition: 你所处的位置、方位或所在之处。
senses.en_definition: Your position or physical location.
senses.ms_definition: Kedudukan atau letak kamu.
senses.nuances: 以上马来文是根据词根释义及 -mu 改写的组合释义。DBP 将 posisi 标作 IB，表示印度尼西亚语用法；马来西亚一般表达更常用 kedudukan kamu、tempat kamu 或 lokasi kamu。词根另有“词语在句中的位置”这一语法义，但不能不加语境便将 posisimu 解释成“你的语序”。[DBP：posisi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=posisi)

etymology.historical_story: DBP labels posisi as Indonesian usage and records meanings involving location, employment, and grammatical placement. Posisimu combines that existing noun with the shortened pronoun mu, meaning your. Its useful learning story is therefore grammatical: a modern positional noun joins a familiar Malay possessive construction. This analysis does not establish the noun’s ultimate borrowing history. [DBP: posisi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=posisi)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 posisi 联想到英语 position，再接 mu＝你的：posisimu，就是“你的位置”。这是联想记忆，不是词源拆解。

etymology.historical_story: Pilatus illustrates how one spelling can carry several histories. Malay Christian texts use it for Pontius Pilate, while aviation uses it as a Swiss manufacturer's name. The aircraft company began in Stans in 1939. These references require context; they do not establish a shared Malay lexical origin. [Malay text](https://www.bible.com/bible/2271/MAT.27.AVB), [company history](https://www.pilatus-aircraft.com/en/company/heritage).

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在 s 起首的词根前表现为 peny-，词根首字母 s 脱落：seleweng → penyelewengan。两个标作 é 的元音读 /e/。输入包的整词词根标记已纠正；音节依据其 DBP 注音补全。

senses.nuances: 通常带负面评价，比中性的 perbezaan（差异）或 perubahan（变化）更强。宗教语境可指教义或解释上的偏离。[DBP 释义与词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penyelewengan)

senses.zh_definition: 违背受托职责而不当处理或转移资金、资源等的行为；舞弊、挪用或其他违规行为。

etymology.historical_story: Penyelewengan belongs to the Malay word family built on seleweng, which conveys departure from a proper course. The circumfix peN-...-an turns that idea into the name of an act or process. Its modern institutional uses retain this directional image: policy, teachings, or entrusted money can be diverted from their intended course. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penyelewengan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象资金沿规定路线前进，突然 seleweng『拐偏』；peN-...-an 把这次偏离变成名词：penyelewengan。

etymology.historical_story: English pillar developed through Middle English and French forms connected with Latin pila, meaning a column or pier. Its physical supporting role also supplies a familiar metaphor for dependable people and essential principles. For this lexicon, the important distinction is linguistic: DBP records the English item with Malay equivalents, rather than thereby establishing pillar as a standard Malay headword. [Dictionary.com: pillar](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/pillar)

morphology.pattern_note: per-...-an 构成表示活动或过程的名词；gelut 的 g 保留，末尾 t 在加元音起首的 -an 后进入下一音节。root_word 与 root_jawi 按数据包保留；实际语言学词根为 gelut（ݢلوت）。[DBP gelut 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=gelut)。

word_family.gloss: 抱住对方，试图摔倒对方

senses.zh_definition: 双方抱缠、翻滚并试图制服对方的角力活动；摔搏。
senses.en_definition: Wrestling or grappling in which participants struggle bodily with one another.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal bergelut; perlawanan bergelut.
senses.nuances: 着重身体纠缠和角力，可指竞技或嬉闹，不必然涉及敌意。正式摔跤运动通常称 gusti；pergelutan 的范围较宽。

senses.zh_definition: 发生身体接触的扭打、搏斗或争斗。
senses.en_definition: A physical struggle or scuffle between opposing people.
senses.ms_definition: Perkelahian.
senses.nuances: 新闻及警方叙述中常指控制、反抗或抢夺时发生的身体冲突。单纯口角通常用 pertengkaran。词义区分参见 [DBP pergelutan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pergelutan)。

senses.zh_definition: 为谋生、克服困难或处理内心冲突而持续进行的艰苦努力或挣扎。
senses.en_definition: An arduous struggle to survive, overcome difficulties or resolve inner conflict.
senses.ms_definition: Usaha atau kegiatan bertungkus-lumus; pertarungan.
senses.nuances: 比喻用法，将抽象困难表现为需要奋力应对的对手，语气较沉重。常用于生活困境、心理矛盾和文学叙述。

etymology.historical_story: Pergelutan is built from gelut, a Malay base associated with grappling and bodily struggle. The dictionary records both physical fighting and strenuous effort against difficulty. Rather than implying a dated historical event, this semantic connection offers a cultural image: the hardships of earning a living can be described through the bodily experience of wrestling an opponent. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=gelut).

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 遇词根首辅音 p，采用 pem- 形式，并脱落词根首字母 p：pem- + ilih → pemilih。输入包将 pemilih 标为词根，应更正为 pilih。

etymology.historical_story: Pemilih belongs to the Malay pilih family, built around choosing. Its prefix forms a word for the chooser, while dictionary usage also recognizes someone who chooses too fussily. Electoral language gives the chooser a public role: a voter. The connection between everyday selection and political representation makes the word memorable without requiring a speculative origin story. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=pemilih)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve two distinct uses of pendarahan: bleeding and a tree name associated with Myristica cinnamomea. The medical noun is transparently connected with darah, blood, while the botanical entry should not automatically receive the same origin story. Adding -nya links either noun to a possessor or an established referent. Context therefore decides whether the word concerns a patient or a tree. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=pendarahan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 医学义拆成 darah「血」→ pendarahan「出血」→ -nya「其／那次」；植物义另记，别把树名直接解释成流血。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary family of pisah connects physical separation with human parting: memisahkan separates things, while perpisahan names a farewell or separation. An older Indonesian expression recorded by Dewan, ilmu pisah, names chemistry, offering a memorable association with separating substances. This lexical connection is documented; a deeper historical derivation of the root is not established by the supplied packet. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=pisah)

etymology.historical_story: Pepe illustrates how a dictionary preserves regional vocabulary beyond everyday Malaysian usage. Kamus Dewan separates a Jakarta food name, an Indonesian cloth term, and a Javanese-linked tobacco expression. Negeri Sembilan records supply another, differently pronounced item concerning bankruptcy. These records establish distinct regional uses, but they do not establish a shared origin or a historical connection between them.

etymology.historical_story: Pembacaan shows how Malay builds an activity noun from baca through peN-...-an. Its dictionary senses connect reading manuscripts and newspapers, reciting poetry, and checking meters. The shared action is extracting or voicing information from a visible source. This explains why the same noun belongs naturally in libraries, literary gatherings, and utility work.

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 植物义没有特殊敬语要求。电话服务中可用 pemanggil 指称来电者；直接与对方交谈时，应使用合适的姓名或称谓。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 介绍植物时最好同时给出学名，减少俗名混淆。不要从植物名称推断其具有招人、招财或其他神秘功效。口语中的 aku、kau 适合熟悉的同辈，正式交流宜改用 saya 及合适称谓。

etymology.historical_story: Pemanggil illustrates how identical spellings can conceal different lexical histories. Malay dictionaries record both a shrub name and an agent noun meaning a person who calls. The agent noun follows the productive pattern peN- plus panggil. The plant is also called bunga mara or bunga tinggal, but these records do not establish why it acquired the name pemanggil.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看语境：pokok pemanggil 是植物，nombor pemanggil 是来电号码。只有“呼叫者”义适合用 peN- + panggil 来拆解记忆。

morphology.pattern_note: per-...-an 构成表示相关事务、过程或集合的名词；senjata 的首辅音 s 保留，词尾 a 与 -an 的 a 分属相邻音节。

word_family.gloss: 为某人或某群体配备武器

senses.zh_definition: 配备武器、进行武装的过程或相关事务。
senses.en_definition: The process or activity of equipping a force or country with weapons.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal melengkapi dengan senjata.
senses.nuances: 强调武装过程或相关安排，常见于防务政策、计划与国际关系语境。与第二义的武器装备集合区别在于过程和实物的侧重点。官方释义见 [Kamus Dewan／PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=persenjataan)。

senses.zh_definition: 武器及其配套装备的总称；军备、武器装备。
senses.en_definition: Weapons and associated military equipment considered collectively; armaments.

senses.nuances: 是集合性名词，可指一个单位、国家或平台所拥有的武器装备。谈一件具体武器通常用 senjata；persenjataan 的范围比单件武器更广。官方释义见 [Kamus Dewan／PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=persenjataan)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于中性、偏正式的防务与技术词汇，适合新闻、政策讨论、博物馆说明和专业报告。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 讨论军备时可与 pertahanan、penyelenggaraan、pemodenan 等词搭配。日常指某一件武器时使用 senjata 更直接；不要把 persenjataan 泛指所有军用品。

etymology.historical_story: Persenjataan shows how Malay builds a broader concept from a concrete noun. Senjata names a weapon, while the surrounding per-...-an formation creates a noun covering the activity of arming and the equipment involved. This process-versus-collection distinction explains why the same word can refer either to an armament programme or to the weapons themselves. See [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=persenjataan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: senjata 是武器；让 per-...-an 把它包起来，就得到整套武器装备或配备武器这件事：persenjataan。

morphology.formula: ∅ + problem → problem（英语整词用于语码混合）
morphology.pattern_note: 在这里作为英语整词处理，不拆成马来语词缀。所列音标为英式英语读音，不代表统一的马来语口语读法。

senses.zh_definition: 问题；需要处理或解决的困难、故障或麻烦，用于夹杂英语的口语。
senses.en_definition: A difficulty, fault, or troublesome situation requiring attention or a solution.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam pertuturan bercampur bahasa Inggeris, masalah, kesulitan atau kerosakan yang perlu diatasi.
senses.nuances: 本条按英语夹杂用法处理，不标作已核实的官方马来语词条。正式马来语通常用 masalah。马来文释义为编者说明；音标取英语读法。搭配为口语用法示例，未作频率统计。[DBP：masalah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=masalah)；[Oxford：problem](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.co.uk/us/definition/english/problem_1)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 与习惯夹杂英语的朋友或同事交谈时容易理解；对不熟悉英语的人或在正式文件中，使用 masalah 更清楚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 询问 Ada problem? 的语气可能是关心，也可能像质问。需要礼貌协助时可说 Ada apa-apa masalah yang boleh saya bantu?

etymology.historical_story: English problem ultimately comes from Greek problēma, something put forward for consideration, through Latin and French. The older image suits both a puzzle presented for an answer and a difficulty demanding action. In a Malay conversation, the English word can be inserted whole; that use does not itself establish official Malay dictionary status. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.co.uk/us/definition/english/problem_1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语 problem 就是马来语 masalah：聊天可听到 ada problem，正式表达记成 ada masalah。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在元音 a 前实现为 peng-；alih 的首元音保留，不发生首辅音脱落。此处修正输入包将 pengalih 标为独立词根的分析。

senses.zh_definition: 进行转移、转换或改换的人；具体工作通常由后接成分说明。
senses.en_definition: A person who transfers, converts or redirects something, with the particular role usually specified by a following expression.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mengalih atau menukarkan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Pelajar》在 pengubah 的释义中以 pengalih 作近义词；本释义据此及构词关系归纳，并非独立词条原文。见 [DBP：ubah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ubah)。pengalih bahasa 指翻译者，pengalih suara 指配音者，具体意义来自整个短语；单独的 pengalih 不固定等于“翻译”。

senses.zh_definition: 使某物改变方向、位置或注意焦点的装置、事物或手段。
senses.en_definition: A device, thing or means that shifts or diverts something, including attention.
senses.ms_definition: Alat, benda atau cara yang mengalihkan arah, kedudukan atau tumpuan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是依构词和具体搭配归纳的工具、事物义，不应将所有英语 switch、diverter 或 distraction 都机械译成 pengalih。pengalih perhatian 表示转移注意力的人、事物或手段；pengalihan perhatian 则着重转移注意力这一过程。相关术语用例见 [DBP：perhatian](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=perhatian)。

collocations.zh: 转移注意力的事物或手段

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称呼从业者时说完整职业名称，如 pengalih suara；交流或署名时优先采用本人及机构使用的职称。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 不要把 pengalih 当作所有翻译、口译、配音工作的通用称号。正式制作名单应明确实际工作；把他人称作 pengalih perhatian 时，也应注意是否带有指责其故意转移焦点的意味。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 称呼从业者时说完整职业名称，如 pengalih suara；交流或署名时优先采用本人及机构使用的职称。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 不要把 pengalih 当作所有翻译、口译、配音工作的通用称号。正式制作名单应明确实际工作；把他人称作 pengalih perhatian 时，也应注意是否带有指责其故意转移焦点的意味。

etymology.historical_story: Pengalih shows how Malay builds a role from an action. Starting with alih, the prefix peN- produces a noun for someone or something that carries out a transfer or shift. The following word supplies the domain: bahasa points to translation, while suara points to dubbing. This is a transparent morphological explanation; no particular date of coinage is established here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: alih＝转移；peN-＋alih＝负责转移的人或物。接 bahasa 想翻译，接 suara 想配音。

morphology.pattern_note: 此处按英语词处理，不作马来语词缀分析。英语中为单音节，词末 e 不单独发音，g 对应 /dʒ/；所列 IPA 是英语英式读音，不是已确立的马来语读音。

word_family.gloss: 已清除；purge 的过去式和过去分词
清除；purge 的现在分词或动名词

senses.zh_definition: 清除、清空或排除不需要的内容、杂质等；具体操作取决于对象。
senses.en_definition: To remove unwanted contents, substances, or elements from something.
senses.ms_definition: Mengeluarkan atau menyingkirkan kandungan, bahan atau unsur yang tidak dikehendaki daripada sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是英语释义及其马来语解释，不冒充 DBP 的马来语词条定义。技术交流中可能作为英语操作名称出现；正式马来语应按语境使用 memadamkan、mengosongkan 或 menyingkirkan 等表达。读音与英语基本义参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/purge)。以下搭配保留英语成分。

senses.zh_definition: 把被认为不受欢迎或持不同意见的人清除出组织；清洗。
senses.en_definition: To remove unwanted or dissenting members from an organization.
senses.ms_definition: Menyingkirkan anggota yang tidak dikehendaki atau yang berbeza pendirian daripada sesebuah organisasi.
senses.nuances: 用于人的时候语气强烈，往往带有政治排斥或强制清洗的意味，不等同于中性的调职。英语用法参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/purge)。以下为说明性的马英混合组合。

senses.zh_definition: 清除行动；尤指组织内部排除异己的清洗。
senses.en_definition: An act of removing unwanted things or people, especially a political or organizational purge.
senses.ms_definition: Tindakan menyingkirkan perkara atau orang yang tidak dikehendaki, khususnya dalam organisasi atau politik.
senses.nuances: 这是英语名词用法。正式马来语可根据对象改用 penyingkiran 或 pembersihan，并清楚说明被清除的内容。参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/purge)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场技术汇报 / 操作名称说明

dual_scenarios.en: The system administrator will run the 'purge' function to delete temporary data that is no longer needed.

messages.en: It's opening now. Thanks!

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 熟悉英语术语的同事之间可自然切换语言；面对公众或不熟悉技术的对象，应给出明确的马来语说明。

etymology.historical_story: English purge came through French from Latin purgare, meaning to cleanse. The underlying image extends from removing impurities to excluding unwanted people. Modern computing applies the same image to clearing stored contents. This history explains the English word; it does not establish purge as an officially adopted Malay headword. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/purge).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“清掉多余内容”的画面：purge cache 清缓存，purge members 清成员；对象不同，语气强度也不同。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在词根起首 b 前变为 pem-，b 保留，因此形成 pembayar。输入包把 pembayar 标为词根，此处依据其实际构词关系修正为 bayar。词根爪夷文及词族见 [DBP：bayar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=bayar)。

senses.nuances: 重在付款方这一角色，不一定就是消费者、借款人或最终受益人；也可由机构承担付款角色。区别于 penerima bayaran（收款者）及 pembayaran（付款行为）。义项依据 [DBP：bayar／pembayar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=bayar)。

etymology.historical_story: Pembayar illustrates a productive Malay pattern: adding peN- to bayar names the person associated with paying. Before b, the prefix takes the form pem-. The dictionary also records money or property used for payment. From receipts to online transfers, the word identifies a payment role while related forms distinguish the action and the amount.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bayar＝付钱；peN-＋bayar → pembayar＝付款的人。遇到 wang pembayar hutang，则看成“拿来还债的钱”。

morphology.formula: Doctor of Philosophy → PhD；马来语对应 Doktor Falsafah

senses.ms_definition: Kependekan bagi Doctor of Philosophy, iaitu Doktor Falsafah.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录形式为 PhD。常见结构包括 ijazah PhD、calon PhD 和 tesis PhD；口语中的 buat PhD 通常表示攻读博士。Doktor Falsafah 的名称不表示持有人必然研究哲学，也不表示具备行医资格。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=phd)

etymology.historical_story: PhD is the international abbreviation associated with Doctor of Philosophy; Malay names the qualification Doktor Falsafah. Its academic use extends beyond philosophy as a modern subject. Malaysian universities offer it in fields such as engineering and forestry, illustrating the breadth of the title. The abbreviation therefore identifies a doctoral qualification rather than specifying the graduate's research discipline. [UKM programme example](https://www.ukm.my/fkab/ms/doktor-falsafah/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 PhD 连到固定全称 Doctor of Philosophy，再记马来语 Doktor Falsafah；名称里有“哲学”，学科却可以是语言学、工程等。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根保持不变，ny 表示单一辅音 /ɲ/。此处依字段归为 suffix；实际功能须按句法区分，可表示所指对象的长度、使性质名词化，或加强感叹。输入包的 jawi 为词根 panjang 的拼写，完整形式可写作 ڤنجڠڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 其长度；所指物体或空间从一端到另一端的距离。
senses.en_definition: Its length; the end-to-end measurement of the object or space referred to.
senses.ms_definition: Ukuran sesuatu dari satu hujung ke hujung yang lain, dengan -nya merujuk kepada perkara yang telah disebut atau difahami.
senses.nuances: 例如 Tali itu panjangnya tiga meter，表示“那根绳子长三米”。-nya 的指称对象可以是物体，无须解释为某个人。词根也有“高、长久、冗长”等用法，但不能把这些词义全部机械地列为 panjangnya 的独立义项。关于 -nya 的名词化及强调功能，参见 [DBP 语法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penekan)。

senses.zh_definition: 所指时间段的长短；某事持续的时间长度。
senses.en_definition: The duration or temporal extent of the period or activity referred to.
senses.ms_definition: Tempoh atau lamanya sesuatu masa, proses atau kegiatan.
senses.nuances: 用于 membandingkan panjangnya waktu menunggu 等表达时，panjang 指时间上的延续。日常直接询问“多久”通常用 berapa lama；不能在所有场合用 panjangnya 替代 lamanya。

collocations.en: the length of the probationary period

senses.zh_definition: 好长啊；真长，用于感叹物体、队伍、话语或持续时间的长度。
senses.en_definition: How long; so long, used exclamatorily of physical length or duration.
senses.ms_definition: Sangat atau sungguh panjang, digunakan dalam ayat seruan untuk menegaskan sifat panjang.
senses.nuances: Panjangnya barisan ini! 相当于 Barisan ini sungguh panjang!。这里 -nya 加强感叹，不宜逐字译为“它的”。可表达惊讶、赞叹或不耐烦，具体取决于对象与语气。

etymology.historical_story: Panjangnya is a grammatical formation rather than a separate borrowed word. Malay combines panjang, meaning long or length, with -nya, whose functions include reference, nominalization and emphasis. The resulting form connects a measurement such as its length with an emotional exclamation such as how long, depending on the surrounding sentence.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: panjang 是“长”；看到 panjangnya，先看句型：后接数字，多半是“其长度”；句首带感叹，多半是“好长啊”。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在词首 g 前变为 peng-，词根的 g 保留，形成拼写 ngg，对应 /ŋɡ/，不是双重 /ɡ/。输入包把 pengguguran 标为词根，应更正为 gugur。

word_family.gloss: 使掉落；删除；撤下；终止妊娠

senses.zh_definition: 删去、省略或去除文字、语音单位、条款或其他内容的行为或过程。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of deleting, omitting, or removing an element.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau perbuatan menggugurkan sesuatu unsur daripada pertuturan, tulisan atau susunan.
senses.nuances: 语言学中可指省略、删略或音的脱落，具体英文译法随对象而变。并非所有省略都合乎语法。此义是 [PRPM：pengguguran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pengguguran) 所载概括义的教学展开，马来文释义为改述。

senses.zh_definition: 将某人从队伍、名单、阵容或参与安排中撤下的行为。
senses.en_definition: The removal or exclusion of someone from a team, list, or selection.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan mengeluarkan seseorang daripada pasukan, senarai atau pemilihan.
senses.nuances: 常见于体育新闻和组织决定。指撤下或不再列入，未必涉及纪律处分。此义由 [PRPM：gugur 与 menggugurkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=gugur) 所载用法展开。

collocations.zh: 撤下球员；将球员排除出阵容

collocations.en: the removal of a name from a list

senses.zh_definition: 撤回、不再追索某项要求，或放弃、免除某项权利或债务的行为。
senses.en_definition: The withdrawal of a claim or the relinquishment or waiver of a right or obligation.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan tidak meneruskan tuntutan atau melepaskan sesuatu hak atau tanggungan.
senses.nuances: 应按对象区分撤回要求、放弃权利和免除债务，不能一律译为“取消”。参见 [PRPM：pengguguran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pengguguran) 及 [DBP 术语中的权利与债务用法](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=pengguguran)。

senses.zh_definition: 终止妊娠；日常语境通常指人工流产，医学术语中的范围须结合限定词判断。
senses.en_definition: Termination of pregnancy, usually induced abortion in general usage.
senses.ms_definition: Penamatan kehamilan melalui pengeluaran embrio atau fetus sebelum cukup tempohnya, lazimnya secara sengaja dalam penggunaan umum.
senses.nuances: 一般用法常以 pengguguran kandungan 指人工流产，以 keguguran 指自然流产；部分医学术语中的 pengguguran 或 abortion 范围较广，可由 spontan 或 aruhan 等词进一步限定。参见 [DBP 医学术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=pengguguran) 与 [PRPM：keguguran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=keguguran)。

senses.zh_definition: 使物体掉落、脱落或从高处投下的行为或过程。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of causing something to fall or be dropped.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan menyebabkan sesuatu jatuh atau luruh.
senses.nuances: 这是 menggugurkan 的使动义所形成的名词用法；自然发生的掉落也可能用 keguguran 或其他表达，不能机械互换。依据 [PRPM：gugur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=gugur)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 必须明确所去除的对象。不要把所有 pengguguran 都理解为人工流产，也不要未经了解就把他人的自然流产称为 pengguguran kandungan。

etymology.historical_story: The root gugur describes falling and shedding, including fruit falling from a tree. Malay extends that image to something disappearing from a list, a text, or a person's rights. The circumfix peN-...-an names the corresponding process or action. This semantic network connects physical removal with administrative deletion and reproductive terminology. See [PRPM: gugur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=gugur).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象 gugur 的果实“掉下来”：加上 peN-...-an，就把“使某物掉下或被去掉”变成一个过程名称。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在元音 i 前采用 peng-，词根 iktiraf 完整保留；ng 表示 /ŋ/，其中 e 读 /ə/。DBP 也记录保留 /ʕ/ 的读法；此处采用含 /k/ 的读法。

senses.zh_definition: 对某事物的地位、资格、效力或合法性的承认或认可。
senses.en_definition: Recognition or acceptance of the status, qualifications, validity, or legitimacy of something.
senses.ms_definition: Tindakan menerima atau mengakui status, kedudukan, kelayakan atau kesahan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常见于学历、专业资格、机构地位和外交关系。是否具有认证或法律效力，须看授予认可的机构及具体制度，不能仅凭 pengiktirafan 一词推定。马来语释义为据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=94740&keyword=pengiktirafan) 整理的释义，并非逐字引文。

senses.zh_definition: 对某人的贡献、成就或价值给予肯定和赏识。
senses.en_definition: Acknowledgment and appreciation of someone's contribution, achievement, or worth.
senses.ms_definition: Penerimaan dan penghargaan terhadap sumbangan, pencapaian atau jasa seseorang atau sesuatu pihak.
senses.nuances: 此义侧重“肯定与赏识”，未必涉及正式证书、奖项或资格审查；可通过公开致谢、表扬或颁奖体现。此义区分依据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=94740&keyword=pengiktirafan)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈学历、专业资格或机构认可时，应明确认可主体及范围；普通称赞可用 pujian 或 penghargaan，是否使用 pengiktirafan 取决于肯定的性质。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 正式致谢可说 Terima kasih atas pengiktirafan ini，语气得体；团队获肯定时，可接着感谢同事和合作伙伴。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 谈学历、专业资格或机构认可时，应明确认可主体及范围；普通称赞可用 pujian 或 penghargaan，是否使用 pengiktirafan 取决于肯定的性质。

etymology.historical_story: Pengiktirafan combines Malay peN-...-an with iktiraf, an Arabic loan associated with acknowledgment. The resulting noun illustrates how Malay incorporates borrowed vocabulary into its own productive morphology. Its two established meanings connect institutional acceptance with appreciation of merit: a qualification can receive recognition, and so can a person's contribution. The Arabic source carries acknowledgment among its meanings. [Arabic dictionary](https://kutub.nur.nu/Arabic-Language/Hans-Wehr.pdf); [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=Iktiraf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iktiraf 记成“认可”，peN-...-an 把动作装进名词框：mengiktiraf＝认可，pengiktirafan＝认可这件事。

morphology.formula: ∅ + points → points（作为英语整词插入马来语话语）
morphology.pattern_note: 依原包保留 points 为导入单位；这不表示它在英语中不可分析。英语内部是 point + -s，复数词尾在 /t/ 后读 /s/。这里没有马来语派生词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 英语复数名词：比赛、测验或奖励计划中的分数、计分单位或积分；在马来语对话中可作为英语成分出现。
senses.en_definition: Units of scoring or reward credit; the English plural of point.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk jamak bahasa Inggeris bagi point yang merujuk mata dalam pertandingan, penilaian atau program ganjaran.
senses.nuances: 这是英语用法说明，并非 DBP 对马来语正式词目的释义；正式马来语依语境用 mata、markah 或 mata ganjaran。所列混语搭配为教学例子，不代表经语料统计确认的频率。[Cambridge：point](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/point?topic=points-in-time)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语复数名词：讨论、说明或报告中的若干要点、论点或事项。
senses.en_definition: Ideas, arguments or items presented in speech or writing.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk jamak bahasa Inggeris bagi point yang merujuk isi, hujah atau perkara dalam percakapan atau penulisan.
senses.nuances: 混语中可见 points penting 等组合；正式文本宜按含义用 isi penting、hujah 或 perkara utama，而非统一机械替换。[Oxford：point](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/point_1)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 奖励积分用 mata ganjaran，比赛计分常用 mata，报告要点可用 isi penting。保留产品界面原文时，可将 points 加引号并说明含义。

etymology.historical_story: Points is an English inflected form, rather than a demonstrated Malay derivation. When inserted into Malay conversation, it can retain familiar English meanings such as scores or discussion items. Its appearance in a frequency list does not establish official Malay status, and the packet supplies no evidence dating its adoption into local speech.

etymology.historical_story: The packet labels posisi as Indonesian usage, placing it within the shared vocabulary circulating between Indonesian and Malaysian Malay. Its resemblance to English position offers a useful international connection, although resemblance alone does not establish the precise borrowing route. The ending -nya is Malay grammar: it attaches a reference to someone or something already understood. See [DBP on attached -nya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=dengan+nya).

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 不宜用是否属于 profesion 来评判工作的社会价值；介绍具体职业时，直接说 guru、doktor 或 akauntan 往往更清楚。

etymology.historical_story: Malay profesion belongs to the international vocabulary represented by English profession. The English word traces through French to Latin professio, a public declaration. Its earlier religious associations involved declared commitments; its occupational meaning later developed around a recognized calling and specialist knowledge. Malay usage emphasizes education and training rather than the older religious senses. [Etymology reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/profession).

etymology.historical_story: The established Malay family centres on jalan, connecting a road with walking, movement and the running of affairs. Perjalanan names a journey and also extends to operations and flow. The supplied perjalan resembles that noun with its ending missing. This is an editorial inference from its form, rather than evidence for a separate historical word.

etymology.historical_story: Penakluk is formed in Malay from takluk with the agent prefix peN-. DBP discusses takluk among established Arabic loanwords, whose spelling and pronunciation have become conventional in Malay. The derived noun identifies the person who conquers. Its historical associations concern power and submission, while modern figurative uses can celebrate someone overcoming an exceptionally difficult challenge.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 takluk＝臣服；peN- 标出实施动作的人：penakluk 就是“使别人臣服的人”。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在 /l/ 前实现为 pe-，词根首音 /l/ 保留；加 -an 后末尾 /s/ 成为下一音节的声母，故分音节为 pe.lu.pu.san。输入未提供 root_jawi，保留 null；DBP 所列 lupus 的 Jawi 为 لوڤوس。

senses.zh_definition: 处置、清除或消除某物的行为或过程，常指废物的最终处置。

senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau perbuatan melupuskan sesuatu.

senses.zh_definition: 对资产、库存或馆藏等进行正式处置，使其退出原有持有或使用体系的过程。
senses.en_definition: The formal disposal of assets, stock, or collection materials no longer retained or used.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam pengurusan, proses melupuskan aset, stok atau bahan koleksi yang tidak lagi dikekalkan atau digunakan.
senses.nuances: 这是基本义在管理领域的常见应用，不自动等于销毁。处置可能涉及出售、赠送或销毁；具体方式依对象和程序而定。实际用例：[MARA：图书处置流程](https://perpustakaan.mara.gov.my/doc/carta_alir_lupus.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records lupus with meanings involving disappearance or elimination. Malay morphology develops this into melupuskan, the action of disposing of something, and pelupusan, the process itself. In institutional life, the noun appears in waste management, asset administration and library procedures. Its administrative use is broader than destruction: an item may leave a collection through sale or donation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lupus 的“消失、清除”放进 pe-…-an 过程框：pelupusan＝让物品退出使用或持有体系的“处置过程”。

etymology.historical_story: This packet illustrates contact between languages rather than an established Malay word history. Peaches retains English plural marking, while Malay has the dictionary headword pic. A bilingual catalogue may therefore preserve peaches as an English label and translate it as buah pic. These records do not establish when either form entered Malaysian usage. [DBP: pic](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371996&keyword=pic)

etymology.historical_story: The tembak family shows how Malay distinguishes an action, its performer, and its outcome. Menembak presents shooting as an action; penembak names the shooter or an instrument; tembakan names a shot or report; penembakan makes the activity itself a noun. The dictionary establishes these relationships without identifying a dated origin for the root. [DBP: tembak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tembak)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 围着 tembak 记三件事：penembak 是“谁射击”，tembakan 是“那一枪”，penembakan 是“射击这件事”。

senses.ms_definition: Perihal membahagi atau membahagikan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 可指划分或分配，本身不表示平均或公平；平均须用 sama rata，公平须用 adil。须与表示某一部分、份额或部门的 bahagian 区分。马来语释义依据用户所供《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》词包展开。

etymology.historical_story: This word illustrates Malay's productive system of turning an action into a process noun. Bahagi expresses dividing, while peN-...-an packages that action as pembahagian. Sharing goods, assigning duties, and calculating portions therefore belong to one connected semantic field. This explanation concerns observable Malay word formation; it does not establish the ultimate historical origin of bahagi.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bahagi 想成“分”，把 peN-...-an 想成装动作的名词盒：装进去，就成“划分、分配这件事”。

senses.zh_definition: 加密；按照密码算法并利用密钥，将可读数据转换为密文，以保护其机密性的过程。
senses.en_definition: Encryption: the transformation of readable data into ciphertext using a cryptographic algorithm and a key to protect confidentiality.
senses.ms_definition: Proses menukarkan data yang boleh dibaca kepada teks sifer dengan menggunakan algoritma kriptografi dan kunci untuk melindungi kerahsiaan data.
senses.nuances: 用于信息技术和密码学，对应 encryption；反向过程为 penyahsulitan。不要与 kesulitan“困难”混淆，也不要把一般编码、文件压缩或设置访问密码一概称为加密。此处马来语释义为根据术语用法编写的释义，不冒充输入中缺失的 DBP 原文。[DBP 相关术语用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=penyahsulitan)。

etymology.historical_story: Penyulitan illustrates how Malay builds technical vocabulary from an existing base. Sulit can concern secrecy as well as difficulty; the secrecy sense supports the computing term for encryption. The circumfix peN-…-an names a process. Malaysian institutional usage pairs penyulitan with penyahsulitan, allowing related security operations to be expressed through a recognisable Malay word family. [DBP terminology](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=penyahsulitan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sulit 的“秘密”义抓牢：penyulitan 就是把明文变成秘密密文的过程。

etymology.historical_story: Parti comes from English party and retains two familiar meanings: a political organization and a social gathering. Partinya adds a Malay grammatical element, -nya, to that borrowed noun. This makes a useful cultural reading exercise: election reporting usually points to someone's political party, while an invitation may point to a celebration. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=parti)

etymology.historical_story: Pompeii is an inherited ancient place name, rather than a word formed from Malay elements. Its cultural significance comes from the eruption of AD 79: volcanic deposits preserved streets, houses, shops and everyday objects. Archaeologists can therefore study an urban community in extraordinary detail, giving the name a lasting association with Roman daily life. [Pompeii Archaeological Park](https://pompeiisites.org/en/archaeological-park-of-pompeii/press-kit/)

senses.zh_definition: 钻孔；使用钻具在木材、金属、混凝土等材料上形成孔洞的作业或过程。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of making holes in material with a drill.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan atau kerja membuat lubang dengan menggunakan gerudi.
senses.nuances: 指作业或过程，不指钻具本身；工具通常称 gerudi 或 mesin gerudi。可用于维修、制造和建筑语境。

senses.zh_definition: 钻探；利用钻具向地下或海床钻进，以勘探或开采石油等资源，或进行地质调查。
senses.en_definition: Drilling into the ground or seabed for exploration, extraction or geological investigation.
senses.ms_definition: Kerja menggerudi ke dalam bumi atau dasar laut, antaranya untuk mencari minyak atau menjalankan penyiasatan geologi.
senses.nuances: 这是一般钻孔义在地质和资源工业中的专业用法。penggerudian minyak 指石油钻探，不等于全部石油开采活动。
